title: Pædagog søges til fast stilling hos Melius Husene
description:
Vil du være med til at skabe en god hverdag for mennesker, der har brug for dig?

Hos Melius Husene søger vi en uddannet pædagog til en fast stilling.

Vi søger en kollega, der har lyst til at lære vores beboere godt at kende og være med til at skabe en tryg, stabil og meningsfuld hverdag.

Det pædagogiske arbejde hos os tager udgangspunkt i den enkelte beboer. Det kræver både faglighed, nærvær og evnen til at være rolig og tydelig, også når hverdagen ikke går helt som planlagt.

Vi lægger vægt på, at du tager ansvar for dit arbejde, bidrager til samarbejdet med dine kolleger og har lyst til at udvikle dig fagligt sammen med os.

Borgeren kommer først

På Melius Husene arbejder vi med voksne mennesker med blandt andet autisme og udviklingshæmning, som har forskellige behov for støtte, struktur og guidning.

Fælles for vores arbejde er, at støtten tager udgangspunkt i det enkelte menneske, dets ressourcer, behov og ønsker til hverdagen.

Borgeren kommer først.

Vi forsøger ikke at få mennesket til at passe ind i vores system. Vi forsøger at skabe rammerne omkring det enkelte menneske.

Derfor arbejder vi med en helhedsorienteret pædagogisk tilgang, hvor anerkendelse, struktur, relation og kommunikation er centrale elementer.

Du skal kunne skabe både relation og retning

Som pædagog hos os bliver du en vigtig del af hverdagen omkring vores beboere og af det faglige samarbejde med dine kolleger.

Vi arbejder sammen om at skabe kontinuitet, tryghed og en fælles pædagogisk retning, samtidig med at der skal være plads til faglige refleksioner og forskellige perspektiver.

Din opgave er blandt andet at:

·        skabe tryghed og forudsigelighed i hverdagen

·        opbygge stærke og tillidsfulde relationer

·        støtte beboerne i struktur, aktiviteter og daglige gøremål

·        arbejde pædagogisk med den enkeltes ressourcer, behov og mål

·        kunne håndtere udfordrende situationer med ro og faglighed

·        observere, dokumentere og dele vigtig faglig viden

·        samarbejde med dine kolleger og ledelsen

·        bidrage aktivt til et godt arbejdsmiljø og en positiv kultur

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du er uddannet pædagog, gerne med erfaring fra det specialiserede socialområde.

Men din uddannelse fortæller ikke alt om, hvem du er.

For os er det mindst lige så vigtigt, at du:

·        er rolig og tydelig

·        er nysgerrig på mennesker

·        tager ansvar

·        er stabil og holder dine aftaler

·        kan arbejde selvstændigt og samtidig ser værdien i samarbejde

·        spørger, når du er i tvivl

·        kan modtage og give faglig feedback

·        bidrager positivt til fællesskabet

·        kan bevare ro og overblik, når en situation bliver svær

Og så skal du have lyst til at blive en del af noget.

Vi ønsker medarbejdere, der tager medansvar for arbejdspladsen og fællesskabet og ikke kun for deres egen vagt.

Vi forventer ikke, at du kan alt

Du behøver ikke kende alle vores beboere, metoder og arbejdsgange fra første dag.

Det lærer vi dig.

Til gengæld forventer vi, at du har lyst til at lære.

Vi tror på, at man bliver dygtigere, når man tør stille spørgsmål, reflektere over sin egen praksis og bruge sine kolleger.

Hos os er det helt i orden at sige: “Det ved jeg ikke, hjælp mig lige.”

Det vigtigste er, at du er nysgerrig, tager ansvar og har lyst til at udvikle dig sammen med os.

Hvad får du hos os?

Vi tilbyder en arbejdsplads, hvor du får mulighed for at komme tæt på det pædagogiske arbejde og følge den enkelte beboers hverdag og udvikling over tid.

Du får:

·        en fast stilling

·        et arbejdsfællesskab, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og løfter opgaven sammen

·        korte veje til ledelsen

·        mulighed for faglig sparring og udvikling

·        indflydelse på den pædagogiske hverdag

·        mulighed for at arbejde i dybden med den enkelte beboer

·        mulighed for at være med til at præge og udvikle Melius Husene

·        en arbejdsplads, hvor vi ønsker høj faglighed uden at miste menneskeligheden

Vi tror på, at en god arbejdsplads ikke skabes af én person. Den skabes af mennesker, der tager ansvar for hinanden, taler ordentligt sammen og hjælper, når der er brug for det.

Måske er du den, vi mangler

Hvis du leder efter et arbejde, hvor du kan møde ind, passe din vagt og gå hjem igen, er vi måske ikke det rigtige sted.

Men hvis du gerne vil være en del af en arbejdsplads, hvor relationer, faglighed, ansvar og fællesskab betyder noget, så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

Send os din ansøgning og dit CV.

Fortæl gerne lidt om hvem du er som pædagog, hvem du er som menneske, og hvorfor du tror, Melius Husene kunne være det rigtige sted for dig.

Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler.

title: Praksisorienterede undervisere til Center for Socialt Arbejde
description:
Er du socialrådgiver med både overbygning, praksiserfaring og undervisningserfaring, og drømmer du om at anvende din erfaring til at uddanne kommende socialrådgivere? Måske har din samlede erfaring også givet dig mod på at være med til at videreuddanne praksis? Så har du chancen nu, hvor vi i Center for Socialt Arbejde (CSA) søger undervisere. I CSA er vi i gang med at opbygge en ny uddannelse jf. uddannelsesreformens intentioner om praksisnærhed og et tættere samarbejde mellem studerende og undervisere. Da vi samtidig udvikler den samlede uddannelse samt efter- og videreuddannelse, har vi brug for at udvide korpset af fastansatte undervisere. På Professionshøjskolen Absalon er det vores ambition, at de studerende oplever en fagligt og socialt inkluderende studiestart, hvor de med det samme kan mærke deres kommende profession, deres uddannelse og bliver del af et aktivt studieliv. Derfor bliver de studerende blandt andet trænet i at udvikle en professionel tilgang til arbejdet i studiegrupper, så de bliver bedst muligt rustet til deres kommende arbejdsliv. Koblingen mellem teoretisk og praktisk erfaring afgørende. Din profil Uddannelsesreformen forpligter os til at tilbyde de studerende mere undervisning - og samtidig skabe bedre forudsætninger for en styrket relation mellem studerende og undervisere. Derfor har vi udviklet værkstedsdage, vi tilbyder de studerende studenterudviklingssamtaler, og vi arbejder i stigende grad med gennemgående faste undervisere. Derfor er følgende afgørende: Praksiserfaring. Du har solid erfaring fra socialt arbejde, f.eks. fra kommunal myndighed (børn og unge, beskæftigelsesområdet eller det specialiserede voksenområde) - måske som udfører - eller måske helt andre nicher indenfor feltet socialt arbejde. Undervisningserfaring. Det er en forudsætning, at du har undervisningserfaring, da vi har behov for, at du kan træde direkte ind i underviserrollen. Du har dermed også allerede mærket, at du trives med undervisning som hovedarbejdsopgave. Teamsamarbejde og koordinering. Du har erfaret, at det kræver et stærkt og ligeværdigt teamsamarbejde at lykkes med kvalificeret undervisning. Du deler ansvar og opgaver med dine kolleger, når I kobles sammen om opgaverne. Du har måske også oplevet, at det at være en del af et team, gør at arbejdsopgaven er lettere at gå til - at I løfter i flok. Fleksibilitet. I uddannelsesverdenen er meget planlagt i rigtig god tid. Trods dette vilkår er du er indforstået med, at der sker uforudsete ændringer, og du er vant til at håndtere disse konstruktivt og med et ansvarligt og samarbejdende mindset. Det er vores forventning, at du har:
  • grunduddannelse som socialrådgiver
  • overbygning med f.eks.. relevant master- eller kandidatgrad.
Dine arbejdsopgaver Din primære opgave er undervisning af fremtidens socialrådgivere samt efter-videreuddannelse af praktikere indenfor det socialfaglige felt. De konkrete opgaver er: At udvikle, planlægge og undervise på både grunduddannelse samt på efter- og videreuddannelse. Dette sker i tæt samspil med de studerende, dine kolleger og i samarbejde med såvel interne som eksterne samarbejdspartnere. På sigt vil der være mulighed for at indgå i forsknings- og udviklingsopgaver. At bidrage til et aktivt og socialt studiemiljø. Vi lægger vægt på, at studiemiljøerne er præget af et socialt liv samt glade og engagerede studerende, der kan få kompetent sparring og støtte, både i studiegrupper og fra deres vejledere. Dine kolleger CSA udbyder socialrådgiveruddannelsen i Roskilde, Slagelse og Nykøbing
  1. Du bliver primært tilknyttet ét campus, dog med forventning om en vis fleksibilitet ift. at kunne varetage undervisning på flere af vores campusser. Som udgangspunkt får du arbejdssted på vores campus i Roskilde.
I CSA er vi ca. 65 engagerede og ambitiøse kolleger, der værdsætter samarbejde og vidensdeling i en respektfuld og uformel omgangstone. Vi er socialt og fagligt velfunderede, og påskønner faglig sparring og udvikling i fællesskab. Derfor prioriterer vi tilstedeværelse på campus, hvor vi blandt andet forkæles med en fremragende kantine- og frokostordning. Der er mulighed for hjemmearbejde i et vist omfang. Sådan ansøger du
  • Ansættelse sker efter gældende overenskomst på statens område.
  • For dig der er nyuddannet og ansættes som adjunkt, vil en forventet startløn være 40.900, - kr. inkl. pension. For dig der er en erfaren underviser og ansættes som lektor, vil en forventet startløn være 54.200, - kr. inkl. pension. Alt efter erfaring og baggrund kan der evt. forhandles kvalifikationstillæg.
  • Stillingen er på fuld tid, og vi vil gerne have at du begynder senest 1. december 2026.
  • Har du spørgsmål til stillingen er du velkommen til at kontakte uddannelsesleder Lisette Kaptain på telefon 7248 2963 eller lkap@pha.dk
  • Ansøgning og relevante bilag sendes via vores rekrutteringssystem her: https://phabsalon.dk/job-i-absalon/ledige-stillinger eller ved at klikke på 'Søg stillingen' til højre på denne side senest den 10. november 2026.
  • Vi forventer at holde samtaler den 17. november 2026
Vi ønsker, at medarbejderstaben afspejler det omgivende samfund, og vi opfordrer derfor alle interesserede uanset køn, kulturel og etnisk baggrund til at søge stillingen. Alt efter dine kvalifikationer bliver du ansat som adjunkt eller lektor På Absalon er adjunkturet en 4-årig uddannelsesstilling. Det understøtter vi gennem Absalons lektorkvalificeringsforløb, som alle nyansatte adjunkter deltager i, og alle får tilknyttet en vejleder. For at blive ansat som lektor forudsætter det en positiv lektorbedømmelse inden for stillingstrukturens anvendelsesområde. Ved ansættelse af lektorer der er lektorbedømt før 2013-stillingsstrukturen, sker ansættelse på hidtidige centralt fastsatte løn- og ansættelsesvilkår. Afhængig af dine kvalifikationer, afvejet med stillingens konkrete indhold, kan fornyet lektorbedømmelse efter den aktuelle stillingsstruktur (fast-track ordningen) eventuelt aftales. Læs mere her i kap. 5. https://www.retsinformation.dk/eli/lta/2025/413 Du kan læse mere om rammerne for ansættelse som adjunkt eller lektor i vores stillingsstruktur her: https://www.retsinformation.dk/eli/lta/2025/414 Om Absalon Professionshøjskolen Absalon er Region Sjællands største uddannelsesinstitution, hvor vi med vores 14 uddannelser uddanner mennesker, der med høj faglighed og professionalisme skaber værdi i det samfund, de er en del af. Vores uddannelser går tæt på den enkelte studerendes drømme og potentialer, tæt på den praksis de skal virke i og på de mennesker og fællesskaber, de skal gøre en mærkbar forskel for. I en ny sjællandsk storregion er det afgørende at have blik for både de store linjer, det lokale og det nære. De mennesker, der uddanner sig på Absalon, løfter andre mennesker og skaber muligheder og udvikling dér, hvor de bor og arbejder. Det er vores ambition at skabe praksisnære uddannelser af høj kvalitet og give de studerende de bedste forudsætninger for at udvikle sig til kompetente professionelle. Og vi vil styrke mulighederne for, at de kan skabe en karriere, der til enhver tid matcher deres faglige interesser og ambitioner - og det ansvar de tager i vores samfund. Vi er 850 medarbejdere, vi har 8.000 studerende på vores grunduddannelser og vi efter- og videreuddanner 3.500 kursister hvert år.

title: Professor of Shared Decision-making and Professional Development (combined position)
description:
Professor of Shared Decision-making and Professional Development 

A combined position as Professor (50%) and as Research Director (50%) is vacant at the Department of Regional Health Research, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark (SDU) and at the Centre for Shared Decision Making, Lillebaelt Hospital, Vejle, respectively.

The position is offered for five years, with the possibility of extension.

The academic positionThe professor will advance research into shared decision-making (SDM) and the involvement of patients and their relatives, as well as the professional development required to integrate these approaches into clinical practice. The professor will be part of the management team at the joint centre at Lillebælt Hospital and will foster coherence between research, education and implementation. The professor will be appointed at the Department of Regional Health Research, Faculty of Health Sciences, SDU. The academic field combines SDM with professional development for healthcare professionals. Interdisciplinary research and collaboration across clinical settings are expected and central to the position.

Research leadership and responsibilitiesAt Lillebaelt Hospital, the professor/appointee will serve as Research Director. Together with the Centre Director, the Research Director forms the joint center leadership. The Research Director has line management responsibility for academic staff and overall scientific and strategic responsibility for research activities associated with the Center for Shared Decision Making (CFFB) and the Center for Involvement of Relatives (CEPI). The two leadership roles work closely together on the development of the centers.

The professor is expected responsible for:

  • Strategic Research Leadership and Centre ManagementThe position as professor includes overall scientific and strategic responsibility for the research units affiliated with both CFFB and CEPI as well as their interdisciplinary research group. This includes line management and academic leadership of researchers, ensuring the stable operation of the centers, and maintaining strategic oversight of the centers’ grant portfolio and funding pipeline.

  • Fundraising and External Research FundingThe professor is expected to secure substantial external research funding from national and international funding bodies to ensure the long-term sustainability and development of the centers’ research activities.

  • Practice-Oriented Empirical ResearchThe professor is expected to develop and lead empirical research SDM projects with a particular focus on the perspectives of patients, relatives, and healthcare professionals within different diseases, specialties and healthcare settings, while contributing to the advancement of qualitative and applied research methodologies such as action research.

  • Development of Educational Resources, Curriculum Design, and Educational TransformationThe position requires designing and developing practical educational tools and implementation resources — e.g., learning materials — that support healthcare professionals’ learning and continuing professional development in clinical practice performing SDM.

  • Teaching, lecturing, supervising and disseminating knowledgeThe professor should teach and mentor postdocs, PhD students, and undergraduate students. Participation in assessment work is part of the position. Additionally, profiling this research area in the public eye will be an important task.

Research activity, network and collaborationThe candidate is expected to demonstrate prior experience with research activities in terms of networks and collaborations. The professor is expected to increase research activity at the research unit and to expand collaboration with other researchers at hospitals in the Region of Southern Denmark, at SDU, the rest of Denmark and internationally.

The position as Research Director at the Centre for Shared Decision Making (CFFB)The Professorship in Shared Decision-making and Professional Development at the Center for Shared Decision Making, Vejle, Denmark, is established to support the continued implementation of Lillebaelt Hospital’s research strategy and the hospital’s overarching commitment to placing the patient at the center of care.

Over the past decade, the Center has conducted research on evidence-based approaches to SDM and has demonstrated that SDM is associated with high patient satisfaction and improved adherence to agreed treatment plans. The professorship will build on this strong research foundation by advancing knowledge on the implementation of SDM and the continuing professional development of healthcare professionals. International research consistently shows that achieving sustained and authentic SDM practice in everyday clinical care remains a significant implementation challenge. Changing professional practices and departmental cultures requires more than time-limited projects or implementation initiatives. Sustainable integration of SDM depends on ongoing and continuous competence development that supports long-term changes in clinical practice.

This professorship is positioned at the intersection of health sciences research, implementation in clinical practice, and professional development through applied educational research. The core purpose of the position is to strengthen and transform the healthcare system’s capacity for meaningful patient and family involvement through SDM.

The professorship requires strategic research leadership from a scholar with extensive expertise in lifelong learning, learning theory, curriculum theory, and action research, and with the ability to translate this knowledge into continuing professional development for healthcare professionals. The professor is expected to lead the national and international research agenda on how SDM can be integrated meaningfully and sustainably into routine clinical practice, to achieve enduring behavioral change among healthcare professionals.

QualificationsThe required qualifications:

  • Applicants must hold a PhD or equivalent post-graduate research qualification and demonstrate scientific achievements at a level appropriate for appointment as Professor.

  • The position calls for expertise in educational science as applied to the professional development of healthcare staff or other types of welfare staff, together with substantial knowledge of and research contributions to SDM.

  • The applicant should be able to demonstrate experience of teaching and lecturing at university and postgraduate level, as well as experience as principal supervisor on PhD projects and academic assessment work, as evidenced by the teaching portfolio.

  • Danish language skills are not required at the time of appointment, but must be mastered at proficiency level C1, at the Common European Framework of References for Languages within the first 2 years of employment.

The ideal candidate preferably demonstrates:

  • The candidate should demonstrate experience with leadership capacity with the ability to lead research teams, drive cultural change, and contribute strategically to the development of the centers.

  • The candidate holds experience in research management, interdisciplinary collaboration, and attraction of external funding for professional development and/or SDM-oriented activities will be considered an advantage.

  • The candidate preferably demonstrates experience with practice-oriented empirical research. Research that is aimed at both an international research community, and ideally also at the target group of professionals in Denmark; therefore, publications and outputs are welcome to be in Danish – whether in the form of books, leaflets, journal publications or other material designed to ensure that both professionals undertaking continuing professional development in Denmark and students on undergraduate program are best supported and thereby ensuring impact.

  • The candidate has prior experience with developing, implementing, and/or evaluating educational programs, frameworks, and curricula for continuing professional development, preferably in terms of SDM-related competencies. Experience of developing and evaluating continuing professional education in clinical settings is valued.

  • The preferred candidate can motivate and supervise, has proven research management skills, good interpersonal skills in charge of a research group, and has a clear vision for how to further strengthen the research unit at CFFB as strong interpersonal and collaborative skills are essential.

  • The successful applicant will have documented experience of leading research and researchers, obtain external funding and work across disciplines and organizations.

EmployersCFFB is a national knowledge and competence center based at Lillebaelt Hospital. Since 2014, it has researched SDM and since 2019 developed approaches for implementation in clinical practice. CEPI works to strengthen meaningful involvement of relatives. The centers retain their distinct areas of responsibility while collaborating closely on research and practice. Lillebaelt Hospital provides somatic and mental healthcare across sites in Vejle, Kolding and Middelfart. Patient and family involvement is central to their approach to care.

SDU's Department of Regional Health Research links research and education with hospitals and clinical environments across the Region of Southern Denmark. The Department of Regional Health Research supports research in relation to the person as a whole, the good life and the more common diseases, makes out a platform for scientists and educators and builds a bridge between University of Southern Denmark, The Region of Southern Denmark, the hospitals in the region and the patient. The department focuses on the continuity of patient care across sectors, hospitals, and specialist fields.

Reference The professor and research director will refer to the hospital management regarding matters concerning the management of the centres, and to the Head of the Department of Regional Health Research, Mikkel Brabrand, in matters regarding the professorship.

Contact informationFurther information concerning the position can be obtained by contacting:

  • The Research Coordinator at Lillebælt Hospital, Jonna Skov Madsen, Jonna.Skov.Madsen@rsyd.dk, +45 30507825

  • The Director of the Centre, Karina Olling, Karina.Olling@rsyd.dk, +45 51518696

  • The Head of the Department of Regional Health Research, SDU, Mikkel Brabrand, mbrabrand@health.sdu.dk, +45 93534980

Salary and terms of employmentThe successful applicant for the professor position will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

The position as Professor is salaried in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and on terms corresponding to salary grade 37 of the Danish state salary system. Additional qualification- and function-related allowances may be negotiated.

The work location will be at Center for Shared Decision Making (Center for Fælles Beslutningstagning), Beriderbakken 4, 7100 Vejle, Denmark.

ApplicationOnly applications written in English will be accepted for evaluation.

The application must include (as PDF files) (please note that the application (the motivation letter) and CV must not exceed 10 MB in total):

  • An application

  • A detailed CV

  • Degree certificates (inclusive of Ph.D.-diploma or equivalent)

  • A complete and numbered list of publications

  • 10 scientific peer-reviewed publications considered by the candidate as most important for this position (please notice that one pdf file must be attached for each publication)

  • It is permitted to merge the 10 scientific peer-reviewed publications into a single PDF file due to upload constraints.

  • A teaching portfolio detailing the candidate’s prior teaching experience, teaching skills, and teaching philosophy

  • Track record in obtaining research funding

  • National and international research collaboration and collaborations with researchers in other disciplines and sectors

  • A research plan detailing the candidate’s ideas and plans for her/his future research work

Please note that all the above-mentioned information must be included in the application. Incomplete applications with regards to the above-mentioned requirements will not be assessed.

Applications received after the deadline and/or incomplete applications will not be considered.

The application deadline is 11 November 2026 at 11.59 PM/23.59 (CET/CEST)

AssessmentShortlisting will be used as part of the initial selection process. 

Assessment of shortlisted applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Shortlisted applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material. 

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicants will receive part of the evaluation that concerns themselves.

title: PhD stipend in thermal modeling and advanced solutions for high-power modules and magnetic components
description:
At AAU Energy, a PhD stipend is available within the general study programme in Electrical and Electronic Engineering. The stipend is open for appointment from 1 December 2026 or soon hereafter. The duration of the position is three years and the position is full-time.

Your work tasksThe position is offered in relation to the GreenMag project, and you will be positioned in the Section of Power Electronics Systems and Materials within the research programme Sustainable Power Electronics and Electrification (SPELL) at AAU Energy, Aalborg University. You will be based at the Aalborg campus in a highly international research environment with close collaboration with academic and industrial partners in the field of power electronics and energy systems.

The increasing electrification of transport, industry and renewable energy systems is driving the development of high-power-density power converters operating at megawatt levels. Advanced planar magnetic components are emerging as a key technology for achieving higher power density, manufacturability and integration in such converters. However, thermal management remains one of the major challenges that limit the performance, reliability and scalability of planar magnetic solutions, especially at high power and high frequency.

In this PhD project, you will work on the development of innovative thermal management technologies for megawatt planar magnetics used in future electrification systems. Your research will combine advanced modelling, experimental validation and prototype development to improve heat dissipation and thermal reliability while maintaining the required electrical and magnetic performance. You will analyse thermal behaviour and heat transfer mechanisms in high-power planar magnetic components, design and evaluate cooling concepts and contribute to the integration of these solutions in realistic converter systems.

You will conduct cutting-edge research on thermal behaviour and heat transfer mechanisms in megawatt-class planar magnetic components and use this knowledge to propose and evaluate new design strategies. You will develop multiphysics simulation models using finite element modelling tools to investigate the thermal performance of planar magnetics and to study alternative cooling concepts and material choices. You will design, manufacture and experimentally validate novel thermal management solutions for planar magnetic structures, and you will explore advanced materials and cooling technologies that can be applied in megawatt-class magnetic components. As part of the GreenMag project, you will collaborate with academic and industrial partners, disseminate your research results through publications in international journals and conferences, and contribute to teaching and supervision activities within the department as part of the PhD education programme.

Your competencies You have a relevant educational background within Power Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Thermal Engineering, Energy Engineering or a closely related field, and you hold a Master’s degree that qualifies you for enrolment in the PhD programme. You are motivated to work at the interface between thermal science, electromagnetics and power electronics, and you are interested in both theoretical and experimental research.

You bring strong analytical skills and a structured approach to modelling and problem solving, and you are comfortable working with numerical tools for thermal and multiphysics analysis. Experience with thermal analysis, power electronics or magnetic component design will be considered an advantage, as will experience with finite element analysis tools such as COMSOL Multiphysics or ANSYS. It is beneficial if you have worked with experimental testing, prototype development or laboratory work in previous projects and if you are prepared to work with both simulation and hands-on experiments in this PhD.

As a person, you are curious and creative, and you are motivated by addressing challenging research questions in collaboration with others. You are able to work independently, take responsibility for your project and contribute actively to collaborative research activities across groups and institutions. Good communication skills in English, both written and spoken, are required, as you will present your results in scientific publications, at international conferences and in meetings with project partners.

Qualification requirementsPhD stipends are allocated to individuals who hold a Master's degree. PhD stipends are normally for a period of 3 years. It is a prerequisite for allocation of the stipend that the candidate will be enrolled as a PhD student at the Doctoral School of Engineering and Science in accordance with the regulations of Ministerial Order No. 872 of 6 October 2026 on the PhD Programme at the Universities and Certain Higher Artistic Educational Institutions. According to the Ministerial Order, the progress of the PhD student shall be assessed at regular points in time. As part of the PhD study, you are among other things required to complete PhD courses corresponding to 30 ECTS, gain experience with teaching or other forms of knowledge dissemination and complete an external research stay outside of Aalborg University, preferably 3-6 months at a foreign research institution.

Who we are    AAU Energy is a research department at Aalborg University dedicated to the development of clean and sustainable energy systems. Our activities cover electrical, thermal and mechatronic energy technologies, and we work closely with industrial partners, utilities and other academic environments to address real-world energy challenges. Aalborg University is recognised internationally for excellence in power electronics and energy systems research, and AAU has been ranked among the leading universities in Europe within energy research. At AAU Energy, you will be part of a highly international environment where research, innovation and collaboration are used to develop solutions to global challenges associated with electrification and the green transition.

The department has campuses in Aalborg and Esbjerg, and this position is based at the Aalborg campus. AAU Energy employs approximately 300 staff members from a broad range of nationalities and disciplinary backgrounds, creating a vibrant international research environment with extensive opportunities for collaboration and professional growth. The department offers world-class laboratory and workshop facilities, and maintains close collaboration with industrial partners. As a PhD student, you will have access to advanced facilities for the design, manufacturing and testing of high-power magnetic components and power electronic systems, and you will be part of an active research community in Sustainable Power Electronics and Electrification.

You can read more about AAU Energy at www.energy.aau.dkHow to applyYour application must include the following:

  • Application, stating reasons for applying and qualifications in relation to the position
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV)
  • Diplomas (bachelor's and master's degree diploma, including grades) 
  • Other relevant documents

title: Tenure-track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor of Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing
description:
Tenure-track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor of Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing Department of Food Science Faculty of Science University of Copenhagen The Department of Food Science (FOOD), Faculty of Science (SCIENCE), University of Copenhagen (UCPH) invites applications for a position as Tenure-track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor in Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing. The research areas of FOOD have a shared mission to contribute to new pathways for society and industry to support the development of solutions based in biology to improve sustainable food production, food security and food safety. FOOD is recognized for excellence in food research, education and industrial collaboration. The Department is an international workplace with Danish and English as parallel working languages, however it is expected that the successful candidate will be able to contribute to teaching in Danish within 3 to 6 years. FOOD has the ambition to reinforce our teaching and research in designing and optimizing biology-based solutions as future sustainable food and ingredient technologies. UCPH is strengthening this area by offering the new MSc Biosolutions program in Kalundborg, Denmark, the largest bio-based manufacturing hub in Scandinavia, home to large fermentation-based manufacturers, and a vibrant innovation environment. The candidate for this position is expected to significantly contribute to this new Biosolutions initiative. The aim of the position is to explore the production and use of new solutions based on both biology and engineering addressing sustainability challenges inherent in food systems today. Although we welcome a diverse range of applicants, the focus of the position will be processing in relation to biochemically based solutions and could include the following disciplines:
  • Food process technology, ideally with an emphasis on fermentation & downstream processing
  • Food process system engineering
  • Use of sensor technologies such as in-line or at line spectroscopic tools
  • Large-data, modelling and prediction of food and ingredient processes.
  • Understanding of biological production systems and their use, and with an emphasis on downstream processing
A central part of the activities anchored to this position will be taking place in Campus Kalundborg, and it is crucial that the candidate is able to leverage the local ecosystem to foster strong collaboration with industry. Qualifications are expected in the following areas:
  • A collaborative and innovative mindset
  • Documented scientific impact and outreach in past research work
  • A proven track record in attracting external funding at both national and international level
  • Experience with international collaborations
  • Ability to establish industrial collaboration
  • Excellent interpersonal and communicative skills
Tenure-track assistant professor The tenure-track assistant professor’s duties will primarily include research, including obligations regarding publication/scientific communication and research-based teaching with associated examination obligations within Ingredient Biochemical Processing. To a limited extent the position may also include other duties. The tenure-track assistant professor must have an academic standing showing internationally competitive research, and/or have internationally recognized high potential to make a future impact. Assessment of applicants for the tenure-track assistant professorship will primarily consider their level of documented, internationally competitive research. The ability to attract external funding will be considered together with outreach qualifications. Teaching qualifications are not mandatory but documented teaching qualifications and teaching experience will be considered. Associate professor Applicants are required to have university level teaching experience, documented teaching competencies and must be able to explain and reflect upon own teaching practice and portfolio. Formal pedagogical training or supervision equivalent to the University of Copenhagen teacher training programme for assistant professors is required. The candidate must be an inspiring teacher with a vision on teaching development, especially in connection with the new MSc Biosolutions program. A new campus with research and teaching facilities is currently being built in Kalundborg and the candidate is expected to contribute to setting up the facilities Duties include the applicant’s own research, development of the field, assessment tasks, grant applications, and research management such as supervision and training of research fellows and other staff. The successful applicant must also teach, supervise, prepare and participate in examinations, and fulfill other tasks requested by the Department. Assessment of applicants for the associate professorship will primarily consider their level of documented, original scientific production at an international level, including contributions to developments in their field, as well as their documented teaching qualifications. Managerial and out-reach qualifications of applicants including ability to attract external funding will also be considered. University of Copenhagen’s criteria for recognising merit General criteria apply to the appointment of assistant professor / associate professor at the University of Copenhagen. The criteria (research, teaching, Innovation & societal impact, organizational contribution and leadership) are considered as a framework for an overall assessment of the applicant. In addition, each applicant will be assessed according to the specific requirements listed in this advertisement. Please read more here For tenure-track assistant professors: https://jobportal.ku.dk/videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-meritering-maj-2026/5a_Criteria_for_recognising_merit_-Assistant_professors.pdf For associate professors: https://jobportal.ku.dk/videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-meritering-maj-2026/5b_Criteria_for_recognising_merit_-Associate_professors.pdf Applicants are encouraged to read the University of Copenhagen's Guidance on the merit criterion Innovation and Societal Impact here The tenure-track assistant programme The tenure-track programme is a career programme and an assigned mentor will provide the tenure-track assistant professors with guidance related to career development, other academic topics and administrative procedures. Performance of the tenure-track assistant professor will be followed via internal yearly evaluations and a mid-term and final international evaluation by an assessment committee. If the ‘final appraisal’ is positive you will be promoted as associate professor. Performance and progression towards the criteria below will be evaluated with due consideration of differences between research fields. After a 6-year tenure-track period tenure-track assistant professors are expected to meet the criteria for appointment of associate professors at the University of Copenhagen. Salary and employment conditions The position is open from 1 May 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. The position is covered by the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff. Employment is as either tenure track assistant professor or associate professor under the applicable collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State. There will be an opportunity to negotiate supplements based on qualifications. You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish). The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background. The Professor will be a part of the Section for Ingredients and Dairy Technology. The section has internationally acknowledged expertise within novel sustainable processing technologies, protein, polyphenol and lipid chemistry, functionality, and modification of food components, kinetics, oxidation, food engineering, rheology, digitalisation, and advanced data analysis. The section is also equipped with pilot facilities for brewing, dairy and bioprocessing. Further information on the Department is linked at Department of Food Science – University of Copenhagen Inquiries about the position can be made to Inquiries about the position can be made to Head of Department, Colin Ray (+45 93565911, colin.ray@food.ku.dk) or Head of Section, Mogens Larsen Andersen (+45 3533 3262, mola@food.ku.dk). Filing of application The position may be applied for at the tenure-track assistant professor level or associate professor level. Please note that it is possible to apply at more than one level. If applied at more than one level, separate applications must be submitted (see below). The application including all attachments must be in English and submitted electronically by clicking APPLY NOW below. Applying for the tenure-track assistant professorship please include
  • Curriculum vitae including:
    • Please describe and document international network and relations
    • Please describe and document internationally based activities
    • Positions held at universities/research institutions outside Denmark
    • Outreach activities, i.e. popular lectures or other activities in the media
    • Grants held, personal or in part. Career development grants.
  • Diplomas (Master and PhD degree or equivalent)
  • Research plan - description of current and future research plans
  • If available, description and documentation of teaching and supervision experience and qualifications- please describe and document:
    • Experience with supervision of BSc and MSc students
    • Teaching experience
    • Formal pedagogical training
  • Complete publication list
  • Separate reprints of up to 5 particularly relevant papers
Applying for the associate professorship please include
  • Curriculum vitae including information about external funding
  • Diplomas (Master and PhD degree or equivalent)
  • Research plan – description of current and future research plans
  • Description and documentation of teaching experience and qualifications according to university guidelines
  • Complete publication list
  • Separate reprints of 5 particularly relevant papers
The deadline for applications is 1 November 2026, 23:59 GMT +1. After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the Interview Committee. You can read about the recruitment process at http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/. Interviews will be held on 8 March 2027. Please refer to the following no. in future communication in this case: 211-0263/26-2N, Tenure-track Assistant Professor Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing. 211-0760/26-2E, Associate Professor of Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing.

title: PhD scholarship in Development of High Temperature Heat Pumps with Thermal Energy Storage - DTU Construct
description:
Do you want to start your research career by making industrial heat clean, flexible and affordable? At DTU Construct you will work at the forefront of technologies key to decarbonizing industries: high-temperature heat pumps and high-temperature thermal energy storage.We invite applications for a fully funded PhD position in the Thermal Energy Section of the Department of Civil and Mechanical Engineering at the Technical University of Denmark. The position is part of HeatMinds, a Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions (MSCA) Doctoral Network funded by Horizon Europe. HeatMinds brings together 6 universities and research institutes and 12 industrial and research partners across Europe to develop industrial high-temperature heat pumps and thermal energy storage. Your project will develop new Carnot Battery technologies: systems that combine heat pumps based on high temperature thermodynamic cycles together with high-temperature thermal energy storage, such as molten salts and dual-media packed beds. These systems will deliver clean process heat while also giving industry flexibility on the electricity market.Supervision: Prof. Adriano Sciacovelli and Prof. Anders Christiansen Erlandsson with industrial secondments. Responsibilities and qualificationsYour overall goal will be to find out how industrial high temperature heat pumps can benefit from integrated thermal energy storage by developing new cost-effective, high-performance hybrid configurations. You will work with fellow doctoral candidates across the network and with industrial partners in Denmark and abroad.Your main tasks will be:
  • Develop and Design new architectures comprising cycles using natural working fluids and thermal energy storage, optimised for efficiency, cost, and fast response to electricity price signals
  • Carry out multi-objective optimisation and dynamic system analysis of alternative layouts
  • Validate results by carrying out experiments and data comparison during industrial secondments, turning the results into innovations with real-world impact (e.g. patents, future commercial solutions)
  • Publish in international journals, present at conferences and take part in HeatMinds network training, summer schools and outreach.
You have:
  • A solid background in engineering thermodynamics, heat transfer and energy technologies, e.g. conversion or storage systems
  • Familiarity with modelling and numerical simulations, for example for MSc thesis or student projects
  • Programming skills, preferably in Python, Matlab, Modelica or similar
  • Excellent written and spoken English, and the motivation to work in an international, goal-oriented environment.
MSCA eligibility: at the time of recruitment, you must not already hold a doctoral degree. You must also not have resided or carried out your main activities (work, studies, etc) in Denmark for more than 12 months in the 36 months immediately before your recruitment date.You must have a two-year master's degree (120 ECTS points) or a similar degree with an academic level equivalent to a two-year master's degree.Approval and Enrolment The scholarship for the PhD degree is subject to academic approval, and the candidate will be enrolled in one of the general degree programmes at DTU. For information about our enrolment requirements and the general planning of the PhD study programme, please see DTU's rules for the PhD education. We offerDTU is a leading technical university globally recognized for the excellence of its research, education, innovation and scientific advice. We offer a rewarding and challenging job in an international environment. We strive for academic excellence in an environment characterized by collegial respect and academic freedom tempered by responsibility.Salary and appointment termsThe appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Please see DTU’s salary structure for scientific staff: www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures. The PhD salary will be based on the Marie S. Curie compensation scheme conditions and according to the grant agreement. Based on seniority the candidate will receive a minimum of DKK 30.264,08 (base salary) and DKK 1580,90 (PhD supplement). In addition, DTU will also pay pension consisting of 18,07%. Finally, it is possible to apply for family allowance. The period of employment is 3 years. The position is a full-time position. Starting date is anticipated as 1 April 2027, or according to mutual agreement. You can read more about career paths at DTU here.Further informationFurther information may be obtained from Prof. Adriano Sciacovelli, adrsc@dtu.dk and Prof. Anders Christiansen Erlandsson, acerl@dtu.dk. You can read more about Department of Civil and Mechanical Engineering at www.construct.dtu.dk. If you are applying from abroad, you may find useful information on working in Denmark and at DTU at DTU – Moving to Denmark. Furthermore, you have the option of joining our monthly free seminar “PhD relocation to Denmark and startup “Zoom” seminar” for all questions regarding the practical matters of moving to Denmark and working as a PhD at DTU. Application procedure Your complete online application must be submitted no later than 24 November 2026 (23:59 Danish time). Applications must be submitted as one PDF file containing all materials to be given consideration. To apply, please open the link "Apply now", fill out the online application form, and attach all your materials in English in one PDF file. The file must include:
  • A letter motivating the application (cover letter)
  • Curriculum vitae
  • Grade transcripts and BSc/MSc diploma (in English) including official description of grading scale
  • A copy of thesis (if available) or other publications (if available)
  • A short critical literature review (max. 3 pages) on high-temperature heat pumps combined with thermal energy storage (e.g. Carnot Batteries): select up to 5 relevant publications and explain your choice, compare their methods & findings, identify possible open research questions, explaining how your background would help you address them. Include at least one figure or table of your own making.
You may apply prior to obtaining your master's degree but cannot begin before having received it. Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.DTU Civil and Mechanical Engineering develops and utilises science and technical knowledge for the benefit of society and the sustainable development. We undertake research, education, innovation, and scientific advice of the highest quality within building design and processes, building construction and safety, building energy and technical services, solid mechanics, fluid mechanics, coastal and maritime engineering, materials technology, manufacturing engineering, engineering systems design, design for sustainability, and thermal energy.DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.

title: MHPSS Advisor
description:
Are you an experienced Mental Health and Psychosocial Support (MHPSS) professional with a passion for advancing evidence-based MHPSS practice in humanitarian settings? Danish Red Cross (DRC) is looking for a MHPSS Advisor to provide technical expertise, capacity development, and quality assurance to the Red Cross Red Crescent National Societies (RCRC) National Societies delivering community-based MHPSS interventions in humanitarian settings.

About the position and the assignments  

You will be based at the Danish Red Cross HQ in Copenhagen and will be part of the Health Team in the Technical Quality and Impact Unit of the International Department. The Health Team comprises technical advisors within health and mental health and psychosocial support. It ensures the availability of the necessary technical capacities to provide timely and relevant assistance and advice to DRC-supported operations, with a primary focus on the Africa, while also supporting MHPSS interventions in MENA, Europe and Asia regions as needed.

As a member of the Health Team, you will be working under the line management of the Health Team Lead and will also work closely with other colleagues at the DRC HQ and Regional and Country Offices (COs), as well as with NSs staff and volunteers. You will also collaborate with the colleagues from the International Federation of the Red Cross Red Crescent (IFRC) and the International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC). The position does not have programme management responsibilities but supports programmes through technical accompaniment, mentoring, and quality assurance.

Your main responsibilities will be to:

  • Strategic planning and direction: Contribute to defining and rollout of DRC’s strategic directions within MHPSS in humanitarian settings. Support development and rollout of strategies, policies, and technical frameworks for MHPSS in humanitarian settings.
  • Technical support and guidance: Provide evidence-based guidance and advice to DRC COs and National Societies on MHPSS priorities, approaches and activities, remotely or through country visits and missions to ensure that MHPSS interventions follow industry standards and good practice. Support development or adaptation and rollout of relevant technical tools and guidelines to meet operational needs.
  • Strengthening of capacities: Support National Societies in assessing technical capacity needs, and in designing and implementing capacity-strengthening plans, including trainings, coaching, mentoring, and technical supervision. 
  • Program monitoring and evaluation:  Support planning and undertaking of assessments, baselines, endlines, reviews and evaluations, and monitoring of MHPSS interventions.
  • Advocacy: In close collaboration with relevant humanitarian diplomacy (HD) colleagues, contribute to DRC’s policy influencing, advocacy and HD efforts on MHPSS in humanitarian settings.
  • Resource mobilisation: Support proposal development by contributing to the design and quality assurance of MHPSS components in the project proposals that align with donor requirements and organisational goals and priorities.
  • Partnerships and collaboration: Foster thematic partnerships and joint MHPSS initiatives within the RCRC Movement and with external stakeholders. 
  • Surge deployments: Undertake MHPSS surge/deployments in support of DRC bi-lateral operations and wider RCRC Movement responses, including multilateral deployments with the ICRC and the IFRC.  

 

Your profile

We are looking for an experienced MHPSS professional with at least five years of experience working on community-based MNHPSS with humanitarian and development organisations, including at least three years in international postings in Africa and MENA regions. You hold a master's degree, or equivalent experience, in MHPSS, social sciences, or another relevant field. You have sound technical, strategy and advisory skills within community-based MHPSS in humanitarian settings and migration. You have proven experience developing and adapting technical guidance, tools and training materials, as well as designing and facilitating capacity-development initiatives for staff and volunteers of partner organisations. 

You have experience supporting assessments, technical reviews, evaluations, and the development of quality assurance processes for community-based MHPSS interventions. You are an excellent facilitator and communicator with strong interpersonal and cross-cultural skills. You work collaboratively, are well organised, and are able to manage multiple priorities while meeting deadlines. You are willing and able to undertake field missions, including emergency deployments, with travel of up to four months per year. Professional working proficiency in both English and French is required. Experience of working for the International RCRC Movement is considered an asset. 

We offer

A job with an opportunity to improve the lives of the most vulnerable people around the world. We further offer a unique opportunity to influence the strategic development and mainstreaming of MHPSS in humanitarian settings.

The position is a full-time position - 37 working hours per week. The position is 12 months with possibility for extension.

Salary and employment conditions are in accordance with Danish Red Cross’s collective bargaining agreement with HK and AC, depending on experience and qualifications. The position is based at the Danish Red Cross headquarters in Copenhagen and requires on-site presence. As this is a national position based in Denmark, the salary package does not include relocation assistance to Denmark and housing or family-related allowances.

Your future workplace

The International Red Cross and Red Crescent network is the largest humanitarian network in the world, with a presence and activities in almost every country. All Red Cross and Red Crescent activities have one central purpose: to help those who suffer, without discrimination, whether during conflict, in response to natural or man-made disasters, or due to conditions of chronic poverty. Our work is guided by seven fundamental principles: humanity, impartiality, independence, voluntary service, unity, and universality. 

DRC’s international department’s approx. 300 staff supporting RCRC NSs with planning and implementing humanitarian and development interventions in some of the most challenging contexts in 20 countries across Africa, MENA, Asia, and Europe.

We offer a meaningful work at a purpose-driven workplace with truly engaged colleagues. We focus on professional challenges, well-being and a flexible organising of your work life. All of us contribute to a great work environment and colleagueship. 

 

Application and further information

For any specific questions about the position, please contact us at zesd@rodekors.dk subject “MHPSS Advisor 2026”.

Interviews will take place in the second part of November with an expected start date as soon as possible and no later than 01 January 2027. 

We look forward to receiving your application and CV no later than 18 November 2026. Application and CV in English are accepted only through our online recruitment system. Applications made by email will not be reviewed.

title: Gram Equipment Graduate Program
description:
Unleash your potential in the Gram Equipment Graduate talent program - Experience hands-on learning in real business settings, open doors to global career opportunities, and join a community of change-makers!

About Us:

Gram Equipment is a global leader in providing innovative solutions for the ice cream and dairy industry. We are dedicated to pushing the boundaries of technology and driving forward the future of our industry. As part of our commitment to nurturing talent and fostering excellence, we are excited to announce our Graduate Program, designed to provide an immersive experience for aspiring professionals who are passionate about both mechanical engineering and commercial business.

Program Overview:

Our Graduate Program offers a unique opportunity for candidates with diverse backgrounds to gain a well-rounded experience in our organization. The program spans a duration of 24 months, divided into four rotations of six months each. This structure ensures that participants gain a comprehensive understanding of both mechanical engineering and commercial aspects of our business.

Qualifications:

We are seeking candidates who have or will graduate either in 2026 or in 2027, and who meet the following criteria:

  • Mechanical Engineering Background with Commercial Interest:

Candidates with a mechanical engineering background who possess a strong interest in commercial business and project management.

  • Commercial Engineering Background with Mechanical Engineering Interest:

Candidates with a commercial/business-oriented Engineering background who are keen to explore the world of mechanical engineering.

Key Program Highlights:

  • Mentorship: Participants will have the opportunity to work closely with a personal mentor from our global management team, offering valuable insights and guidance throughout the program.
  • Continuous Development: Gram Equipment is committed to fostering the growth and development of its talent. Participants will have access to the Gram Academy, a platform dedicated to ongoing learning and skill development.
  • International Rotation: Possibility for an international 6 month rotation in either our Turkish or US location.
  • Community Building: Join a vibrant and peer -based community of talented individuals within our organization, creating opportunities for networking, knowledge sharing, and collaboration.

How to Apply & Our Recruitment Process:

Our recruitment process is designed to identify and nurture potential talent. We believe in comprehensive evaluation, from video interviews and cognitive assessments to in-depth interviews and real-world business case evaluations during the Assessment Day, ensuring we welcome the best fit for our Graduate Program.

  1. Application and Assessment: Apply before 1st of March 2027, and if shortlisted, you'll complete a video interview and cognitive assessment.
  2. Interview and Evaluation: Promising candidates proceed to a comprehensive evaluation phase, which evaluates their behavioral competencies and business acumen, including a detailed assessment of a business case.
  3. Contract and Start Date: Upon impressing us at every stage, you'll sign a contract and officially begin your journey with the Gram Equipment Graduate Program on 1st of September 2027.

Join Us in Shaping the Future:

At Gram Equipment, we believe that innovation is driven by diverse perspectives and talents. Join our Graduate Program to embark on a journey that will equip you with the skills, knowledge, and experiences needed to excel in both the mechanical engineering and commercial aspects of our dynamic industry.

We look forward to welcoming the next generation of leaders to our team.

“For me, the biggest value being part of the Gram Equipment Graduate Program has been the people I have worked with along the way and the understanding I have gained of how the different parts of the organization come together.”Tommy Bui (ENG Integrated Design - SDU) - Project Manager at Gram Equipment

“The Graduate program gave me a strong network across the entire company and useful insights into many of our internal processes.” / “Contributing to such a significant change as a graduate was both empowering and a clear example of how my work could make a meaningful difference.”Luciana Apachitei (ENG in Global Business Engineering - VIA University College) - Engineering Excellence Project Manager "At Gram Equipment, I have shaped the company's direction and the projects related to it. I have had the chance to choose the projects that interested me. Many of the things I have learned in my studies, I have been able to apply to what I am doing at Gram Equipment, from engineering work to business understanding. I am actively involved in the strategy work, engineering practices and various digitalization tools. I use a lot of theoretical knowledge that I have acquired in my Engineering studies in relation to my daily work. My business background helped me understand how the business is working, and because the company foundation is at the technical aspect, my background has helped me identify its strengths and weaknesses very fast." -Rudy Mandrup Cazelles (ENG Product Development and Innovation - SDU) - Business Developer at Gram Equipment

Gram Equipment is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: 1.assistent til SMP - Fyn
description:
Vi søger en erfaren 1.assistent til Fyn

Er du serviceminded og kan lide et job med meget kørsel?

SMP Rengøringsservice er i rivende udvikling og søger derfor en erfaren medarbejder på fuldtid (37t), til vores i forvejen stærke team på Fyn.

Som 1.assistent er dit ansvar at sikre afviklingen af den daglige rengøring i samarbejde med din Serviceinspektør

Andre opgaver kan også forekomme.

Du vil have direkte reference til din Serviceinspektør hos SMP rengøringsservice. Jobbet indebærer b.la. følgende arbejdsområder:

•   Skal stå for rengøring af egne pladser og øvrig bemanding iht. rengøringskalenderen

•   Skabe god relation til kunderne

•   Være behjælpelig med afløsning ved. ferie/sygdom

•   Hjælpe ved opstart af nye kunder og opgaver sammen med Serviceinspektør

•   Forefaldne opgaver i samarbejde med din Serviceinspektør

 

Det skal forventes, at timer kan ligge både tidlig morgen, eftermiddag og aften.

 

Hvem er du?

 

Vi søger dig, som trives i en omskiftelig hverdag, hvor opgaverne og dagene aldrig er ens.

Det er ikke vigtigt for dig, at du har faste rammer mandag-fredag fra 8-16, men tværtimod trives du med en flydende hverdag, hvor arbejdsugen kan variere med forskellige tidspunkter på dagen.

Som person kan du nikke genkendende til, at du:

•   Har erfaring med erhvervsrengøring

•   Trives i en til tider hektisk hverdag

•   Står til rådighed for rengøring af egne pladser

•   deler telefonvagt efter forudgående aftale

     står for sidemandsoplæring af rengøringspersonale

•   Kan håndtere og omgås forskellige kulturer

•   Behersker dansk og engelsk i skrift og tale på et rimeligt niveau

•   Har kørekort

•   Kan fremvise straffeattest

Du får stillet en firmabil til rådighed, samt firmatelefon- iPad, og arbejdsbeklædning.

Vi glæder os meget til at lære dig at kende - så hvis du kan se dig selv i denne stilling, bedes du sende din ansøgning til: job@smpservice.dk  - husk at mærke ansøgningen ” 1.assistent Fyn”

 

Samtaler bliver holdt løbende.

 

Har du ikke hørt fra os inden den 04.11.2026, skal du betragte jobbet som besat til anden side.

 

SMP er en velrenommeret virksomhed i rengøringsbranchen, - og det vil vi gerne blive ved med at være

Vi beskæftiger i dag mere end 300 medarbejdere med kunder i en stor del af Danmark. Vi har landsdækkende og lokale aftaler inden for kontor, produktion, skoler, slagterier, bagerier, butikker, supermarkeder mv.

title: Senior Authorised Person (SAP) – Switching Leader
description:
Senior Authorised Person (SAP) – Electrical Operations / Switching Leader

Location: DenmarkEmployment type: Full-timeEmployer: Global Nordics

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Senior Authorised Person (SAP) / Switching Leader (Koblingsleder) to support electrical operations on a major engineering project in Denmark.

The successful candidate will be responsible for coordinating safe switching operations, electrical isolations and safety procedures across high-voltage (HV) and low-voltage (LV) electrical systems.

The position operates within an established electrical safety management structure, under the designated Operation Manager (Driftsansvarlig Person), and in accordance with applicable Danish electrical safety regulations and EN 50110-1.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan, coordinate and oversee HV and LV switching operations.

  • Prepare and review switching schedules and electrical safety documentation.

  • Coordinate electrical isolations, earthing and safe access procedures.

  • Prepare, issue and cancel safety documents within the scope of assigned authorisation.

  • Coordinate with Control Engineers and electrical work teams during operational activities.

  • Ensure appropriate safety precautions are implemented before electrical work begins.

  • Supervise and coordinate personnel involved in electrical operational activities.

  • Support commissioning, energisation and electrical system handover.

  • Maintain accurate switching records, operational logs and safety documentation.

  • Participate in safety audits, risk assessments and toolbox talks.

title: Head of the Nordic-Baltic Cyber Consortium (NBCC)
description:
About the positionThe Danish Resilience Agency (SAMSIK) is seeking a highly experienced and strategic leader to serve as Head of the Nordic-Baltic Cyber Consortium (NBCC).The NBCC is a Danish-hosted, EU-supported cybersecurity initiative established under the EU Cyber Solidarity Act. The consortium brings together Denmark, Estonia, Finland, Iceland, Latvia, Lithuania and Norway to build and operate a regional cyber hub that strengthens situational awareness and analytical capacity across the Nordic-Baltic region.As Head of the NBCC, you will be responsible for establishing and leading a new international organisation of strategic importance to both regional and European cybersecurity. While formally employed by the Danish Resilience Agency, you will report to the NBCC Executive Board, composed of senior representatives from the participating national cybersecurity authorities, and operate in close coordination with EU institutions.The position is based in Copenhagen, Denmark.Key responsibilitiesStrategic leadership and governance

  • Provide overall strategic direction and leadership of the NBCC in line with EU objectives, consortium agreements and national mandates.

  • Develop, implement and continuously adjust the NBCC’s strategic roadmap, including the phased build-up from initial deployment to full operational capability.

  • Ensure alignment between the NBCC activities, EU cybersecurity policies and the strategic interests of participating member states.

Management, organisation and budget

  • Act as head of the NBCC organisation, including direct line management of up to eight permanent staff based in Denmark and professional oversight of national analysts located in each participating member state.

  • Build and lead a cohesive multinational organisation with a shared operational culture, while managing differing national frameworks and practices.

  • Ensure sound financial management, reporting and documentation in accordance with EU and national requirements.

Operational responsibility

  • Hold overall responsibility for the NBCC’s operational delivery, including the secure and reliable operation of platforms for cyber threat intelligence sharing, analytical collaboration and communication.

  • Ensure structured and timely sharing of relevant cyber threat information and contribution to regional and European situational awareness.

About youTo succeed in this role, we expect that you:

  • Have proven experience leading multinational or international cooperation involving multiple stakeholders and governance layers; experience from Nordic-Baltic cooperation is a strong advantage.

  • Possess a strong understanding of cyber threat intelligence, incident response ecosystems and information-sharing mechanisms at national and international level.

  • Have demonstrated experience with EU cooperation, preferably including EU-funded projects and engagement with EU institutions.

  • Are able to operate confidently at senior political and administrative levels, nationally and internationally.

  • Can demonstrate strong regional insight and experience, for example from a Nordic or Baltic cybersecurity authority or a comparable organisation.

In addition, you:

  • Exercise strong strategic judgement and are able to balance political, operational and technical considerations.

  • Have excellent leadership and communication skills and are able to build trust across national and organisational boundaries.

  • Are fully proficient in English; knowledge of one or more Nordic or Baltic languages is an advantage. Danish language skills are not required.

About the Danish Resilience AgencyThe Danish Resilience Agency is under the authority of the Danish Ministry for Resilience and Preparedness. The agency is responsible for tasks related to cybersecurity, crisis management, physical security and protection of critical infrastructure.We advise and support authorities, companies and key societal functions in preventing and managing incidents and crises. The agency currently employs approximately 300 staff members working across disciplines in a highly engaged and mission-driven environment.About the NBCCThe NBCC is a Nordic-Baltic cybersecurity cooperation supported by the EU. Through the NBCC, the participating countries jointly establish and operate a regional cyber hub that enhances collective situational awareness and analytical capacity.The NBCC will jointly procure cybersecurity capabilities with the EU, employ analysts in Copenhagen and across the member states, and contribute to the European Cybersecurity Shield. The NBCC is organised as a distinct entity within the Danish Resilience Agency and is accountable to its Executive Board.As Head of the NBCC, you will be responsible for building this organisation from the ground up and for strengthening collective regional resilience against cyber threats.Salary and terms of employmentSalary and terms of employment will depend on qualifications and experience and will be determined in accordance with the collective agreements applicable to employees in the Danish state. The area of employment is the Danish Ministry for Resilience and Preparedness.Employment is conditional on obtaining and maintaining a Danish security clearance at SECRET (DK: HEMMELIGT) level for the duration of employment.The position is a fixed-term appointment for a period of 4 years, with the possibility of extension.The position is full-time 37-hours per week, and the duty station is Holsteinsgade 63, 2100 Copenhagen.To be eligible for employment EU/EEA Citizens are required to obtain an EU residence document as proof of your right to reside and work in Denmark. Non-EU/EEA Citizens must hold a valid residence and work permit before you can begin working in Denmark. Citizens of Sweden, Norway, Finland, or Iceland do not require a residence or work permit to live and work in Denmark. For more detailed information regarding the regulations for your specific citizenship, please visit: New to Denmark and/or Info Norden | Nordisk SamarbejdeIf the position is filled by an applicant not currently residing in Denmark, the Danish Resilience Agency is prepared to offer a relocation package of up to 45.000 DKK. Any other costs related to relocation or housing must be covered by the employee.Are you interested?Please submit your application via the “Apply” button on this page. Your application must be received by the recruitment system no later than 15th November 2026 and must include a CV and relevant diplomas of education.For further information about the position, please contact Kia Slæbæk Jensen at +45 2134 1851 or Morten Bro at +45 2178 4257.All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply regardless of personal background.Applications may be shared with participants from the employment committee from all participating countries.
