title: A position as postdoc (100% time) is vacant at the Research Unit of Child and Adolescent Psychiatry, the Department of Clinical Research, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark. The position is limited to three years.
description:
A position as postdoc (100% time) is vacant at the Research Unit of Child and Adolescent Psychiatry, the Department of Clinical Research, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark. The position is limited to three years. The starting date is 01 February 2027 or later by agreement and depending on the candidate’s preferences.

We are seeking a researcher with documented experience in epidemiological research who can independently plan studies, conduct analyses and write scientific papers. We are looking for a future colleague with a clear academic interest in women’s mental health and the motivation to develop their research in this field. Experience in psychiatric epidemiology is a distinct advantage.

The project

The position is funded by a grant from the Wellcome Trust through PROMIS, an international research project on women’s mental health during perimenopause. The project is in its initial phase and will draw on cohort data linked to national registers, in collaboration with researchers in the UK, the USA and Sweden.

The project investigates risk factors for the onset or recurrence of depression, anxiety, bipolar disorder and psychotic disorders during perimenopause. The work includes epidemiological studies of risk, the development and validation of prediction models, and studies of hormone therapy and mental health outcomes using target trial emulation.

Research tasks

The postdoc will work closely with Principal Investigator Professor Trine Munk-Olsen and the project’s data analyst and participate actively in the international research collaboration. The candidate will have considerable scope to shape research questions, the structure of individual studies, study designs and methodological choices within the framework of the project.

The main tasks are to:

  • Plan and conduct epidemiological studies using register and cohort data, including preparing study protocols and analysis plans.

  • Independently perform statistical analyses, interpret results and write scientific papers.

  • Identify risk factors for mental disorders during perimenopause and contribute to the development and validation of prediction models.

  • Contribute to studies using target trial emulation to investigate hormone therapy and mental health outcomes.

  • Together with other project team members, contribute to applications for access to external datasets and to the maintenance, quality assurance, harmonisation and documentation of the datasets used.

  • Participate in subprojects and undertake tasks within the international collaboration, including coordination, organising project meetings and following up on joint agreements.

The position will involve limited travel. It is primarily research-oriented. Teaching and supervision duties may be included, depending also on the candidate’s interests and preferences.

Expectations of qualifications

The applicant who is hired must have a Ph.D. degree in epidemiology, health sciences, biostatistics or data science with a strong focus on health. Candidates who have not yet completed their Ph.D. may apply if they expect to obtain the degree by the starting date. However, we envisage that, in addition to their Ph.D., the candidate will have at least 1–2 years of research-related experience, for example as a postdoc, research assistant or statistician.

The applicant must have the following qualifications:

  • A clear academic interest in research on women’s mental health, including the relationships between reproductive life stages and mental disorders.

  • First authorship of several scientific papers, including documented experience in epidemiological research based on register or cohort data.

  • Documented experience with advanced epidemiological and statistical methods.

  • Documented experience and competence in statistical programming, for example in R or Stata.

  • A documented ability to independently plan studies, prepare study protocols, conduct analyses and write scientific papers.

  • Good collaboration skills and the ability to take responsibility for tasks and contribute constructively to joint research projects.

  • The ability to work systematically with data quality, documentation and the maintenance of research data.

  • Fluency in written and spoken English.

The following would be an advantage but are not requirements:

  • Experience in psychiatric epidemiology.

  • Experience in the development or validation of prediction models.

  • Practical experience with target trial emulation.

  • Experience in international research collaborations.

  • Written and spoken Danish, as Danish is the working language of the research unit.

Research environment

The position is based in the Research Unit of Child and Adolescent Psychiatry, a growing, dynamic and collaborative research environment at the Department of Clinical Research, University of Southern Denmark. Our research group brings together expertise in psychiatry, psychology, epidemiology and public health. We offer a friendly, inclusive and interdisciplinary working environment where early-career researchers are supported in developing their academic and professional skills. The unit leads several major research projects focusing on perinatal mental health, child and adolescent psychiatry, and early intervention and prevention.

Research strategy for OUH and the Department of Clinical Research

The joint research strategy for the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital sets the direction for our shared research efforts in the years ahead. Rooted in the vision –We conduct research together to shape the patient care of the future – it focuses in particular on: cross-disciplinary research – with people at the centre; strong research environments – as drivers of development; and the research journey – from idea to impact. Further information on the joint research strategy of the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital is available here.

Further information 

For further information please contact Professor Trine Munk-Olsen, e-mail: tmun@sdu.dk, phone: +45 24 46 62 97.

Interviews

The position as Postdoc is placed within salary steps 4–8 of the Danish state salary scale, depending on seniority. In addition, a centrally agreed postdoc allowance is paid, and further qualification- and function-related allowances may be negotiated.

description:

title: Experienced High Voltage Specialist wanted for Bravida El-Infrastruktur Øst
description:
Do you have at least three years of high voltage experience? At Bravida, you will install circuit breakers, disconnectors and switchboards and help build substations. Here, you will put your experience to use on critical electrical infrastructure projects that help secure Denmark’s power supply and support the green transition.

On behalf of Bravida El-Infrastruktur Øst, Career | a JKS Company is recruiting experienced High Voltage Specialists for projects across Zealand and Lolland-Falster.

Bravida El-Infrastruktur Øst has secured the framework agreement with Energinet, becoming a regular supplier of high voltage installation work across Zealand and Lolland-Falster. With this agreement and a strong order book, Bravida is expanding the department. You will join the team responsible for building, expanding, refurbishing and maintaining the infrastructure that the power grid of the future relies on.

Installation and construction of high voltage installationsYou will work at substations and other high voltage installations, putting your experience into practice. You will take responsibility for your own tasks and work alongside your team to deliver safe, high-quality work.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Installing and replacing circuit breakers, disconnectors and other substation components

  • Carrying out cable work and working on earthing systems

  • Working on switchboards, electrical installations and dismantling tasks

  • Contributing to the construction, refurbishment and maintenance of high voltage installations

  • Carrying out quality assurance and maintaining documentation

Over time, you will also share your knowledge by helping apprentices and new colleagues get to grips with their tasks.

You bring solid high voltage experience and take responsibilityYou are a qualified electrician or have an equivalent electrical qualification, with at least three years of hands-on experience in high voltage work. You are familiar with the tasks described and comfortable working independently. You take initiative, recognise what needs doing and understand that safety is integral to every task.

We are looking for someone who:

  • Works independently and takes a structured approach

  • Takes responsibility for the safety and quality of their work

  • Is proactive, well-presented and works well with others

  • Is physically fit and comfortable with hands-on work outdoors and at height

  • Holds a category B driving licence and can provide a criminal record certificate

You must be able to communicate clearly in English and have a valid work permit for Denmark.

A company vehicle to take home and no on-call dutiesAt Bravida, you will join a team of skilled, dedicated technicians who take pride in their work.

title: Associate Professor in Public Health: Children and Young People
description:
At the National Institute of Public Health (NIPH), University of Southern Denmark (SDU), a position as Associate Professor in Public Health is hereby advertised with a focus on interdisciplinary, qualitative studies of children’s and young people’s health and well-being, commencing on 15 April 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.About your future research environment  

The National Institute of Public Health (NIPH) is part of the University of Southern Denmark and is located in Copenhagen. As a national public health institute, we conduct research to improve public health in Denmark and Greenland. At the same time, we contribute internationally to the development of knowledge, theories and methods in the field of public health.

We offer an inspiring research environment in the heart of Copenhagen with skilled and dedicated colleagues from diverse research and educational backgrounds. Here, you will have the opportunity for academic exchange and further development of your own research areas, as well as participation in national and international networks. The position is anchored in the research group Health Promotion and Interventions, which conducts research on interventions addressing public health issues and works with methodological and theoretical challenges related to the design and evaluation of intervention and implementation studies. Our research concerns children, young people and families, as well as vulnerable and disadvantaged groups, and takes place in a range of settings, including daycare institutions, primary and lower secondary schools, upper secondary education, the healthcare system, municipal services, supermarkets and local communities.  You will actively participate in the daily activities of the research group and work closely with other researchers at NIPH.  

The duties include research, teaching and dissemination within the institute’s areas of expertise, including:  - Children’s and young people’s health, well-being and everyday life- The significance of digital media for children’s and young people’s lives and health- Health promotion and implementation research in daycare institutions, schools and upper secondary education- Interdisciplinary, practice-oriented research and development projects, including process evaluation- Advanced qualitative methods, including ethnography, interviews, focus groups and child-centred approaches- Teaching and supervision at bachelor’s and master’s level, including qualitative methods, children’s and young people’s health, and implementation- Preparation of applications for external funding as well as project management and coordination- Contributions to the further development of the research environment, including method development and research group activities The following qualifications are highly valued:  You have established yourself as a qualified researcher within qualitative methods, children’s and young people’s health, and intervention and implementation research, and you possess strong research and teaching qualifications at a high level. You have a relevant publication profile and extensive experience in disseminating research to researchers, practitioners, and other target groups. You have broad collaborative networks and experience in research collaboration with practitioners. As a person, you are dedicated and possess strong communication skills. You are able to build trusting relationships with students, colleagues, and external partners alike. As a teacher, you communicate up-to-date, relevant knowledge in an engaging, clear and understandable way, and as a supervisor you are skilled, inspiring, and supportive.  Qualifications  - A PhD degree in Public Health, Education, Sociology, Anthropology or a related field- Experience with intervention and implementation research- Documented experience in research on children’s and young people’s health- A strong profile within qualitative research- Experience in collaborating with practitioners, exchanging knowledge and disseminating research- Experience in national and international research collaboration- Documented teaching experience at university level and experience supervising students (e.g. bachelor’s or master's students)- Proficiency in Danish and English at a high level, both orally and in writing- Documented experience with scientific publications within relevant research areas 

Further information regarding the position can be obtained from:  Research Leader Susan Andersen,  mailto:suan@sdu.dk

Terms and conditions of employment  Appointment as an Associate Professor is for a fixed term of three years, commencing on 15 April 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.Appointment to the position will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state with the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for associate professor as described herein. Please check links for more information on salary (only available in Danish) and taxation.

The person employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a self-organiser.

The assessment and evaluation processShortlisting may be used in the assessment process. Please note that only shortlisted applicants will receive an assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU. Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee and the shortlisted applicants will receive the part of the evaluation that concerns them. The committee may request additional information, and if so, it is the responsibility of the applicants to provide the necessary material. Interviews and tests may form part of the overall assessment carried out by the appointment committee.  Based on information from the entire recruitment process, the Head of Institute will decide which applicant is offered the position. 

The application

Applicants are encouraged to read the information "How to apply" before applying. 

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include:

  • Motivated application

  • Curriculum vitae

  • Master’s degree and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (copy of original + verified English translation)

  • Teaching portfolio

  • Research plan, including an account of your own research and preferably a vision for future research 

  • A complete list of publications

  • Up to six of the most relevant publications. Please attach one PDF file per publication. In cases of co-authorship, a co-author declaration must be submitted as part of the PDF file.

  • Reference letters/references may also be included

  • A statement of other qualifications relevant to the position.

We request files in pdf-format no more than 5 MB per file. All pdf-files must be unlocked and allow merging and may not be password protected. Documents should not contain a CPR number (civil registration number) – in this case, the CPR number must be crossed out.

UPLOAD GUIDE: Motivated application shall be uploaded as ‘Cover letter’, Curriculum Vitae shall be uploaded as ‘CV’. All other documents shall be uploaded as ‘Miscellaneous documents’.

If the application does not meet the requirements mentioned above, the faculty may reject your application without further notice. Applications received after the deadline will neither be considered nor evaluated.

If you experience technical problems, please contact mailto:hcm-support@sdu.dkApplication deadline 18 November 2026 at 23.59 (CET) 

We recommend that as an international applicant, you take the time to visit Work in Denmark where you will find information and facts about moving to, working and living in Denmark, as well as the International Staff Office at SDU.  The University of Southern Denmark wishes to reflect the surrounding society and therefore encourages all qualified candidates, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position.  

About SDU  The University of Southern Denmark was founded to create value for and together with society. Whether our contribution comes in the form of excellent research, innovative solutions, education, or learning, we must make a positive difference to society and contribute to a sustainable future. We do this by nurturing talent and creating the best environments for research and learning. It is therefore crucial that SDU retains, develops, and recruits talented individuals. At the same time, we must ensure consistently high quality in all our activities, which can only be achieved with the right people.  The university’s researchers, teachers, students, managers, and technical-administrative staff constitute the foundation of our success.

title: Assistant Professor in Materials for Power Electronics / Printed Electronics
description:
The cross-border region Denmark-Germany is a powerhouse in industrial electronics. The Centre for Industrial Electronics (CIE) at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) was established by a strong partnership between industry, academia and regional authorities. CIE is located at the campus of SDU Sønderborg and surrounded by a vibrant industrial environment. CIE is part of the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering at the Faculty of Engineering.

 

Job description 

We are seeking an innovative and visionary Assistant Professor to join the Centre for Industrial Electronics in Sønderborg. The Centre currently has 40 staff, including full and associate professors, assistant professors, postdoctoral researchers, PhD students, and support staff. Funding has been secured to support to establish new research and test laboratories in key areas of industrial electronics. Our ambition is to deliver excellence in research, innovation, and education.

It is our vision that the Centre for Industrial Electronics at SDU will excel in areas of key relevance for companies in the region of Southern Denmark and beyond. 

Candidates are thus required to have a proven research records at least one of the following fields:

  • General power electronics and its reliability

  • Multimaterial additive manufacturing

  • Printed electronics

  • Polymer composites and nanocomposites for energy applications

  • Surface and interface engineering

  • Dielectric materials and capacitor technology

  • Materials for power electronics

  • Energy-device manufacturing

  • Sustainable and circular electronics

 

Qualifications

The candidates must have a PhD in Electrical Engineering/Materials science/Mechanical engineering, or a closely related discipline. 

We also expect:

  • An outstanding research and publication track record 

  • Experience with industrial collaboration

  • Research experience in multi-material additive manufacturing of functional polymer composites

  • Experience developing polymer nanocomposite dielectrics and thin-film capacitors

  • Knowledge of nanoparticle surface modification, dispersion, and interface engineering

  • Hands-on experience in materials processing, device fabrication, and electrical characterization

  • Ability to investigate relationships between material structure, manufacturing conditions, and electrical performance

  • Peer-reviewed publications in functional materials, additive manufacturing, or energy-device research

  • Experience collaborating across materials science and electrical engineering.

Further desirable qualifications:

  • Experience with bio-based, self-healing, or temperature-resistant capacitor materials

  • Knowledge of scalable thin-film fabrication, including layer-by-layer deposition or coating.

  • Experience translating research into industrial applications, particularly embedded heating, sensing, or battery-conditioning systems.

  • Experience preparing research proposals, securing research resources, and training students.

 

Contact and further information

For information about the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical engineering, which encompasses SDU Electrical Engineering please see https://www.sdu.dk/en/ime.

For specific information on section and centre, please visit www.sdu.dk/ee and www.sdu.dk/cie. 

You are also welcome to contact the Head of the CIE, Professor Thomas Ebel (ebel@sdu.dk,  +45 93 50 72 05) for further information. 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

A panel will assess the qualification of the candidate for the described post based on the submitted material. 

The application should include:

  • Curriculum Vitae.

  • Motivated application. 

  • Ideas for research and development activities.

  • Account of significant contributions to innovation in Electrical Engineering and Industrial Engineering Electronics.

  • Complete list of publications.

  • Publications most relevant to the position. 

  • Summary and documentation of teaching experience, including account of experience in training students and outreach. You may attach a Teaching Portfolio. 

  • Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation). 

  • References/reference letters may also be included.

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included. 

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is November 15, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment terms

Appointment as an assistant professor is temporary and for an initial 3-year period, and the position is open from start of 2027.

During employment, the assistant professor will complete the Lecturer Training Programme. 

Employment as an assistant professor requires academic qualifications at a minimum of PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for assistant professor as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

 

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

title: Student Assistant in our Control Center - night shift position
description:
Nordic RCC is looking for candidates with a technical background and interest in the role as operator in our control center – is this something for you?

Do you like working by firm and well-defined procedures, yet alert to interfere in the process when needed? Are you open-minded and enjoy working in a diverse and international team? And are you eager to be part of something new and meaningful?

The position will mainly cover the operator position during the shift from 21.00 PM- 07.15 AM during both weekdays, weekends and holiday periods. The shifts, of individually 10.25 hours length, are distributed throughout the operator team. The schedule is planned and updated 3 times a year, securing at least a planned period of 4 months into the future. You can expect an average of around 70-80 working hours per month.

You will be working alone in the office during the shifts, with an on-call colleague standby to assist in any technical matters if needed.

If you can say yes to the above, then you may be just the person we are looking for.

Join Nordic RCC, a fast-developing company determined to make a significant impact in the energy sector and to provide for a secure and efficient transition to the green, sustainable energy system.

Nordic RCC – supporting security of supply and the green transition

Nordic RCC provides calculations and recommendations to the four Nordic Electricity Transmission System Operators (TSOs), Energinet, Fingrid, Statnett and Svenska Kraftnät. The main aim of the services is to ensure transparency and help the TSOs with operational planning to ensure continued security of supply with an increase of renewables in the system. In short: We play a small but important part of enabling the green transition.

You will join a team of young, diverse, and enthusiastic colleagues of currently more than 20 nationalities, and at times work in virtual teams with expert colleagues from the Nordic TSOs and potentially from all of Europe.

We are not looking for a specific educational background, but an engineering or similar technical or data-scientific background is preferred.

Whether you are in your bachelor’s program, or master’s degree program, that is not critically important. What is more important is your profile as a whole and how you are assessed to fit within the Nordic RCC organization.   

Key responsibilities for the operator role will be:

  • Participating in the 24/7 control center shift roster: mainly covering the night hours 21.00 - 07.15.

  • The shift starts in the control center relieving a colleague operator from the evening shift. When time allows, and the processes for the evening have finalized successfully, you have an opportunity to enter an adjacent resting facility. During the shift, when alerted, your responsibility is to enter the control center within minutes, intervening in the operational challenge faced. Next morning at 07.00, the morning operator will relieve you from your shift responsibility.

  • Become an expert in executing the services provided from the 24/7 Nordic RCC control center.

  • Maintaining your qualifications and knowledge in the operator control systems, including through routinely joining parallel shift during office hours to train in all NRCC services under the guidance of operators.

  • Interface to the Nordic TSOs control centers.  

  • Cooperation with the TSOs securing the process of services.

  • Trouble shooting and fixing challenges in the services together with NRCC IT support.

  • KPI recording and reporting, weekly and monthly.

  • Aid the back-office operators in small tasks, such as visit approval to the core room.

Additional tasks and involvement

Depending on the flexibility and the competence of the candidate, together with the department needs, there will be an opportunity to be involved in other areas of responsibility. This way one will get a better understanding of the NRCC in general and meet fellow NRCC colleagues during normal business hours.

Other working areas, depending on department needs, can be:

  • Involvement in testing system updates and features to be introduced to the control center.

  • Quality assurance and updating operational procedures.

  • Quality assurance and data retrieval for operational reporting.

  • Provide analytical insights on operational planning scenarios.

You are open-minded, international mindset and excellence at working within structured patterns, at the same time the ability to maneuver within a huge spectrum of corner cases quickly, reliably, and independently.

You are structured and can appreciate a fast-paced environment from time to time. On a personal level you are open-minded, team-oriented and take responsibility.

Nordic RCC is an international office, so fluency in spoken and written English is required as well as a motivation for working in an international environment.

You will join a diverse and enthusiastic team in our office at Copenhagen Towers, Ørestad. Nordic RCC is home to over twenty nationalities, with a healthy gender balance and a wide range of ages and backgrounds. We value curiosity, fellowship, respect, and transparency—and we hope you see yourself in these values. 

Your daily workplace will be in the NRCC control center at the office premises in Copenhagen Towers, Ørestad.

Application deadline and contact information

Please apply online as soon as possible (in English) and no later than November 15th 2026.

To ensure a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly request that you do not include photographs in your CVs or application materials.

A cover letter is not required, but we kindly ask you to include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are interested in the position. Applications are only accepted through our online recruitment system.  

Note that as part of the recruitment process, the candidate must undergo a satisfactory background check. The position is also conditioned upon a national security clearance. Both will be facilitated by Nordic RCC. You can read more on security clearance here. Please also note that the process includes that any spouse, registered partner, cohabitant, steady partner, co-resident, child over 18 living at home and parent with the same address as the candidate must also consent to be examined.   Nordic RCC is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. 

If you have any questions, please contact Kenneth Nielsen, Head of Service Operations, KEN@nordic-rcc.net

title: Tenure track assistant professor/Associate professor positions in Veterinary medicine
employer: Technical Sciences - Institut for Husdyr- og Veter
description:
The Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences (ANIVET) is seeking three new staff members for teaching and research in veterinary medicine. The positions are available from 1 August 2027 or soon thereafter.The educational activities for these positions are aimed at students in veterinary medicine at both the bachelor’s and master’s levels.The veterinary medicine programme is organised into courses covering educationally relevant themes and integrates a range of disciplines, and this is done with the vision to create a professional engagement while ensuring scientific depth for the students of veterinary medicine.ANIVET is part of the Faculty of Technical Sciences at Aarhus University. The department is located near Viborg (Campus AU Viborg – Research Centre Foulum) and encompasses five research units with approximately 200 dedicated employees of which 50% are scientific staff. The AU Viborg campus will gradually grow to a student population of 800 – 900. The positions will be integrated into the department’s existing scientific research units, in which scientists at all career stages work together with skilled technical staff such as laboratory technicians and data analysts.The positions
  1. Clinical veterinary science – livestock
  2. Veterinary public health
  3. Veterinary pathology
If you wish to apply for more than one position, please apply for each position separately. Please read more down below in “How to apply”.1. Tenure track assistant professor or Associated Professor in Clinical veterinary science – livestockWe are seeking a candidate with a clinical background in veterinary science within production animals - Livestock.Research tasksThe focus of the position is to:
  • Perform clinical veterinary science within production animals, with emphasis on individual or group-level animal diagnostics, clinical decision-making, and evidence-based treatment and prevention strategies.
  • Research in major production diseases in cattle and/or pigs of significant importance in Europe, including development of clinically applicable knowledge and tools supporting veterinary decision-making in practice.
  • Integrate clinical findings with herd-level data to improve disease prevention and health management in modern production systems.
Within his/her area of expertise, it is expected that in addition the candidate will:
  • Conduct research-based advisory work for authorities and have an active role in externally funded research projects.
  • Contribute to the development and delivery of teaching in clinical veterinary science for production animals, with emphasis on case-based and hands-on learning.
  • Provide academic leadership within the clinical production animal field, including mentoring and coordination of junior teaching staff (e.g., assistant lecturers/teaching assistants).
  • Contribute to strengthening collaboration with the veterinary profession and industry stakeholders in Denmark.
Your profileThe preferred candidate should demonstrate:
  • The ability to independently conduct research within veterinary clinical science related to pig or cattle production
  • Danish authorization as a veterinarian or can achieve it
  • Preferably experiences within obstetrics
2. Tenure track assistant professor or Associated Professor in Veterinary Public HealthWe are seeking a candidate with strong expertise in veterinary public health, including popu-lation-level animal health, food safety/meat inspection, and the role of veterinarians in society.Research tasksThe focus of the position is to:
  • Conduct research within veterinary public health, including epidemiology, zoonoses, food safety/meat inspection, disease dynamics, risk assessment or animal welfare.
  • Contribute to interdisciplinary One Health research integrating animal, human and environmental health on population level.
  • Support evidence-based policy and advisory work for authorities.
  • Participate in externally funded research projects.
Within his/her area of expertise, it is expected that in addition the candidate will:
  • Develop and deliver teaching in Veterinary Public Health for example to apply case-based and problem-oriented teaching methods with focus on real-world scenarios in veterinary services.
  • Do research within monitoring of animal welfare issues across the EU.
  • Contribute to teaching across the veterinary curriculum where public health perspectives are relevant.
Your profileThe preferred candidate should demonstrate:
  • The ability to independently conduct research within veterinary public health preferably with an interdisciplinary research profile integrating biological, social and economic aspects in projects
  • Danish authorization as a veterinarian or can achieve it. Experience with Danish conditions is an advantage.
  • Preferably, experience with antimicrobial use at the population level.
3. Tenure track assistant professor or Associated Professor in Veterinary PathologyWe are seeking a candidate with a broad background in veterinary pathology, encompassing both gross and histopathological examinations for diagnostic purposes with a strong interest in developing and innovating teaching within veterinary pathology.Research tasksThe focus of the position is:
  • General and comparative veterinary pathology, including the mechanisms, diagnosis, and characterization of disease processes across animal species.
  • Diagnostic pathology, encompassing post-mortem investigations, histopathology, and the integration of pathological findings into veterinary practice and meat inspection.
  • Pathological assessment of animal welfare aspects of mortality in livestock
Within his/her area of expertise, it is expected that in addition the candidate will:
  • Teach and supervise students and early-career researchers at bachelor, master, and PhD levels.
  • Conduct research-based advisory work for authorities and have an active role in externally funded research projects.
  • Contribute to the collection and curation of pathological specimens for teaching purposes and reporting of findings to referring veterinarians and animal owners.
  • Contribute to the continued development of the department's digital histopathology teaching platform, TUTOR.
  • Support in the administration and further development of the department's animal donor programme for anatomy and pathology.
Your profileThe preferred candidate should have experience with:
  • Post-mortem examinations, including diagnostic necropsies, case reporting, and communication of findings.
  • Diagnostic histopathology.
Your profle as Tenure Track assistant professorYou are a skilled researcher with a solid background within your specific field of research, and you possess:
  • Documented research qualifications at a high international level
  • Teaching and supervision experience
  • Qualifications for the Tenure-Track assistant professor level at Aarhus University must include postdoctoral training or similar with a relevant research profile and a strong scientific publication record in one or more of the areas of the position you are applying for.
Please refer to the tenure track guidelines for the tenure review criteria and for the tenure review process.Your profile as Associate professorYou are established as a prominent researcher within your specific field of research, and you possess:
  • The ability to carry out independent and well-organized research work, as well as work as part of an interdisciplinary team.
  • Documented teaching qualifications at a high international level.
  • Experience with project management
In order to be assessed as qualified as associate professor, you must meet the academic criteria as outlined hereHow to apply
  • You must indicate the specific position you are applying for by selecting it in the menu. You may only select one position. If you wish to apply for one of the other positions, you must submit a separate application for each position.
  • Please also indicate in your written application which position you are applying for.
  • Furthermore, please indicate whether you are applying for a tenure-track assistant professor position, an associate professor position, or both by ticking the box. .
Who we areThe Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences is well-known for its skilled and very innovative interdisciplinary research environments with a high international impact. We perform world-class research, which contributes with solutions to address essential societal challenges within the green transition; the food production and veterinary medicine – nationally and globally.The department generates novel research at the highest international level within sustainable food production, the environment, climate, and the health and welfare for animals and humans. The activities form the basis for our research-based public authority consultancy and degree programmes covering bachelor’s, master’s and PhD degree programmes within animal science and veterinary medicine. We offer a lively, engaged and innovative learning and study environment, which is closely integrated with the research environment.Our department has unique and advanced animal experimental research facilities and technologies located close to the research environment, and a comprehensive national and international research network and strong industrial and professional collaborations.What we offer
  • A well-developed research infrastructure, laboratories and access to shared equipment and animal experimental facilities.
  • An informal and multicultural research environment with high professionalism and close collaboration and networking activities.
  • A workplace characterised by equality and a good work-life balance, and open discussions across different fields of research.
Living in DenmarkPlease visit the international staff https://internationalstaff.au.dk/prearrival/ for information about arriving to and living in Denmark for both the applicants and their potential families.Area of employment and place of workThe area of employment is Aarhus University (AU), with related departments The place of work is AU Viborg, Research Centre Foulum, Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences, Blichers Allé 20, DK-8830 Tjele.AU Viborg is approximately 10 km from Viborg. You can read more about it here: https://international.viborg.dk/ContactFor further information, please contact Deputy head of department, Professor Henrik Callesen (henrik.callesen@anivet.au.dk)or Head of department, Professor Charlotte Lauridsen (charlotte.lauridsen@anivet.au.dk)Technical Sciences Tenure TrackAarhus University offers talented scientists from around the world attractive career perspectives via the Technical Sciences Tenure Track Programme. Highly qualified candidates are appointed as Assistant Professors for a period of six years with the prospect of performance- based advancement to a tenured Associate Professorship. The aim of the Technical Sciences Tenure Track Programme is to:
  • attract outstanding talented individuals that are competitive at an international level
  • to promote the early development of independent research success early in the career of scientists
  • to create transparency in the academic career path
As part of the tenure track position, the candidate is offered:
  • access to research infrastructure
  • capability development, including postgraduate teacher training
  • a mentoring programme
  • support to develop scientific networks and to secure interdisciplinary research at the highest level
As part of the Aarhus University Tenure Track Programme, the University carries out a mid-way evaluation to review the progress of the tenure track candidate after three years, according to the same criteria used in the final tenure review. The final tenure review is conducted after five and a half years. If the review is positive, the candidate will be offered a tenured position as Associate Professor at Aarhus University.Please refer to the tenure track guidelines for the tenure review criteria and for the tenure review process.Application procedureShortlisting is used. This means that after the deadline for applications – and with the assistance from the assessment committee chairman, and the assessment committee if necessary, – the head of department selects the candidates to be evaluated. The selection is made on the basis of an assessment of who of the candidates are most relevant considering the requirements of the advertisement. All applicants will be notified within 6 weeks whether or not their applications have been sent to an expert assessment committee for evaluation. The selected applicants will be informed about the composition of the committee and will receive his/her assessment. Read the full text and apply online

title: Senior AI Engineer (image & video generation)
description:
Working language: English (Estonian not required). Remote; Tallinn optional.

Work tasks: MyArchitectAI is AI rendering software for architects and interior designers. Users upload a design and get a photorealistic render in seconds that keeps their geometry and materials. Then they can swap materials, change lighting and objects, upscale, or turn the still into a video. We're a small founder-led team and we move fast. Our working language is English. We're looking for an engineer who rapidly turns promising image- and video-generation techniques into evaluated, shipped MyArchitectAI features. This is hands-on product building: not pure research, and not a pure inference/infrastructure job. - In your first 30 days you ship a meaningful improvement, scoped with a founder: a new AI capability, a quality or speed gain, an evaluation system, or automation of manual work. You back it with visual examples and numbers. - By 60 days you find an opportunity yourself (new models, user data, weak spots in our pipeline), propose it and ship it. - By 90 days you have three or more shipped contributions and own the loop: find → evaluate → build → validate → ship → learn. - You keep a clear view of new models, techniques and competitors without chasing novelty for its own sake.

We offer: - Working directly with the founders, with real impact on the product.- GPU access. - Remote work; Tallinn optional. - Employment contract or contractor agreement, as you prefer. - English is our working language; Estonian is not required. - Salary negotiable.

Other requirements: You have:- Hands-on work with generative image or video models (not only LLMs, RAG or agents). - At least one shipped product, deployed feature, meaningful open-source contribution, or convincing end-to-end project, and you can say exactly what you built. - Experience running experiments and making quality vs. speed vs. cost decisions. - The engineering skills to take a notebook or demo into a real product (Python, production-quality code). - Good written English (our working language). Estonian is not required. Nice to have: Diffusers, ComfyUI, ControlNet-style conditioning, inpainting and editing, LoRA and fine-tuning, video models, upscaling; your own evaluation datasets or benchmarks; GPU deployment and optimisation; 3D, AEC, CAD, rendering or interiors; public code, demos, models or write-ups.

Option to work from home: Yes

title: Breakfast Cook
description:
Work tasks: Kolm Õde boutique hotel (Pikk 71, Tallinn Old Town) is looking for a breakfast chef to join our team. Our breakfast is a buffet focused on Estonian produce and bread and pastries baked on site, and it is open to guests of the hotel and our apartments as well as to outside visitors. Your main duties: - preparing hot and cold breakfast dishes (egg dishes, porridges, hot sides, salads, cold cuts, smoked fish, etc.); - baking bread, buns and morning pastries on site; - setting up the buffet before opening and keeping it replenished during breakfast; - taking care of the taste, freshness and attractive presentation of the food; - preparing for the next day (doughs, prep work, etc.); - monitoring stock, preparing orders and receiving deliveries; - following food hygiene and self-monitoring (HACCP) requirements, checking temperatures and shelf life; - keeping the kitchen, equipment and tools clean and in order; - working closely with the breakfast server and reception, and helping develop the menu. You are responsible for making sure every morning starts with a tasty, fresh and beautifully presented breakfast for our guests.

We offer: - Work in a unique setting: Kolm Õde boutique hotel is housed in three medieval merchant houses in the heart of Tallinn Old Town.- The opportunity to bring your own ideas to the menu. - Morning working hours – your evenings stay free. - Work uniform. - A small, friendly team and international guests. - A central location that is easy to reach by public transport.

Other requirements: - Previous experience as a cook (experience with breakfast service, hotel kitchens or baking is a big plus). - Valid health certificate (tervisetõend). - Willingness to work early mornings, as well as on Saturdays and Sundays. - Cleanliness, accuracy, independence and good time management. - A desire to cook tasty, beautifully presented food and to help develop our new breakfast concept.

Option to work from home: No

title: Müügiassistent
description:
Rootsi keele oskusega müügiassistent

Tööülesanded: Agent Triin otsib oma kliendi Bellus Furniture’i meeskonda rootsi keele oskusega müügiassistenti. Sinu koostööpartnerid on Rootsi mööblikauplused, kaupluseketid ja Belluse sealsed müügiagendid – paljud neist pikaajalised partnerid. Sinu peamised ülesanded: • suhtled äriklientide ja müügiagentidega rootsi keeles telefoni ning e-posti teel; • sisestad ja kontrollid müügitellimusi ning küsid vajalikke täpsustusi; • vahendad tellimustega seotud infot klientide, kontori ja tootmise vahel; • aitad lahendada tarne- ja tooteküsimusi ning käsitled reklamatsioone. Hommikuti keskendud tavaliselt tellimustele, päeva jooksul lisandub jooksev kliendisuhtlus. See on klienditeeninduse ja müügitoe roll. Aktiivset müüki ega lõpptarbijate teenindamist töö ei sisalda.

Omalt poolt pakume: Võimalust kasutada rootsi keelt igapäevases töös ning hoida suhteid Belluse pikaajaliste Rootsi koostööpartneritega.• Põhjalikku sisseelamist kolleegide ja mentori toel. Mööblivaldkonna, toodete ja tööprogrammide tundmine ei ole eeltingimus – need õpid selgeks kohapeal. • Kogenud meeskonna tuge, kellega saad arutada ka keerulisemaid kliendiküsimusi. • Vaheldusrikast tööd, kus tellimuste haldamine vaheldub suhtlemise ja lahenduste leidmisega. • Võimalust korraldada oma tööd iseseisvalt ning teha ettepanekuid igapäevase koostöö parandamiseks. • Kindlat töörütmi esmaspäevast reedeni. Eelistatud töökoht on Haljalas, kus asuvad Belluse põhikontor, tehas ja suurem osa klienditeeninduse tiimist. Tööaeg on kell 8.00–16.30. Sobiva kandidaadi puhul on võimalik töötada Tallinna kontoris aadressil Tatari 25–205, käies regulaarselt Haljalas. Lähtekoht on üks päev nädalas, täpne korraldus lepitakse kokku. Tallinna kontori tööaeg on kell 8.30–17.00. Tegemist on täistööajaga kontoritööga. Oodatud oled ka siis, kui kaalud karjääripööret või naased tööturule.

Muud nõuded: Valdad hästi rootsi keelt kõnes ja kirjas ning oskad eesti ja inglise keelt igapäevaseks koostööks.Suhtled julgelt ja väljendad end selgelt, nii telefonis kui ka kirjalikult. Oled täpne ja analüüsivõimeline - märkad detaile, seostad infot ja mõtled lahendused läbi. Oled algatusvõimeline ja vastutustundlik - korraldad oma tööd iseseisvalt ning pead kokkulepetest kinni. Väärtustad koostööd ja head teenindust ning säilitad keerulises olukorras rahuliku ja konstruktiivse suhtumise. Tahad õppida ja oled valmis omandama uusi teadmisi ning töövõtteid. Varasem klienditeeninduse, tellimuste haldamise, müügitoe või logistika kogemus tuleb kasuks. Mööblivaldkonna ja tööprogrammide tundmine ei ole eeltingimus - need õpid selgeks kolleegide ja mentori toel. Oled oodatud ka siis, kui kaalud karjääripööret või naased tööturule.

title: Servicerådgivare till Mariehamn
description: **Job ID: 6971**Till vårt kontor i Mariehamn söker vi nu en Servicerådgivare som vill vara en del av vårt härliga team. Vill du ha ett jobb där ditt driv för service gör verklig skillnad i människors vardag? Vill du vara med och bidra till våra kunders framtidsplaner genom förstklassig service?Vi ser fram emot att träffa dig som har en naturlig talang för att skapa varma relationer och se affärsmöjligheter i varje samtal. Hos oss på Nordea blir du en nyckelperson. Du är bankens ansikte utåt och den som ser till att våra kunder får en fantastisk upplevelse. Med ditt engagemang och din passion för att överträffa kundernas förväntningar bidrar du till att skapa framtidens relationsbank.**Om vårt team**Välkommen till Nordea Daily Banking Mariehamn, ett härligt team som präglas av en stark vinnarkultur med fokus på resultat. Vi sätter höga mål, men vi når dem tillsammans, vi hjälper, stöttar och firar varandras framgångar. Hos oss möter vi kunderna där det passar dem bäst: både fysiskt på kontoret, i telefon och i våra digitala kanaler.Collaboration, Ownership, Passion och Courage är värderingar som vägleder oss i hur vi arbetar och hur vi fattar beslut och som vi tror att du delar med oss!**Vad du kommer att göra**Som Servicerådgivare är du ofta kundens första kontakt och spelar därmed en avgörande roll i att skapa positiva kundupplevelser, underlätta i deras vardag samt att hitta nya affärsmöjligheter. Du guidar kunderna rätt bland bankens tjänster, produkter och smarta digitala verktyg.**Dina viktigaste fokusområden:**- Skapa hög tillgänglighet, tillit och kundnöjdhet tillsammans med dina kollegor, med sikte på att lösa kundens ärende direkt i det första mötet. - Ha ett skarpt öga för sälj- och servicemöjligheter genom ett proaktivt arbetssätt. - Du fångar upp kundens behov i samtalet och slussar dem vidare till våra privat- eller företagsrådgivare när det behövs för att bygga långsiktiga relationer. - Aktivt introducera och hjälpa kunderna att använda våra digitala tjänster utifrån deras unika behov. **Vem du är**För att trivas och lyckas i rollen är du en lagspelare med mycket energi och ett genuint intresse för människor.**Vi söker dig som**- Har en naturlig fallenhet för att etablera kontakt och älskar att ge service i världsklass i mötet med både kunder och kollegor. - Triggas av att jobba resultatinriktat och ser det som en rolig utmaning att matcha kundens behov med rätt lösning. - Är nyfiken på ny teknik och trivs med att använda digitala verktyg i kundmötet. - Arbetar aktivt med att utveckla din egen kompetens och bidrar till ett öppet, dynamiskt och positivt klimat i teamet. - Pratar och skriver flytande finska och svenska samt har goda kunskaper i engelska. - Har en godkänd och fullständig gymnasieutbildning. **Vad vi erbjuder**Människor kommer till Nordea när de vill framåt. För somliga innebär det att ta karriären till nästa nivå, för andra att utveckla sin kompetens i en levande miljö – hos oss får du utrymme att växa. professional growth, and contribution to the school community.Teaching and Learning\-Plan progressive units and lessons from the approved PE curriculum and learning outcomes.\-Develop fundamental title: Executive Assistant to the CEO
description: Priority deadline: October 27. Complete the short form at https://forms.office.com/e/AaqXdKeeWn, then email your CV to kimberly@stillart.com with the subject line "EA application, FULL NAME." STILLART · FULL TIME · SOUTHERN FINLAND, WITH WEEKLY TIME IN PERSONFor two decades, StillArt has helped orchestras and arts organizations fill their halls. The company works. What it needs now is someone to protect the mind behind it.A COMPANY ON SOLID GROUND StillArt (Finland) and its associated companies are established and profitable, with about €2 million in annual turnover, a team of four, and two dozen suppliers in a dozen countries. Unique products and clear plans for international growth mean this role grows as the companies do.THE ROLE As Executive Assistant, you guard the CEO's energy, momentum and focus, so his hours go where they are worth the most: winning clients, solving the problems only the CEO can solve, building the brand and starting what comes next. Everything that pulls him out of that zone, you take, and you take it so well he never has to look back. This is not a role for someone who waits for instructions. It is a partnership. You lead the daily rhythm, you arrive with the agenda, and within three months you are anticipating the next move.WHAT YOU WILL OWN This is a role with real ownership. From your first weeks, these are yours: The inbox. You triage, decide and reply, so only what truly needs the CEO reaches him. The calendar. You manage scheduling across the companies in the group, guard focus time and prepare the week ahead. Follow-through. Loose ends close because you close them, with the team, leads and clients. Momentum. You keep notes, actions and the project list moving, so the best ideas actually get implemented. Travel and events. Conferences, flights and hotels arranged to a high standard. Purchases and payments. Handled correctly, within limits the CEO sets. Voice and visibility. Social posts and copy coordinated with the right people. The daily rhythm. A short morning check-in and an end-of-day hand-off that previews tomorrow's one big thing. Planning together. You plan and prioritize alongside the CEO, with more independence as trust grows, and you serve as a sounding board when it is time to decide which ideas earn traction now.WHY THIS ROLE IS SOUGHT AFTER A seat beside the founder. You work directly with the CEO, close enough to shape the company's next chapter. A role built with you. The scope is designed around the person who takes it, and you carry the responsibility to build it. A 90-day path. A structured training program, in three stages, so you are never left guessing how to be impactful.WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR Calm in motion. Steady when plans change fast. Proactive by instinct. You see what needs doing before you are asked. Curious and always learning. New tools, new products, new markets, new ways of working, including AI. The CEO has a voracious appetite for learning. Entrepreneurial at heart. At home in a founder-led company where change moves quickly, and energized by growth. Experienced and discerning. You have run a busy executive's day before, as an executive assistant or in a similar supporting role, and senior team members take you seriously. Strong with people. A real listener who makes a room feel safe. You guide as much as you assist. Trusted with what matters. Discreet with sensitive information, trusted with visibility of company and personal money, and comfortable with finance basics. Careful with detail. You would rather get it right than get it fast. To show us, add the word intern to the last field on the application form. Fluent in Microsoft tools. StillArt runs on Microsoft 365, including Planner, OneDrive, Outlook and Copilot. You work in it with ease and, ideally, help the team get more out of it by showing how our processes can be set up. Warm, with boundaries. Helpful and friendly, and honest about what is sustainable. Culture oriented. You care about the arts and about being of service to arts organizations. Experience in the arts is a plus. At home across languages and cultures. English is a must. German is a strong advantage, as this is StillArt's long term target market. Swedish (the CEO's mother tongue) and Finnish (the dominant language of the home country) are valued, and other languages are welcome as the company grows globally.WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT This role guards the CEO's time. It does not carry the sales pipeline, own bookkeeping or financial modeling, or run operations or manage the team. Those sit in other seats at StillArt.THE DETAILS Employer: StillArt Limited Ab Employment: Employee, full time, Monday to Friday, working roughly 9:00 to 17:00 Helsinki time Target start: Mid-November 2026 Location: Ideally based in Finland, able to meet in person once a week in Porvoo. Candidates living elsewhere in the EU, EEA or Switzerland are encouraged to apply. Working style: Mostly remote, with regular time in person, ideally weekly Salary range: €3,500 to €4,500 gross per month, depending on experience and languages. Open to more for a candidate who clearly shows the added value they bring.HOW TO APPLY Apply through the short form here: https://forms.office.com/e/AaqXdKeeWn. It takes about 10 minutes. After you submit it, please email your CV to kimberly@stillart.com with the role and your full name in the subject line. Example: EA application, FULL NAME. We review applications once both arrive, so early applications are strongly encouraged. Priority deadline: Oct 27. Applications received after that date may still be considered while the role remains open. StillArt is a founder-led firm in Porvoo, Finland that helps orchestras and performing arts organizations grow their audiences and revenue, with clients around the world. Learn more at stillart.com.

title: Kahvilapäällikkö, Relove Café, Helsinki-Vantaan lentoasema
description: Relove on kotimainen perheyritys, second hand -alan pioneeri ja rakastettu lifestyle-brändi, joka yhdistää laadukkaan second hand -myymälän ja tunnelmallisen kahvilan saman katon alle. Reloven maailmassa vastuullisuus, yhteisöllisyys ja ensiluokkainen asiakaskokemus kulkevat käsi kädessä. Liikkeissämme asiakkaat voivat tehdä upeita löytöjä, nauttia herkullisesta ruoasta ja kahvista sekä viettää aikaa inspiroivassa ympäristössä.Etsimme Relove Cafén tiimiin kokenutta, energistä ja innostavaa kahvilapäällikköä vakituiseen ja kokoaikaiseen työsuhteeseen Helsinki-Vantaan lentoasemalle.Kahvilapäällikkönä johdat noin 15-20 hengen tiimiä ja huolehdit siitä, että kahvilan arki toimii sujuvasti, laadukkaasti ja tehokkaasti. Tärkein tehtäväsi on saada ihmiset onnistumaan yhdessä: rakennat hyvää yhteishenkeä, motivoit tiimiä ja varmistat selkeän ja tasapuolisen johtamisen. Tiimiisi kuuluu kahvilatyöntekijöiden lisäksi vuoropäälliköitä ja apulaiskahvilapäälliköitä, joiden työtä ohjaat ja tuet.Roolisi on käytännönläheinen ja operatiivinen. Olet mukana kahvilan päivittäisessä tekemisessä ja vastaat muun muassa toiminnan organisoinnista, resursoinnista, tuotteiden laadusta ja saatavuudesta, tilauksista, varaston ja hävikin hallinnasta sekä erinomaisen asiakaskokemuksen toteutumisesta.Tarjoamme sinulle- Vakituisen ja kokoaikaisen työsuhteen- Monipuolisen ja vastuullisen esihenkilöroolin kansainvälisessä lentoasemaympäristössä- Mahdollisuuden johtaa ja kehittää sekä kahvilan toimintaa että sen työntekijöitä- Kiinteän kuukausipalkan (2 800-3 500 €/kk) kokemuksesi ja osaamisesi huomioiden- Vaihtelevat työajat maanantaista sunnuntaihin kahvilan aukioloaikojen mukaisesti klo 04-22 välillä- Hyvät työsuhde-edut (muun muassa työterveyshuolto, ePassi flex,jopa -50 % alennus Relovessa ja -20 % Rue Madamessa ruoka- ja juomatuotteistaitselle ja pöytäseurueelle)Odotamme sinulta- Vahvaa käytännön kokemusta kahvilaliiketoiminnasta sekä aikaisempaa kokemusta tiimin johtamisesta. Tunnet kiireisen kahvilaympäristön arjen ja osaat organisoida tekemistä, priorisoida sekä ratkaista eteen tulevia tilanteita. Arvostamme erityisesti kokemusta vilkkaista, suuren asiakasvolyymin toimintaympäristöistä sekä muiden esihenkilöiden johtamisesta.- Positiivista, ihmisläheistä ja innostavaa, mutta samalla jämäkkää ja johdonmukaista johtamista. Olet läsnä tiimisi arjessa, annat palautetta ja uskallat tarttua myös haastaviin tilanteisiin rakentavasti. Sinulle on luontevaa johtaa omalla esimerkilläsi ja luoda ympärillesi hyvää tekemisen meininkiä.Tehtävä edellyttää lisäksi- Vahvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa työn luonteen vuoksi, muu kielitaito katsotaan eduksi- Hygienia- ja anniskelupassia- Valmiutta työskennellä vaihtelevasti aikaisin aamulla, iltaisin ja viikonloppuisin- Nuhteetonta taustaa, sillä lentoasemalla työskenteleville teetetään turvallisuusselvitysKuulostaako tämä sinun seuraavalta askeleeltasi? Jos haluat ottaa vastuullesi vauhdikkaan kahvilan arjen ja ennen kaikkea johtaa ihmisiä kohti yhteisiä onnistumisia, haluamme kuulla sinusta hakemuksen muodossa. Lähetä tietosi meille mahdollisimman pian, sillä tehtävä täytetään sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.**Jätäthän hakemuksen hakulomakkeen kautta, sillä emme voi tietoturvasyistä huomioida sähköpostitse jätettyjä hakemuksia. Hakeaksesi avoimia työpaikkoja, sinun tulee luoda työnhakuprofiili Barona Careersiin. Täytät profiilisi vain kerran, minkä jälkeen voit hakea kaikkia Baronan työpaikkoja samalla profiililla.

title: Vik. socialhandledare, Tallbacken
description: Hos oss möter du barn, ungdomar och vuxna i olika livssituationer. Du blir en viktig del av arbetet med att skapa trygghet, skydd och en fungerande vardag för dem som bor hos oss.Tallbacken är ett kombinerat barn- och ungdomshem enligt barnskyddslagen och ett skyddshem för våldsutsatta personer och deras barn. Vi tar emot klienter från hela Åland och erbjuder stöd och omsorg utifrån deras behov och situation.Vi söker dig som är intresserad av ett omväxlande arbete där du möter människor i olika skeden av livet och med olika behov av stöd. Du har lätt för att skapa kontakt, är trygg i mötet med människor i utsatta situationer och kan ta egna initiativ. Du trivs med att arbeta både självständigt och som en del av arbetsgruppen.Tillsammans skapar vi en trygg och hemlik miljö med struktur och omsorg för barn, ungdomar och vuxna i utsatta livssituationer.Som person ser vi att du är ansvarstagande, flexibel, utåtriktad, gillar utmaningar samt har god förmåga att uttrycka dig i både tal och skrift. Du behöver ha lätt för att ta initiativ i kontakten med både klienter, anhöriga samt aktivt samverka med interna och externa samarbetspartner. Vi lägger stor vikt vid personliga egenskaper.Behörighetskravet är för uppgiften är lämplig högskoleexamen inom det sociala området i enlighet med 1 § landskapsförordning (2015:118) om skyddshemspersonal. För arbetet behövs körkort och straffregisterutdrag uppvisas innan anställning.Som stöd i ditt arbete håller vi regelbundna gemensamma arbetsgruppsmöten och erbjuder även extern handledning i grupp. Vår företagshälsovård inkluderar sjukvård på allmänläkarnivå och i friskvårdförmåner ingår massage, kultur och motion.Vikariatets omfattning är 80 %, men det finns goda möjligheter att utöka arbetstiden till 100 % under större delen av anställningstiden. Arbetet är i periodarbete och inleds 25.11.2026 eller enligt överenskommelse. Den uppgiftsrelaterade lönen är 80% av 3 255,24 euro vid formell behörighet, samt eventuella erfarenhetstillägg. Prövotid tillämpas och intervjuer kan ske löpande under ansökningstiden.

title: Aktiviteettipäällikkö Holiday Club Saimaan Rauhaan
description: Tykkäätkö keksiä uutta, innostaa ihmisiä ja saada asioita tapahtumaan? Haluaisitko olla mukana luomassa elämyksiä, jotka tekevät asiakkaidemme lomasta ja vapaa-ajasta entistäkin ikimuistoisemman?Etsimme nyt joukkoomme idearikasta, innostavaa ja toimeen tarttuvaa aktiviteettipäällikköä vastaamaan Holiday Club Saimaan Rauhan aktiviteettien suunnittelusta, kehittämisestä ja toteutuksesta. Tehtävässä johdat omaa tiimiäsi, kehität palvelutarjontaa sekä vastaat aktiviteettien vetovoimasta ja kannattavuudesta. Osallistut myös käytännön tekemiseen arjen toiminnassa. Tarjoamme vakituisen ja kokoaikaisen tehtävän.TehtävästäAktiviteettipäällikkönä vastaat Saimaan Rauhan aktiviteettikokonaisuudesta sekä aktiviteettitiimin esihenkilötyöstä. Tehtävässä yhdistyvät liikunta- ja elämyspalveluiden kehittäminen, ihmisten johtaminen, käytännön tekeminen sekä liiketoiminnallinen vastuu.Etsimme henkilöä, jolla on kokemusta palveluliiketoiminnan kehittämisestä ja esihenkilötyöstä. Sinulla on liikunta-alan osaamista ja ymmärrystä hyvinvointiin, liikuntaan ja aktiiviseen vapaa-aikaan liittyvien palveluiden suunnittelusta ja ohjaamisesta. Innostut uusien ideoiden kehittämisestä, osaat motivoida ihmisiä ja luoda mieleenpainuvia kokemuksia erilaisille ja eri-ikäisille asiakasryhmille.Liikunta ja hyvinvointi ovat tärkeä osa työnkuvaasi, mutta meillä aktiviteetit tarkoittavat paljon muutakin. Liikunnan rinnalla ne voivat olla tapahtumia, teemallisia ohjelmia, yhdessä tekemistä tai täysin uusia konsepteja. Arvostamme rohkeutta kokeilla uutta, kykyä tunnistaa mahdollisuuksia sekä taitoa viedä ideat käytäntöön. Osallistut myös itse aktiviteettien ohjaamiseen ja toteuttamiseen.Esihenkilönä johdat ja innostat aktiviteettitiimiä, huolehdit arjen sujuvuudesta ja luot edellytyksiä sille, että tiimi onnistuu työssään. Kehität toimintaa asiakaslähtöisesti ja huolehdit samalla siitä, että aktiviteettitarjonta tukee myös resortin liiketoimintaa.Tehtävä on lähityötä Holiday Club Saimaan Rauhassa, sillä aktiviteettien kehittäminen, toteuttaminen ja tiimin johtaminen edellyttävät vahvaa läsnäoloa paikan päällä.KohteestaHoliday Club Saimaan Rauha on Saimaan rannalla sijaitseva monipuolinen lomakeskus, jossa yhdistyvät majoitus, ravintolat, kokous- ja tapahtumapalvelut sekä laaja aktiviteettitarjonta. Tarjontaan kuuluvat muun muassa kylpylä, golfkenttä, spa, Angry Birds -sisäleikkipuisto, kuntosali sekä monipuoliset peli- ja liikuntamahdollisuudet. title: R&D Project Manager, Bluefors Oy
description: Do you want to lead the development of cutting-edge technology at the forefront of quantum computing and cryogenic solutions?We are looking for an R&D Project Manager to join Bluefors and lead complex product development and productization projects within the companys cooling systems portfolio. In this role, you will have an opportunity to drive the development of innovative technologies that enable some of the worlds most advanced scientific and quantum computing applications.This is much more than a traditional project management role. You will act as a technical project leader in a multidisciplinary environment, working closely with engineering, systems, product development, and productization teams to ensure successful project execution from concept through product readiness.We are looking for a person with strong technical curiosity, the ability to understand complex systems, and a passion for bringing new products from development to market. Previous experience in cryogenics is considered an advantage, but candidates from other complex engineering environments are also encouraged to apply.Your key responsibilities- Lead R&D and productization projects from planning through design completion and product readiness- Define and manage project scope, schedules, milestones, dependencies, and risks- Coordinate and drive execution across multidisciplinary development teams- Act as the system-level owner, ensuring alignment between different subsystems and stakeholders- Manage technical requirements, interfaces, and dependencies throughout the project lifecycle- Support decision-making by balancing technical considerations, project timelines, and business priorities- Drive projects towards scalable, maintainable, and production-ready solutions- Facilitate collaboration and remove obstacles to ensure smooth project executionWhat we expect from you- A degree in Engineering, Physics, or another relevant technical field- A few years of experience in project management, project engineering, product development, or a similar technical environment- Understanding of complex technical systems and product development processes- Structured, proactive, and solution-oriented approach to work- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills- Fluency in English, both written and spokenConsidered an advantage- Experience in productization, industrialization, or NPI (New Product Introduction) projects- Background in systems engineering, mechanical engineering, vacuum systems, process equipment, or other complex hardware environments- Experience working in multidisciplinary R&D organizations- Understanding of modular product architectures and configurable products- Familiarity with cryogenic technologies or other advanced scientific equipmentWhat Bluefors offersBluefors is a global technology leader in cryogenic measurement systems and cooling solutions, serving some of the worlds most advanced research organizations and quantum technology companies. You will join a highly skilled international team working at the cutting edge of science and engineering.This position offers a unique opportunity to contribute to the development of strategically important products while growing your expertise in a rapidly expanding high-tech industry. You will work in a collaborative and multicultural environment where innovation, learning, and professional growth are highly valued.Interested?Apply as soon as possible. We review applications continuously and will move forward with suitable candidates already during the application period. The position will be filled as soon as the right person is found, so we encourage you to submit your application without delay.

title: Raskaskoneasentaja, Kankaanpää
description: Raskaan kaluston asentaja vakituiseen työsuhteeseen. Etsitkö vakaata työpaikkaa, jossa on reilu meininki, mahdollisuus kehittyä ja osaamista arvostava palkkaus?Asiakkaamme on pitkään toiminut ja hyvämaineinen huoltokorjaamo, joka etsii nyt tiimiinsä kokoaikaista ja vakituista raskaan kaluston asentajaa. Tässä roolissa pääset työskentelemään monipuolisesti kuorma-autojen, perävaunujen ja erilaisten työkoneiden parissa. Työskentelet pääasiassa arkipäivisin klo 7.00–17.30 välillä. Toivomme kuitenkin joustavuutta, sillä työpäivien pituudet saattavat vaihdella työtilanteen mukaan. Tulevaisuudessa yrityksessä on mahdollista siirtyä 2-vuorotyöhön, ja toisinaan töitä tehdään myös viikonloppuisin. Saat vahvan tuen ja perusteellisen perehdytyksen – meillä kaveria ei jätetä yksin. Palkkaus määräytyy AKT:n huoltokorjaamoalan työehtosopimuksen ja kokemuksesi mukaan. Erikoisosaamisesta olemme valmiita maksamaan erillistä ekstraa.Mikäli muutat työn perässä toiselta paikkakunnalta, voimme auttaa sinua asunnon hankinnassa. Odotamme sinulta alan koulutusta ja jonkin verran aikaisempaa työkokemusta raskaan kaluston parista, oikeaa asennetta ja vastuuntuntoa sekä tiimihenkeä. Suomen kielen C1 (Taitavan kielitaidon perustaso) vaaditaan työturvallisuuden vuoksi, sekä sujuvaan kommunikointiin muiden työntekijöiden ja asiakkaiden kanssa.
