title: Manager CGS Manufacturing & Logistics Operations
description: Change people's lives and love what you do  Cochlear develops world-leading hearing solutions that help people hear and be heard. We are now looking for an experienced operations leader to lead our Manufacturing and Logistics Operations teams in Gothenburg.  As Manager, CGS Manufacturing & Logistics Operations, you will bring two important operational areas together around clear goals, strong collaboration and a shared commitment to safety, quality, delivery and continuous improvement. This is an opportunity for a people-focused leader who enjoys developing teams while building effective, reliable and scalable operations.  The opportunity  You will lead the operative Manufacturing and Logistics teams and ensure quality products are delivered safely, to specification and on schedule, while maintaining the quality and regulatory standards expected in a medical-device environment.  You will provide clear leadership across the teams, establish effective ways of working and create clarity around goals, responsibilities and priorities. Alongside daily operational leadership, you will strengthen processes and capabilities for the future, support operational and equipment improvements, lead change effectively and build a proactive continuous-improvement culture. The team you will lead is in total 15 persons divided by 7 in production and 8 in logistics.  You will also collaborate with colleagues across our Global Supply Chain network and distribution hubs, connecting local operational priorities with the wider global organisation.  Key responsibilities      Lead and develop the Manufacturing and Logistics Operations teams, with a strong focus on people, safety, quality and delivery.    Establish clear goals, responsibilities, priorities and an effective operating cadence across Manufacturing and Logistics.    Ensure products are delivered to specification and schedule while maintaining quality and regulatory compliance.    Develop and stabilise processes and support equipment requirements, operational improvements and change implementation.    Drive structured continuous improvement using Lean and Six Sigma principles.    Develop team capability through coaching, clear accountability and opportunities for growth.    Manage operational priorities, budgets and cost performance across Direct Manufacturing and Logistics Operations.    Build strong collaboration across Manufacturing, Logistics, Global Supply Chain sites and distribution hubs.    Lead change while maintaining operational continuity, quality and compliance.About you  You are an experienced and supportive operations leader who combines a strong delivery mindset with the ability to develop people and improve how work gets done. You are comfortable balancing daily operational delivery with continuous improvement, change and longer-term capability development.  To be successful in this role, you will bring:      At least five years of people-management experience within manufacturing and/or logistics operations.    Experience leading teams responsible for delivering quality products to specification and schedule.    Strong knowledge of manufacturing and/or logistics operations management.    Practical experience applying Lean, Six Sigma or structured continuous-improvement methodologies.    Experience leading operational change while protecting quality, compliance and delivery.    Experience managing budgets, competing priorities, conflict and capability development.    Understanding of operational planning, process and equipment requirements and change control.    The ability to create accountability, build effective teams, develop talent and make sound operational decisions.Knowledge of medical-device Quality Management Systems, ISO 13485 and GMP requirements will be highly relevant to the role.  Why join Cochlear?  This is more than an opportunity to manage an established operation. You will help shape a newly combined Manufacturing and Logistics organisation, strengthen collaboration and develop the capability needed for the future.  You will work in an environment where quality, continuous improvement, coaching and accountability matter, while contributing to products that help people around the world hear and live full lives.  If you are motivated by developing people, improving operational performance and taking responsibility for quality and delivery in a highly regulated environment, we would welcome your application.  Apply now and help us make a difference to people's lives. #CochlearCareers #TogetherCochlear

operational challenges    Conduct market assessments, competitive analysis, and business case development to support strategic decision-making    Support the development and execution of go-to-market title: Destinationschef till First Camp
description: Vill du leda en destination där gästupplevelser, affärsutveckling och ledarskap går hand i hand? Hos First Camp får du möjlighet att kombinera affärsmässighet, service och ledarskap i en roll med stort ansvar och variation. Här får du driva, utveckla och påverka din destination – med fokus på resultat, gästnöjdhet och teamutveckling.Vilka är First Camp? Vi är en del av First Camp Group, norra Europas ledande koncern för camping och resorts. Tillsammans är vi på en spännande resa med en tydlig, gemensam vision: att skapa en världsledande campingkedja - där vi är first choice för gäster, medarbetare och campingbranschen i Europa.Hållbar utveckling och datadrivna gäst- och medarbetarinsikter är viktiga fokusområden för att tillsammans skapa moments of happiness - varje dag.Vad innebär rollen?Som Destinationschef får du en roll med stort ansvar, variation och verklig påverkan. Du leder helheten på din destination – människor, drift och resultat. Rollen handlar lika mycket om att skapa ordning och struktur som att bygga engagemang, driva affär och utveckla både verksamheten och medarbetarna.Du är närvarande i vardagen, ser detaljerna som gör skillnad och fattar beslut nära verksamheten. Samtidigt har du blicken framåt och arbetar långsiktigt för att stärka destinationens lönsamhet, gästupplevelse och teamkultur.I uppdraget ingår bland annat att:    Leda, rekrytera och utveckla medarbetare samt säkerställa bemanning, introduktion och en trygg arbetsmiljö.    Driva den dagliga driften effektivt och strukturerat, med fokus på kvalitet, service och gästupplevelse.    Ansvara för budget, KPI:er och resultat – inklusive försäljning mot både privat- och företagskunder.    Initiera och genomföra lokala aktiviteter och samarbeten som stärker intäkter, beläggning och gästvärde.    Arbeta med affärsutveckling, prissättning och paketering i samverkan med supportkontor och kollegor.    Vara synlig i verksamheten och coacha teamet i värdskap, bemötande och service – från första intryck till avresa.    Samarbeta med Regionchef och centrala funktioner för att säkra samsyn, struktur och resultat.Rollen kräver närvaro, engagemang och ett tydligt ledarskap – men också nyfikenhet, initiativkraft och viljan att alltid hitta vägar framåt.Vem söker vi?Vi söker en driven och affärsorienterad ledare med ett genuint intresse för människor och service. Du trivs i en roll där du får kombinera strategi och drift, inspirera andra och skapa både resultat och trivsel.Med tydlighet, engagemang och helhetsperspektiv leder du din destination mot gemensamma mål – och skapar en miljö där både gäster och medarbetare känner sig välkomna, sedda och stolta.För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har:    Erfarenhet av ledarskap och personalansvar, gärna från besöksnäring, service, handel eller hotell.    God förståelse för ekonomi, affärsutveckling och försäljning.    Förmåga att driva förändring, utveckla team och skapa engagemang.    Mycket god kommunikativ förmåga på svenska och engelska.    God systemvana och förmåga att arbeta strukturerat även i ett högt tempo.    B-körkort och möjlighet att använda destinationens fordon i arbetet.    Det är meriterande med erfarenhet av rekrytering, budgetarbete, B2B-försäljning eller lokalt affärssamarbete.Som person är du en närvarande och trygg ledare med förmåga att fatta beslut nära verksamheten. Du ser möjligheter där andra ser hinder, skapar tydlighet och energi i teamet och driver förbättringar som gör skillnad för både gäster och medarbetare.Framför allt har du ett genuint engagemang för människor – och drivs av att bygga en kultur där ansvar, stolthet och arbetsglädje går hand i hand.Vad erbjuder vi?Hos oss får du vara en del av ett ambitiöst företag med både hjärta och framåtanda. Rollen ger dig möjlighet att påverka, utvecklas och växa – samtidigt som du får arbeta nära både människor och verksamhet.Våra gemensamma värderingar styr våra dagliga handlingar:We Care – Vi jobbar tillsammans med omtanke om gästen, medarbetaren och planeten. Vi skapar en öppen och stöttande miljö där vi utmanar varandra, lär oss av misstag och firar framgångar.We Have Fun – Genom att vara oss själva och ha roligt ihop skapar vi en välkomnande stämning för alla vi möter. Tillsammans skapar vi fina minnen för våra team, kollegor och gäster.We Simplify – Framåtanda, tillsammans med viljan att lära, gör att vi ständigt förbättrar och utvecklar hur vi arbetar. Vi gör det enkelt för varandra – det ska vara lätt att göra rätt för både kollegor och våra gäster.We Deliver Results – Vi fokuserar i allt vi gör på att skapa resultat för våra gäster, kollegor och hela företaget. Målen är högt satta och vi lyckas bäst när vi använder både hjärta och hjärna.Vi erbjuder en arbetsplats med goda möjligheter till utveckling och omtänksamma kollegor som delar med sig av visdom och skratt. Tillsammans vill vi fortsätta vår framgångssaga och växa med fler stjärnor som vill vara med och bygga vår framtid.VillkorTjänsten är ett vikariat på heltid och innefattas av kollektivavtal med tidsbegränsad anställning.  Lön och villkor enligt överenskommelse. Arbetet innefattar visst helg- och kvällsarbete samt delad beredskap.AnsökanUrval och intervjuer sker löpande, så vänta inte med att skicka in din ansökan om detta låter som rätt möjlighet för dig.Vi arbetar kompetensbaserat i våra rekryteringar och fokuserar på att hitta den person som bäst matchar tjänstens kravprofil. För slutkandidater i processen kan utdrag ur belastningsregistret komma att begäras.Som ett första steg i vår urvalsprocess kan du få genomföra rekryteringstester som hjälper oss att säkerställa en rättvis och träffsäker matchning.

title: Research Scientist
description: Are you a hands-on research scientist with deep expertise in medical imaging and strong technical skills in programming, data analytics and AI?Do you enjoy combining scientific research with practical technical development, taking ownership and driving complex research collaborations towards successful outcomes?Collective Minds is looking for a Research Scientist to drive scientific and technical contributions in public and private research consortia. This is an opportunity to combine research, technology and project ownership in a growing international healthtech company.About Collective MindsCollective Minds is based in Stockholm/Danderyd and we operate globally across clinical trials and life sciences. We are an imaging platform for clinical trials that connects hospitals, experts, and industry - including CROs, pharma, biotech, medtech, and eClinical vendors - enabling trials with imaging endpoints and the generation of high-quality evidence faster and more efficiently. We are a fast-moving, commercially minded team focused on collaboration, accountability, and impact. By combining deep domain expertise in medical imaging with novel cloud technology, we help customers reduce risk, ensure compliance, accelerate and scale research.About the roleAs Research Scientist, you will combine scientific expertise in medical imaging with hands-on technical development and ownership of selected research consortia.Collective Minds currently participates in more than 10 public and private research consortia spanning medical imaging, big data, analytics and AI modeling and validation. These collaborations bring together academic hospitals, research organizations and industry partners across therapeutic areas such as oncology, immunology, cardiovascular and musculoskeletal research.Acting as a data manager and platform provider, Collective Minds plays a central role in these collaborations. You will be responsible for our contributions in two to three consortia, with the opportunity to apply your scientific and technical expertise, work independently and contribute to impactful research.Your main responsibilities:    Lead Collective Minds' contributions in selected research consortia, ensuring delivery within agreed budgets, timelines and scope.    Develop and implement technical solutions, including scripts, data pipelines, analytical tools, dashboards and AI-based applications.    Make scientific and technical decisions across medical imaging, data analytics, AI modeling and validation.    Ensure effective use of the Collective Minds platform, prioritizing standardized and scalable solutions over unnecessary custom development.    Manage project scope and stakeholder expectations, clearly defining deliverables and commitments.    Take ownership of work package delivery, reporting to consortium partners, coordinators and funders, and efficient project close-outs.    Collaborate with internal teams and external research partners, coordinating additional resources when needed.Who are we looking for?We are looking for a scientifically experienced and technically skilled professional who combines deep expertise in medical imaging with the ability to independently develop solutions and deliver complex research projects.You are analytical, pragmatic and hands-on, with a proactive approach to problem-solving. You enjoy taking ownership, collaborating across disciplines and driving results in a fast-moving environment.We believe you have:    A strong scientific background in life sciences, medicine, biomedical engineering or a related field, with deep expertise in medical imaging research.    Strong hands-on technical skills in Python, SQL, DICOM and AI frameworks, with experience developing scripts, data tools and analytical solutions. Familiarity with dashboarding tools such as Superset or Metabase is a plus.    Experience delivering work packages in research consortia or grant-funded projects, including grant execution, reporting and project close-outs.    A proven ability to independently manage research projects within agreed budgets, timelines and scope, and make informed scientific and technical decisions.    Experience coordinating work across academic, clinical and industry partners, with strong communication and stakeholder management skills.    Fluent in English, both written and spoken.    Willingness to travel internationally as required, typically approximately every two months.    Ability to work regularly from our Stockholm/Danderyd office.Why join Collective Minds?At Collective Minds, you will join an innovative and ambitious company where technology, science and collaboration come together to make a meaningful difference in healthcare.You will be part of an entrepreneurial environment with short decision-making processes, engaged colleagues and the opportunity to influence how things are done.This is an opportunity to work with leading scientific and industry partners, contribute to innovative research collaborations and play an important role in the continued growth of an international healthtech company.

implementations when needed.    Commercial awareness and the ability to balance scientific objectives with budgets, resources and project commitments.    Strong communication, coordination and initiative.    Fluency in English, both written and spoken.    Willingness to travel internationally as required by research projects, typically approximately every two months.    Ability to work regularly from our Stockholm/Danderyd office.Why join Collective Minds?At Collective Minds, you will join an innovative and ambitious company where technology, science and collaboration come together to make a meaningful difference in healthcare.You will be part of an entrepreneurial environment with short decision-making processes, engaged colleagues and the opportunity to influence how things are done.This is an opportunity to take responsibility for a strategically important research portfolio, work with leading scientific and industry partners and contribute to the continued growth of an international healthtech company.We look forward to receiving your application!

title: AWS DevOps Engineer
description: They say, “it’s not rocket science.” We disagree.Welcome to SSC Space (formerly Swedish Space Corporation), the perfect workplace for those passionate about technology in general and space in particular.  With space organizations, research institutes, institutional and commercial actors as customers, we offer specialist expertise in satellite communications, spacecraft consulting services, rocket and balloon systems, and much more. SSC Space also has one of the world’s largest global networks of ground stations for satellite communications. We own and operate the Esrange Space Center in Kiruna, northern Sweden, with the aim of launching satellites in the near future. We are now looking for an AWS DevOps Engineer who will build and improve the infrastructure and deployment workflows that support our systems. Working across AWS and on-premises environments, you will help developers deliver software reliably, strengthen security through automated controls and make our systems easier to operate and monitor. JOB REQUIREMENTSWe are looking for someone who enjoys solving practical problems through automation and takes ownership of system reliability. You work well across IT and development teams, share your knowledge and look for ways to make everyday operations better.You bring:    At least three years of hands-on AWS experience in production environments.    Practical experience with infrastructure as code, using tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation.    Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitHub Actions, AWS CodePipeline or Jenkins.    Experience managing Kubernetes clusters in cloud or on-premises environments.    Fluency in Swedish and English, both spoken and written.Experience with Ansible or similar configuration management tools, scripting in Python or Bash, and DevOps practices is an advantage.Swedish citizenship is required for this role. JOB RESPONSIBILITIESYou will work closely with developers, architects and IT colleagues to improve how we build, deploy and manage our environments.Your responsibilities include:    Develop and maintain infrastructure as code using tools such as Terraform and CloudFormation, and automate configuration with Ansible.    Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for cloud-based systems and applications.    Automate deployments and environment provisioning to improve consistency and reduce manual work.    Manage containerized workloads in Amazon EKS and on-premises Kubernetes environments.    Develop monitoring and observability across cloud and on-premises resources using Grafana and application performance monitoring tools.    Investigate operational incidents and improve reliability through testing, automation and lessons learned.    Build security policies and automated guardrails into infrastructure and deployment workflows.    Manage software artefacts and container images using Amazon ECR and JFrog, supporting a secure software supply chain.    Contribute to solution design, quality assurance and clear documentation of infrastructure and processes for internal use and audits. BENEFITSWe offer you     A unique opportunity to contribute to a wide range of projects and play an active role in both the Swedish and international space industry.     An excellent opportunity for personal and career development.     An exciting, international workplace characterized by an open atmosphere and proud employees all over the world.  You will work with colleagues across engineering and IT, develop your skills across cloud and on-premises environments, and contribute to how we build and operate our systems. Additional benefits     In addition to vacation and traditional public holidays, we offer extra paid leave throughout the year, such as time off between Christmas and New Year, Ascension Day, amounting to 6-11 extra days depending on the calendar.      Wellness allowance of SEK 5,000 per year.     Health benefits such as voluntary health insurance and regular health checks for eligible employees.      Access to a benefit bike through a tax-efficient leasing program.     Support for employee-driven activities that promote connection, health, and culture across teams.     Collective Agreement, including good pensions plans, parental pay and insurance.   LOCATIONThis is a full-time, permanent position based at our office in Solna Strand.   NEXT STEPIf this opportunity sparks your interest, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible! We review applications continuously and will conduct interviews throughout the process. Please note, however, that the position may be filled before this date, and the advertisement may therefore close earlier. This allows us to manage the process efficiently and give each application the attention it deserves. When applying, please include your CV. While you are welcome to include a brief personal note or letter, our evaluation will primarily focus on your skills and qualifications as outlined in your CV, ensuring a fair and unbiased recruitment process.  As part of our recruitment process, all candidates selected for employment undergo a background check and security screening. Citizenship requirements may apply depending on the role. WE HELP EARTH BENEFIT FROM SPACESSC Space is a leading global provider of advanced space services, with more than 50 years of experience. We help space organizations, research institutes, commercial and institutional actors from all over the world to get access to space. With local presence on all continents and about 800 committed employees, we offer specialist expertise in satellite communications and satellite control services, spacecraft operations, rocket and balloon systems, launch services and flight test services, as well as engineering, operations and consultancy services for space missions. We help Earth benefit from Space. Learn more at sscspace.com

title: Professional Analyst
description: Company DescriptionVattenfall is a European energy company with approximately 20.000 employees. For more than 100 years we have electrified industries, supplied energy to people’s homes and modernized our way of living through innovation and cooperation. We are looking for talented individuals who, in addition to their passion for their own role, also have strong team spirit and want to contribute to supporting a meaningful corporate mission.Within Vattenfall, Business Area (BA) Markets optimizes assets and effectively sources and trades commodities, thus ensuring best value for both Vattenfall and our customers. BA Markets is active across Europe with around 450 professionals working from Sweden, Germany, the Netherlands, and the UK. In BA Markets the mission of the Business Unit (BU) Operations is to drive the digital transformation. BU Operations consists of diverse and highly skilled employees from more than 20 countries. We work internationally from our locations in Stockholm, Hamburg, and Amsterdam.  Job DescriptionDo you want to take on exciting challenges and contribute to a changing energy landscape? Join our Fundamental Analysis team and use your expertise to develop valuable market insights and support better-informed decisions. Together with talented colleagues in an international environment, you will have the opportunity to grow, collaborate and make a difference. The department, team, and job As part of the Analysis department, the Fundamental Analysis team develops models and analyses on power markets, deals and assets, following an Agile / Scrum process. We provide model-based forecasts of power prices and analysis of price drivers to support decision making in the traded market horizon and beyond. Our analysis is based on fundamental power forecasting models covering our core markets on the continent and in the Nordics. We believe that the decisions we help make enable fossil freedom that drives society forward. The position is located in Stockholm as part of an international team of highly professional, skilled analysts, located in Hamburg and Stockholm. What you will do: Build better models: Collaborate with your team members to develop our short-, mid- and/or long-term fundamental power-price models and contribute to our hydrological models.     Improve our forecast by adapting our models to evolving electricity markets, such as producing better and dynamic assumptions for inputs such as electricity demand, stack, solar and wind production, etc..     Turn stakeholder needs into new model capabilities. Communicate your developments to the stakeholders and gather their reflections. Examples could be volatility estimation or applying data science methods to update demand profiles.      Use generative AI and AI agents responsibly to streamline our analytical methods.     Improve model architecture, cloud efficiency, code quality and data integration. Create insight: Run simulations and translate results into clear answers for hydro bidding and optimisation, valuation, trading and ad-hoc questions for our stakeholders.      Deliver market insights to support decision making for battery and wind project valuations and hydro production planning.     Investigate scenarios to estimate their market price and asset portfolio impact and support Vattenfall’s position on power market regulatory topics.     Provide fundamental analyses that enable profitable trading strategies.     Update our market outlook and present it to upper management to keep them informed on energy market developments. QualificationsWe are looking for someone with:     A good understanding of Nordic energy markets and a curiosity to learn more about Nordic and Continental European markets.     Strong Python skills and a collaborative approach to improving code, infrastructure and ways of working. Experience with Git, DevOps, Azure or containerization is an advantage.     Knowledge of quantitative methods, power modelling, mathematical optimisation or data science. Experience with an energy-market simulation tool such as EMPS is welcome.     An academic degree in engineering, mathematics, or a related field, would be preferred. Energy-systems modelling is a plus.     Fluency in English is required, Swedish is advantageous.      Willingness to travel a few times per year, for example to Hamburg for team events or for trainings. You do not need to meet every requirement to apply. If this role excites you and you believe you can contribute, we would like to hear from you. Additional InformationWe offer:     Meaningful analytical challenges in fast-changing energy markets.     An active Analysis community that shares knowledge on topics from flow-based market coupling to practical uses of AI.     A welcoming, respectful workplace with flat hierarchies, appreciation for own initiative, open discussion culture and zero-tolerance for harassment.      An international team where we believe diverse perspectives improves our work.      A flexible, supportive Agile culture with trust, autonomy and no micromanagement.     Support for professional growth, including learning opportunities and internal rotations.     Flexible working hours, including working remotely up to half of the time per week. We are convinced that diversity contributes to building a more profitable and attractive company. We work actively for all employees to have the same opportunities and rights regardless of age, religion, gender identity & expression, sexual identity, disability, religion, and ethnic background. More information Location: Stockholm with the option to work remotely up to half of the week  Contract type: PermanentFor more information about the recruitment process you are welcome to contact our Recruiter Johan Macdonald, johan.macdonald@vattenfall.com Trade union representatives Trade union representatives: Lars Erik Näsman (Unionen) and Sven Gunnar Gremlin (Akademikerna). To get in contact with the representatives, please call Vattenfall switchboard: 0046 8 739 50 00.   We welcome your application no later than 9th of november 2026. As we may conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

title: Embedded Software Architecture, SI ICE Control
description: Embedded Software Architecture, SI ICE Control – ExpertIntegro Consulting | Automotive & Powertrain Development | SwedenHelp shape the future of sustainable powertrain technologyIntegro Consulting is seeking a highly experienced Senior Expert in Embedded Software Architecture and Spark-Ignited Internal Combustion Engine (SI ICE) Control for a consulting assignment with our client, Volvo Trucks.This is an opportunity to contribute to next-generation powertrain technologies, particularly hydrogen-powered combustion engines and alternative fuels for heavy-duty applications.Combining expertise in embedded software, model-based control, and engine management with technical leadership, you will help develop advanced control systems, automate engineering workflows, and explore the potential of physics-inspired AI and machine learning.About the assignmentYou will contribute to early-phase development and concept engineering within a multidisciplinary powertrain organisation. Your primary focus will be embedded software architecture and model-based control systems for spark-ignited engines, particularly hydrogen internal combustion engines (H2 ICE).You will work across engineering disciplines to develop robust, scalable control solutions while improving software development, testing, verification, and calibration through automation. You will also investigate how physics-inspired AI/ML can enhance modelling, diagnostics, control strategies, and engineering optimisation.Key responsibilities    Embedded software architecture: Define scalable architectures and control concepts for SI ICE applications, particularly hydrogen engines.        Engine control: Develop and integrate ECU functions for air-path management, torque modelling, combustion control, knock detection, and knock control.        Model-based development: Translate system requirements into control models, software implementations, and verified solutions.        Software integration: Integrate ECU functions with sensors, actuators, diagnostics, communication interfaces, and powertrain platforms.        Automation: Improve software development, code generation, continuous integration, testing, and verification workflows.        Calibration optimisation: Automate calibration processes, measurement-data analysis, test planning, and optimisation.        Physics-inspired AI/ML: Explore physics-based and data-driven methods for modelling, control, diagnostics, and optimisation.        Testing and verification: Support SIL/HIL testing, engine test-bench activities, calibration, and release-readiness assessments.        Technical leadership: Lead design reviews, coordinate engineering activities, provide technical recommendations, and share knowledge.Required qualifications and experienceWe are looking for a senior technical expert who can take ownership of complex engineering challenges and deliver high-quality solutions.You should have:    An M.Sc., PhD, or equivalent expertise in control engineering, mechatronics, electronics, automation, applied physics, mechanical engineering, or a related field.        Typically 12+ years of relevant experience in powertrain development, embedded systems, or automotive product development.        Extensive experience in model-based control for spark-ignited combustion engines, including requirements, modelling, implementation, integration, verification, and calibration.        Deep knowledge of ECU function development, air-path control, torque modelling, combustion control, and knock detection and control.        Strong experience in embedded software architecture, AUTOSAR Classic, software integration, diagnostics, and automotive communication protocols.        Knowledge of functional safety and cybersecurity, including ISO 26262 and SAE J21434.        Experience with SIL/HIL testing, engine test benches, data analysis, and technical documentation.        Practical experience in automated software development, code generation, scripting, continuous integration, and automated testing.        Experience in ECU calibration and optimisation, including test planning and measurement-data processing.        Advanced working knowledge of MATLAB/Simulink and Python.        Experience with ATI Vision and/or AVL Concerto. Knowledge of ETAS INCA, ETAS ASCMO, TargetLink, and C/C++ is also relevant.        Strong technical leadership, analytical skills, and the ability to communicate complex topics clearly in English.You are proactive, structured, and results-oriented, with the ability to challenge established approaches constructively and collaborate across engineering disciplines.Meritorious experienceThe following would be particularly valuable:    Development or calibration of hydrogen, natural gas, or other alternative-fuel SI engines, especially for heavy-duty applications.        Experience with physics-inspired AI/ML, physics-informed learning, hybrid modelling, virtual sensing, anomaly detection, or data-driven control.        Applying AI/ML to improve engineering workflows, software development, testing, or calibration.        Knowledge of software-defined vehicle architectures, AUTOSAR Adaptive, or RTOS-based solutions.        Experience in heavy-duty powertrain development, calibration, verification tools, or engineering methods.        Contributions to technical roadmaps, patents, scientific publications, or engineering competence development.Interested in this opportunity?If you have the expertise to advance embedded engine control and sustainable powertrain technology, we would like to hear from you.Please submit your CV and a brief summary of your relevant experience, highlighting your expertise in embedded software architecture, SI ICE control, model-based development, ECU calibration, and automation.Please also include your availability and any experience with hydrogen engines or physics-inspired AI/ML.Apply through Integro Consulting to discuss the assignment and how you can contribute to this exciting development programme.

title: Hepatologist
description: At Sahlgrenska University Hospital, we work together to provide the highest quality of care with the patient at the center. Our great commitment and continuous learning make us one of the country's leading university hospitals. We provide everything from county healthcare to national highly specialized care. We focus on the future of healthcare through exciting research. We care about digital skills and everyone's contribution to the digital development. Our work is about using our collected knowledge and experiences together with you – to create value for our patients.We are transforming healthcare with the ambition of becoming Europe’s leading university hospital by 2032. In partnership with our patients, we work to ensure quality, accessibility, patient safety, research, education, and innovation within an integrated healthcare system across the Västra Götaland Region in Sweden.Sahlgrenska University Hospital is one of Northern Europe's largest hospitals with over 17,000 colleagues who have different experience and backgrounds.About usThe Department of Gastroenterology and Hepatology at Sahlgrenska University Hospital (SU) is one of the largest in the Nordic region. We provide emergency and scheduled outpatient care, and have close collaboration with other departments including upper and lower GI surgery, and transplantation surgery.The department is organized into teams focusing on hepatologic outpatient care, gastroenterologic outpatient care, endoscopy, intestinal failure unit, and an inpatient ward. The department is actively involved in ongoing research across several fields and has a strong emphasis on education, continuing professional development, and the ongoing advancement of clinical services.What can we offer? As a Specialist Physician/Senior Consultant at the Department of Gastroenterology and Hepatolgy at Sahlgrenska university Hospital, you will have excellent opportunities for professional development and research. You will work within our subspecialty teams alongside ambitious and friendly colleagues, with close collaboration with the transplantation unit.The department has a high patient volume, providing extensive opportunities for both clinical practice and research.Our goal is to provide the highest possible standard of care for our patients. We place great importance on supporting each individual's professional development according to their interests, strengths, and career goals, while also enabling them to influence their working environment.About the RoleYou will work with the assessment, diagnosis, and treatment of patients requiring specialized care in hepatology in both emergency and elective settings. Your duties will include working in the outpatient clinic, inpatient ward, and at the liver transplant unit, as well as participation during office hours and on-call duties.Teaching and supervising less experienced colleagues, medical students, and healthcare professionals is an integral part of the role. You will also be expected to take an active part in the department’s quality improvement, development, and change initiatives, as well as in research activities.About YouWe are looking for a board-certified senior consultant in Gastroenterology and Hepatology with a high level of expertise in hepatology. You should be interested in both your own professional development and contributing to the advancement of care at one of the largest university hospitals in the Nordic region. You work well within a team and have a strong interest in liver disease.We value strong communication and collaboration skills. You are able to apply newly acquired knowledge in your clinical practice, make sound clinical judgments, and thrive in a fast-paced work environment. We are seeking a motivated and independent individual with the ability and interest to take overall responsibility and place the patient's needs at the center of care.Ongoing research activities and/or a doctoral degree (PhD) are considered meritorious.Great emphasis will be placed on personal suitability.Interviews will be conducted on an ongoing basis throughout the recruitment period.We warmly welcome your application!Together for the patient - Sahlgrenska UniversitetssjukhusetIn the event of recruiting a physician or nurse with a foreign medical license and/or specialist certification, the appointment will be preceded by the necessary process to fulfill the requirements for Swedish licensure and/or specialist recognition.About Region Västra GötalandRegion Västra Götaland is there for the people of Västra Götaland. We ensure good quality healthcare for everyone. We work towards a sustainable development and growth, a clean environment, an improved public health, a rich cultural life and good communications throughout Västra Götaland.Region Västra Götaland is actively working to digitize more ways of working. To be part of the digital transformation, you need to have basic skills and be able to use digital tools and services. You know how to search for information, how to communicate and interact digitally, you are also risk-aware and motivated to be part of the development to learn new things.If you want to know more about Region Västra Götaland, you can visit our introduction to new employees at www.vgregion.se/introduction.  You can also read more in the presentation on Salary, remuneration and benefits – what you will receive as an employee in VGR.All permanent employees of Region Västra Götaland are assigned wartime postings.ApplicationRegion Västra Götaland would like you to register your application through the recruitment system. If you have any questions about the advertised job, or if you are unable to register your information in a public system for any reason, please contact the person who advertised the job.For employment agencies, intermediaries, recruitment agencies and salespeople:We kindly refrain from direct contact with employment agencies, intermediaries, recruitment agencies and other external actors and sellers of additional job advertisements. Region Västra Götaland has tendered contracts.

title: Technology Strategy and Transform Lead
description: Company description:Ericsson ABJob description:   Join our Team       About this opportunityEnterprise IT is looking for a Director, Strategy and Transformation to turn its most urgent, complex and enterprise-wide priorities into results. The role combines strategic advice, special-project leadership, executive problem-solving and hands-on delivery, and is suited to assignments that are ambiguous, cross-organisational, time-critical or without a clear organisational home.Reporting to the Head of PA Technology Foundation, you will clarify complex issues, bring the right stakeholders together and drive assignments through to resolution, recovery, acceleration or measurable business outcomes.   What you will do•    Act as a rapid-response advisor for complex, ambiguous or urgent enterprise situations.•    Structure issues, clarify root causes and turn strategic intent into executable actions.•    Lead CIO-sponsored initiatives, special projects and cross-organisational transformations from mobilisation to delivery.•    Engage senior stakeholders across business areas, Enterprise IT, architecture, sourcing, finance, risk, legal and the wider technology ecosystem.•    Recover or accelerate critical programmes through fact-based plans, clear ownership and executive follow-through.•    Help resolve executive deadlocks and build coalitions where escalation alone is not enough.•    Lead enterprise responses to audit findings, control gaps and other governance matters.•    Address critical supplier and partner challenges across sourcing, commercial, delivery and relationships.•    Act as a strategic interface between Enterprise IT and Ericsson's business and technology ecosystem.•    Provide concise executive briefings that make decisions, risks, trade-offs and next steps clear.   You will bring•    Extensive experience in enterprise technology strategy, digital transformation or large-scale business transformation.•    A proven ability to advise CIOs and senior executives and turn strategic priorities into practical execution.•    Strong executive problem-solving skills, including issue structuring, analysis and decision facilitation.•    Experience leading complex, cross-organisational initiatives with limited formal authority.•    Experience in programme recovery, transformation acceleration, strategic sourcing or major commercial engagements.•    A sound understanding of enterprise technology domains such as cloud, AI, cybersecurity, data and enterprise platforms.•    The ability to navigate governance, audit, risk and compliance while maintaining delivery momentum.•    Excellent stakeholder management, negotiation and coalition-building skills.•    Clear, influential executive communication that distils complexity into decisions and measurable outcomes.•    High personal ownership, discretion, integrity and resilience in high-pressure situations.•    A relevant university degree is required; an advanced degree or recognised strategy, transformation or programme leadership qualification is an advantage.

title: Communication Strategist
description: Company description:Who are we?Volvo Cars is a company on a mission; to bring traditional car manufacturing into a connected, sustainable and smart future.Since 1927, we have been a brand known for our commitment to safety, creating innovative cars that make life less complicated for our consumers. In 2010, we decided to transform our business, resulting in a totally new generation of cars and technologies, as well as steady growth and record sales. Today, we’re expanding our global footprint in Europe, China and the US, and we’re on the lookout for new talent. We are constantly pushing our own skills and abilities to drive change in the automobile industry like never before. We are looking for innovative, committed people to join us in this endeavour and create safe, sustainable and connected cars. We believe in the power of people and will challenge and support you to reach your full potential. Join us and be part of Volvo Cars’ journey into the future.Job description:   Let's introduce ourselves   You’ll join the Leader and Employee Communication team, part of the broader Communication and Public Affairs organisation. Together, we help leaders communicate with clarity and purpose, while ensuring employees feel informed, engaged and connected to Volvo Cars’ strategic direction.   Working closely with communication colleagues and stakeholders across the organisation, we translate business priorities into clear, relevant and engaging communication, delivered through the right messages and channels.   We are a collaborative and creative team that values fresh thinking, strong relationships and communication that makes a meaningful difference. We encourage curiosity, bold ideas and new ways of working, and foster an international culture where people are united by a shared purpose.     What you'll do   You will create communications content and execute communication strategies in line with established communication policies. You will follow communication plans and share company information through a combination of channels.    People who make a difference are the driving force that has built one of the most recognisable brands in the world. We are looking for change makers who think about communication opportunities in exciting and different ways, creative and critical thinkers who want to make a difference with us at Volvo Cars. In this role, you will:      Shape the news and information flow within Volvo Cars, driving employee engagement and strategic alignment and encouraging employees to become proactive brand ambassadors.     Develop multi-channel communication strategies around news-based stories and see them through to execution.     Develop thought-leadership positions that strengthen employee engagement and the Volvo Cars brand.     Drive the development and consistent implementation of stories and messages that support our corporate strategy and core values across communication channels globally.     Collaborate with business area communication teams to identify and develop relevant news-based stories from across the company.     Co-create the editorial calendar across communication channels.     Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders and provide high-level communication guidance.     Contribute to developing our employee communication capabilities by keeping up with trends and best practices from other industries and implementing working methods and tools that strengthen employee engagement.      What you'll bring   We are looking for a social, passionate and creative communications professional with experience in developing and delivering engaging and motivating communication strategies. You have deep experience in earned communication and/or journalism and the ability to utilise different channels to support desired business outcomes. You thrive in a fast-paced and entrepreneurial environment and are comfortable adapting to changing business priorities. You combine your natural interest in creating innovative communication with an ability to identify the right channel for different stories.         BA / BSc in communication, journalism or equivalent experience     A strategic and creative approach to communication planning, with an ability to manage a range of projects, balancing quality and speed     Exceptional communication skills and fluency in English and Chinese, both verbal and written      Experience working across different communication channels and formats.     Strong ability to build good working relationships with stakeholders and internal colleagues.     Experience in journalism, earned communication or corporate communication.     Experience from the automotive industry and/or financial communication is considered an advantage.

title: Psychologist
description: Scania is undergoing a transformation from being a leading supplier of trucks, buses, and engines to providing complete and sustainable transport solutions. Together with TRATON and our sister brands MAN, Volkswagen Truck & Bus, and International, we are working to shape the future of mobility with innovative and environmentally conscious solutions.Our values – customer first, respect, team spirit, responsibility, and elimination of waste – are at the heart of everything we do. Together, we are at the forefront of creating a sustainable future.Role SummaryScania Occupational Health Services Sweden is looking for an experienced licensed psychologist who would like to provide qualified support to Scania’s operations in Södertälje. In this role, you will work with issues relating to individuals’ health and circumstances, group interaction and development, and organizational ways of working and change. You will support employees, managers, HR and management teams, adapting your interventions to their needs—from clinical support for individuals to consultative work with groups and organizations.You will contribute psychological expertise and a holistic perspective to issues relating to work-related ill health, rehabilitation, collaboration, conflict and change. The aim is to promote health and create sustainable conditions for both people and the business.You will be part of a cross-professional team in a global and dynamic organization. Your experience and ability to translate knowledge into practical support will be important to our work to promote health, safety and sustainable productivity.  Job ResponsibilitiesYou will be part of a cross-functional team that includes occupational health physicians, occupational health nurses and other psychologists. In your customer team, you will also work with ergonomists and work environment engineers. You will work in a consultative capacity, supporting individuals, groups, managers, HR and management teams.The work includes both preventive and remedial interventions at individual, group and organizational levels. You will move between these levels according to the needs of each assignment and consider how individuals’ situations, group interactions and organizational conditions affect one another.Your main responsibilities will be to:    Conduct clinical assessments and provide time-limited psychological treatment for individuals, both individually and in groups, as well as support in cases of work-related ill health and rehabilitation.    Support individuals and groups with issues relating to health, work capacity, collaboration and return to work.    Support groups with group development, collaboration and conflict issues, for example through facilitation and consultative support.    Support managers, HR and management teams with issues relating to employee health, group interactions and organizational conditions.    Contribute psychological expertise to organizational changes and change management, focusing on how changes affect individuals, groups, leadership and the work environment.    Analyze organizational conditions and provide recommendations for sustainable ways of working and a good organizational and social work environment.    Develop and deliver training in areas such as mental health, change, work environment and leadership.The position is based at Occupational Health Services in Södertälje. When the customer assignment allows, the work can be carried out remotely.Who You Are    Licensed Psychologist with experience providing psychological support to individuals and groups.    Strong consultative background, partnering with managers, teams, and organizations to address workplace challenges and promote wellbeing.    Experience supporting organizational change, including reorganizations, new ways of working, and business transformations.    Knowledge of group dynamics, organizational psychology, and evidence-based interventions that support healthy and effective workplaces.    Experience working with work-related ill health, rehabilitation processes, and employee support.    Skilled in supporting managers and teams through collaboration, communication, and conflict-resolution challenges.    Able to build trust, provide constructive challenge, and translate psychological expertise into practical recommendations and actions.    Structured, empathetic, and adaptable, with excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.    Fluent in Swedish and English, both written and spoken; experience within Occupational Health Services is considered an advantage.This Is UsOccupational Health Services Sweden is part of Global SHE, which supports Scania in the areas of safety, health and work environment. We are based in Södertälje, Oskarshamn and Luleå in Sweden, as well as at other locations around the world. Our role as an independent expert resource is to guide Scania in its work to ensure and promote health, safety and sustainable productivity. As an integrated part of the business, we have a good understanding of the workplaces and the opportunity to follow operations over time.Scania OffersWe offer a dynamic and engaging workplace where collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement are part of everyday life. You will be part of a strong team environment that encourages knowledge sharing and close cooperation across functions.With a structured development plan and a wide range of training opportunities, Scania supports your professional growth both locally and internationally.Benefits include access to our health center in Gröndal or a wellness allowance, result bonus, flexible working hours, and company car leasing. Scania also arranges events for employees and their families, and for those living in Stockholm, convenient commuting is supported through direct Scania Job express buses to Södertälje.ApplicationWe look forward to receiving your application, consisting of your CV and kindly ask you not to share a cover letter to ensure an efficient and unbiased recruitment process for all parties.Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-11-10. title: International Advocacy Advisor
description: RFSL is seeking an International Advocacy Advisor to support Ukrainian LGBTQI organisations and activists in advancing their advocacy priorities and influencing policy at national, regional and international levels. The role combines international advocacy, partnership development and capacity strengthening, with practical programme and administrative support that enables locally led movements to thrive.About RFSL and our international workRFSL (the Swedish Federation for Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender, Queer, and Intersex Rights), founded in 1950, is one of the world’s oldest non-profit organisations working to advance LGBTQI rights.RFSL’s international work supports LGBTQI movements in Eastern Europe, Asia and Africa through regranting, partnerships, knowledge exchange, organisational support and advocacy. We work closely with local partners to support locally led movements, strengthen their agency and influence, and contribute to enabling environments for LGBTQI rights at national, regional and global levels.Your role with usYou will work closely with Ukrainian LGBTQI organisations and activists to strengthen their ability to lead and influence advocacy processes. Together with partners, you will identify priorities, develop strategies and messaging, map stakeholders, and find opportunities to engage decision-makers and relevant international platforms, including the EU, UN, OSCE and Council of Europe.A central part of the role is helping partners access the knowledge, networks, resources and practical support they need to pursue their priorities. This includes organising capacity-strengthening activities, managing scholarships and providing hands-on programme and administrative support. You will also contribute to advocacy efforts in Sweden related to Ukraine and work with RFSL colleagues to align policy, advocacy and communications.You will collaborate with the Head of Program, International Program Managers, other Advocacy Advisors and colleagues across RFSL’s international work. The position is based in Stockholm and involves international travel several times per year.For full description of  key responsibilities and desirable qualifications, please see our job ad on RFSL’s careers pageWho are you?You are a structured, collaborative and solution-oriented professional committed to LGBTQI rights, international advocacy and locally led movement strengthening. You understand Ukraine’s political and social context, the regional human rights and civil society landscape, and the challenges facing LGBTQI organisations working in politically sensitive or resource-constrained environments.You build trusted partnerships and adapt your approach to different organisations, particularly grassroots groups that may need substantial practical support alongside strategic guidance. You respect local leadership and autonomy, understand power dynamics in international partnerships, and approach your work with awareness of security, safeguarding and the importance of accountable support.You enjoy combining strategic advocacy and capacity strengthening with practical operational and administrative tasks. You are comfortable moving between developing advocacy strategies and organising activities, coordinating travel, booking accommodation, handling receipts and ensuring that payments and documentation are in order. You recognise that this hands-on support is an important part of enabling partners to advance their own priorities.You bring strong analytical, communication and organisational skills, can represent RFSL professionally with civil society, public authorities and international institutions, and work effectively across teams and cultures. You are proactive, flexible and accountable, and share RFSL’s values of anti-racism, feminism, accessibility and intersectionality.To succeed in this role, you need:    A strong commitment to LGBTQI rights and experience or demonstrated competence in advocacy, policy influence, civil society support or related human rights work, particularly in relation to Ukraine.    Strong knowledge of the human rights situation and civil society landscape in Ukraine or the wider region, including experience working in partnership with LGBTQI movements or organisations.    At least three years of relevant professional experience in advocacy, civil society support, development cooperation or a related field.    Experience engaging with international or regional advocacy processes and human rights mechanisms, such as those of the EU, UN, OSCE or Council of Europe.    An understanding of security and safeguarding considerations when working with LGBTQI activists and civil society in challenging contexts.    Strong analytical, organisational and administrative skills, including experience with organisational capacity assessment, budgets, programme documentation and risk management.    Excellent written and spoken English.    Some understanding of Ukrainian or a closely related language, together with a willingness to develop Ukrainian-language skills as needed.    The ability to work from Stockholm, Sweden, and undertake international travel several times per year.Employment terms    Employment type: This is a permanent position, starting with a six-month probationary period.     Location: RFSL office in Stockholm.    Start date: As agreed    Contract terms: Covered by the Collective Agreement for Nonprofit OrganizationsOur offerRFSL offers an inclusive, values-driven workplace where you can contribute to meaningful change alongside committed colleagues and partners. We provide competitive employment conditions, including occupational pension and parental benefits.How to applyApply by November 15th, 2026. The recruitment process is conducted in English and includes anonymous, competency-based assessment, a work-related assignment and a background check.For questions about the position or recruitment process, contact HR Partner Tobias Jensen at tobias.jensen@rfsl.se.RFSL strives to be an inclusive, feminist and anti-racist workplace. We welcome applicants regardless of sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, sex characteristics, religion, race, ethnicity, country of origin, disability, age or other grounds of discrimination. We strongly encourage candidates with diverse backgrounds and experiences to apply.

title: Senior Control Systems Engineer
description: What we do at BlykallaBlykalla is a Swedish deep-tech company at the forefront of the nuclear industry, pioneering the development of small modular reactors that provide clean, safe, and reliable energy. Thanks to lead-cooling, we achieve high safety in a very compact format, allowing for a simple and cost-effective design that can be mass-produced. Our unique reactor design will provide safe and green baseload energy that perfectly complements solar and wind power.What you’ll get to doWe are seeking a Senior Control Systems Engineer with deep expertise in ABB 800xA DCS to lead the development of Blykalla's plant control system architecture and implementation strategy.This is a unique opportunity to help define the control philosophy of a first-of-a-kind advanced nuclear reactor. You will play a key role in ensuring that Blykalla develops and retains ownership of critical control system intellectual property while working closely with ABB and other suppliers.Key ResponsibilitiesDCS Architecture & Ownership    Lead the design and development of Blykalla's plant-wide automation and control system architecture.    Define the ABB 800xA system architecture for reactor, balance-of-plant, auxiliary, and test facility applications.    Develop internal engineering standards, libraries, templates, and control strategies to maximize in-house ownership of intellectual property.    Establish long-term governance for control system design, lifecycle management, cybersecurity, and configuration control.Control System Engineering    Develop functional specifications, control narratives, cause-and-effect matrices, and automation philosophies.    Design and implement control logic, sequences, interlocks, alarms, and operator interfaces.    Configure ABB 800xA applications, controllers, engineering environments, and HMI systems.    Define communication architectures including OPC UA, IEC 61850, Modbus, Profibus/Profinet, Ethernet/IP, and other industrial protocols.    Develop and maintain simulation and testing environments for control system validation.Nuclear Plant Integration    Support the integration of reactor systems, safety systems, and balance-of-plant equipment into the overall control architecture.    Work closely with reactor, thermal-hydraulic, electrical, mechanical, and safety engineers to define system requirements.    Contribute to licensing and regulatory documentation related to instrumentation and control systems.    Support development of digital I&C architectures aligned with nuclear industry expectations and international standards.Vendor & Stakeholder Management    Act as the primary technical interface with ABB regarding 800xA architecture, licensing, engineering tools, and implementation support.    Ensure that Blykalla retains ownership of application software, engineering databases, configuration standards, and control strategies.    Manage external engineering partners and system integrators where required.    Participate in factory acceptance tests (FAT), site acceptance tests (SAT), commissioning, and startup activities.Verification & Validation    Develop testing methodologies for control logic verification and system validation.    Lead integration testing and commissioning activities.    Support development of digital twins and operator training simulators.    Ensure traceability from requirements through implementation and testing.Who you’ll get to work withThe Senior Control Systems Engineer sits in the Plant engineering Team within Blykalla. We are a diverse team that is passionate about our work and Blykalla. Who you areYou will be part of a highly skilled team with a can-do attitude. We value personnel chemistry and strive to create a workplace where you enjoy coming to. There are however a few things that we think will help in order for you to succeed in this role, these are:    MSc or BSc in Control Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering, Nuclear Engineering, or related discipline.    Minimum 10 years of experience in industrial automation and control systems engineering.    Extensive hands-on experience with ABB 800xA DCS engineering, configuration, commissioning, and lifecycle management.    Proven experience designing and implementing large-scale DCS architectures.    Experience developing control strategies for complex industrial facilities.    Strong understanding of industrial networks, field instrumentation, and process control.    Fluent in English, spoken and written    Fluency in Swedish is a plusTechnical Skills    Expert-level knowledge of ABB 800xA:    AC 800M controllers    Control Builder    Aspect Objects    System 800xA Engineering    Operator Workplace    Alarm Management    Batch and Advanced Process Control (desirable)    Strong understanding of:    ISA-88    ISA-95    IEC 61511    IEC 61508    Industrial cybersecurity principles    Configuration management and software lifecycle practices    Experience with simulation and testing environments.Location This position is for our office in Stockholm.Reference & Background ChecksAs part of our recruitment process, we conduct background checks on all candidates. We may also conduct reference checks to gain a well-rounded understanding of your professional experience, performance, and ways of working. This includes both references provided by you and, where relevant, conversations with other professional contacts who have worked closely with you. We strive to be transparent about our reference-checking process and handle all personal data in accordance with applicable data protection regulations. Any additional references will be sought with professional judgment and only when considered relevant to the role.We offer competitive compensation aligned with our internal salary framework and growth potential in the role.We do not accept applications via email. We are not open to external help from recruitment agencies. Note on AI Use: Blykalla may use AI technology to assist with certain administrative aspects of the hiring process, such as note-taking, interview documentation, and reporting. However, every resume and application is reviewed directly by our recruiting team. AI tools are used solely for operational support and do not influence candidate evaluation or hiring decisions.

title: Swiss German AI Voice Trainer
description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Swiss AI Voice Trainer--- Swiss AI Voice Trainer======================What if your Swiss language skills could help improve the AI.  **PROJECT DETAILS**   **Title: Hydrus \- Voice Contributor \- Swiss (Switzerland)Project Overview:** a scripted and conversational audio data collection project**Language:** Swiss (Switzerland)**Location:** Remote (Switzerland)**Compensation**: 65USD per hour **WHAT YOU’LL DO**  Two supervised sessions of approximately 4 hours each, guided in real time by a Session Director on a separate recording platform. Record scripted material in a natural, conversational tone — faithfully, without a polished, performed, or “announcer” delivery. Record unscripted, spontaneous speech on a given topic, matching the same warmth and pace as your scripted takes. Set up and manage your own recording space and equipment for session recording. Deliver all recordings entirely in the required language (with specific dialect), without code\-switching into other languages or dialects.   **WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR** **Required** Experience as a voice actor, actor, or theater performer, or a comparable performance background. Native or native\-equivalent fluency in the required language and dialect, with the ability to deliver natural, everyday\-sounding speech both when reading a script and speaking to a quiet recording space, free of echo and background noise (acoustically treated for session recording, if selected). Owns or will acquire a dedicated, professional\-grade microphone for the audition (e.g. RODE NT\-USB , Blue Yeti), upgrading to a qualifying USB condenser or XLR mic \+ audio interface for session recording if selected. Built\-in laptop mics, AirPods, earbuds, and headsets are not accepted at any stage. Owns closed\-back monitoring headphones (required for session recording if selected). Comfortable both self\-directing for the audition and taking live direction from a Session Director in guided sessions.**Preferred (nice to have, not required)** Professional voice\-over experience (dubbing/ADR, audiobook, podcasting) in a conversational rather than commercial/announcer register. Baseline audio hygiene: comfortable setting mic distance and catching noise, clipping, or distortion yourself. An existing home recording setup already treated for sound. **Please note**: the recordings you produce may be used to create synthesized, AI\-generated voices for conversational AI products. Full details on how your data is collected, used, shared, and retained are set out in a Consent Form, which you'll review and sign before any paid session recording begins. **Your Data \& Privacy**Before any session recording, you'll be asked to review and sign a Consent Form covering how your voice recordings are collected, used (including to train synthesized/AI voice models), shared with approved partners, retained, and how to exercise your data rights (access, correction, deletion, and more, depending on where you live). If you'd like to review these terms before applying, contact us and we'll share a copy in advance. ![Welocalize]()* Welocalize  8001 Zürich*jid6011255jm jit1044jm jiy26jm

assurer l’analyse des risques et le contrôle du périmètre tout au long du projet (projets env. 500 kCHF).* Sécurité \& Qualit\&eacute; : intégrer les exigences HSE et qualité dès la conception et jusqu’à l’exécution.* Suivi administratif : suivre les coûts et le planning, assurer la prévisibilité et produire la documentation projet.* Organisation : coordonner sponsors et parties prenantes, collecter les informations nécessaires aux décisions, constituer et piloter l’équipe projet.* Communication : animer les équipes transverses, remonter les points de vigilance et plans d’actions, respecter la confidentialité, représenter l’expertise technique sur le projet.**Votre profil*** Diplôme d’ingénieur* Minimum 3 ans d’expérience en gestion de projets infrastructure/bâtiment en environnement industriel* Solide capacité à maîtriser et piloter les coûts* Connaissances en utilities / HVAC / traitement d’air : un plus* Bonne connaissance des réglementations suisses et des permis de construire : un avantagejpid4b183f1jm jpit1044jm jpiy26jm

title: Infirmier·ère diplômé·e
description: --- base: meta-keywords: meta-viewport: width=device-width, title: Infirmier·ère diplômé·e --- Infirmier·ère diplômé·e ============================ \*\*À propos de notre institution\*\* Situé à Payerne, notre EMS accueille 44 résident·e·s en long séjour dans un environnement calme, familial et accompagnons des personnes âgées présentant des besoins relevant de la gériatrie et de la gériatrie complexe, en plaçant au cœur de nos pratiques la qualité des soins, le respect de la personne et le maintien de son autonomie. \*\*Vos missions\*\* En tant qu'infirmier·ère, vous jouez un rôle essentiel dans l'accompagnement et la prise en soins de nos résident·e·s. À ce titre, vous serez notamment amené·e à : \* Assurer des soins infirmiers et des traitements médico\\-techniques adaptés aux besoins des résident·e·s. \* Accompagner et soutenir les résident·e·s dans les activités de la vie quotidienne, en favorisant leur autonomie, leur dignité et leur bien\\-être. \* Participer à l'évaluation des situations de soins et à la mise en œuvre d'une prise en charge individualisée et globale. \* Identifier les situations complexes et contribuer à leur gestion en collaboration avec les différents professionnels. \* Assurer une transmission fiable, précise et structurée des informations, tant à l'oral qu'à l'écrit. \* Garantir la qualité et la continuité du dossier de soins. \* Assurer, en l'absence de l'IC ou de l'ICUS, la gestion et l'organisation de la journée au sein de l'équipe de soins, en coordonnant les activités, en répartissant les tâches et en veillant au bon déroulement des soins et à la continuité de la prise en charge des résident·e·s. \* Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes soignantes, médicales et les autres secteurs de l'institution. \* Développer des synergies et une collaboration interdisciplinaire favorisant une prise en charge cohérente des résident·e·s. \* Participer à l'évolution et à l'amélioration continue des pratiques professionnelles. \*\*Votre profil :\*\* Nous recherchons une personne engagée, autonome et désireuse de s'investir dans un environnement en évolution. Vous êtes : \* Titulaire d'un diplôme d'infirmier·ère HES ou d'une formation reconnue comme équivalente. \* Au bénéfice d'une expérience clinique en gériatrie ou en EMS en Suisse. \* À l'aise dans l'accompagnement de personnes âgées présentant des situations de santé complexes. \* Une expérience ou une spécialisation complémentaire en lien avec la gériatrie constitue un atout. \* À l'aise avec les outils informatiques utilisés dans le domaine des soins ; la connaissance de Carefolio est un avantage. \* Rigoureux·se dans la tenue, le suivi et l'amélioration du dossier de soins informatisé. \* Doté·e d'un bon sens de l'organisation, de l'autonomie et des responsabilités. \* Reconnu·e pour vos qualités relationnelles, votre capacité d'écoute et votre esprit d'équipe. \* Adaptable et à l'aise dans un contexte institutionnel en pleine évolution. \* Domicilié·e dans la région ou disposé·e à assurer les éventuelles astreintes et interventions rapides sur site, selon les besoins du poste. \* La formation d'évaluateur·trice PLEX / Plaisir constitue un atout supplémentaire \*\*Nous vous offrons :\*\* \* Des horaires continus uniquement pour le personnel infirmier \* Une collaboration étroite avec une équipe dynamique engagée dans l'évolution des pratiques. \* Un EMS à taille humaine, fondé sur des valeurs de proximité, de respect et de bienveillance envers les résident·e·s. \* Des possibilités de formation et de développement professionnel. \* Des conditions de travail conformes à la CCT\\-SAN Vaud. \*\*Entrée en fonction\*\* 1er décembre 2026 ou à convenir Nous vous remercions de nous adresser votre dossier complet (CV, lettre de motivation, diplômes et certificats de travail) \*\*uniquement\*\* via le site JobUp. Il ne sera répondu qu'aux dossiers complets et correspondants au profil. \*\*Renseignements\*\* 📞 Mme Aurélie Meylan, infirmière\\-cheffe -- \\+ !\[EMS les Cerisiers\]( ) \* EMS les Cerisiers Rue des Cerisiers 15 1530 Payerne \* \[ \](\< \>) jpid5a86c63jm jpit1044jm jpiy26jm
