title: Institutional Coordinator Human Research Infrastructure
description: Ref 2581058 \\\| Date: 25 Sept 2026 !\[EPFL\]( ) EPFL, the Swiss Federal Institute of Technology in Lausanne, is one of the most dynamic university campuses in Europe and ranks among the top 20 universities worldwide. The EPFL employs more than 6,500 people supporting the three main missions of the institution: education, research and innovation. The EPFL campus offers an exceptional working environment at the heart of a community of more than 17,000 people, including over 12,500 students and 4,000 researchers from more than 120 different countries. Institutional Coordinator Human Research Infrastructure \*\*Mission\*\* EPFL is strengthening its capacity to conduct world\\-leading research involving human biological samples, clinical collaborations, sensitive data, artificial intelligence, and biomedical innovation. To support this ambition, EPFL is establishing an institutional framework for the management of human biological samples and sensitive research data. This initiative will provide researchers with secure, compliant, and scalable infrastructure and services that support cutting\\-edge research while meeting evolving Swiss, European, and international regulatory requirements. EPFL seeks an experienced and visionary coordinator to establish and develop this new capability. \*\*Main duties and responsibilities\*\* \*\*Strategic Development:\*\* \\- Lead the implementation of EPFL's institutional strategy for human biological samples and sensitive research data. \\- Develop a long\\-term roadmap for human research infrastructure at EPFL in coordination with the operational teams. \\- Identify opportunities for national and international partnerships and participation in research infrastructures. \*\*Governance, Policy, and Compliance:\*\* \\- Establish and maintain governance frameworks for human biological samples and sensitive data, including policies for acquisition, access, sharing, reuse, and stewardship. \\- Support institutional alignment with ethical, legal, and regulatory requirements (Swiss HRA, GDPR, data protection, biobanking standards). \\- Promote harmonization and best practices across EPFL laboratories and research units. \*\*Cross\\-Institutional Coordination:\*\* \\- Serve as the institutional point of coordination for compliance topics involving human research. \\- Facilitate interactions between researchers, IT services, Legal Affairs, Ethics Affairs, the Data Protection Office, and external partners. \\- Coordinate EPFL's participation in national and international infrastructures ( , biobanking networks, secure data environments, precision medicine initiatives). \\- Oversee budget planning for the human research infrastructure ecosystem. \\- Represent EPFL in relevant governance bodies, working groups, and strategic partnerships. \*\*Sensitive Data and Clinical Research Support:\*\* \\- Oversee the development of secure research environments and trusted research infrastructures for sensitive data. \\- Work with the operational teams to implement robust processes for traceability, data governance, and responsible data use. \*\*Human Biological Samples and Biobanking:\*\* \\- Provide strategic oversight of the establishment and evolution of EPFL's biobank services. \\- Support the integration of EPFL's biobank services with the School of Life Sciences and clinical partners. \*\*Quality Systems:\*\* \\- Define quality\\-management expectations and appropriate certification frameworks. \\- Establish institutional KPIs, reporting mechanisms, and evaluation processes. \*\*Research Community Engagement:\*\* \\- Provide expert guidance to researchers developing projects involving human samples or sensitive data. \\- Promote training and awareness programs and foster a culture of responsible and compliant research across EPFL. \*\*Profile\*\* \*\*Essential:\*\* \* PhD or equivalent advanced degree in life sciences, biomedical sciences, genetics, bioinformatics, public health, or a related field. \* Significant experience managing human biological samples, human subjects/clinical research data and clinical trials. \* Demonstrated experience in research infrastructure leadership, biobanking governance, data governance, or large\\-scale biomedical programs. \* Strong understanding of ethical, legal, and regulatory frameworks relevant to human research in Switzerland as well as Good Clinical Practice (GCP). \* Experience coordinating across multiple stakeholders and organizational units. \* Experience with data governance and secure data environments \* Ability to provide strategic leadership in complex, multi\\-partner environments. \* Excellent communication, negotiation and organizational skills. \*\*Highly desirable:\*\* \* Experience with national or international biomedical infrastructures. \* Experience with biobank governance, sample management systems, or laboratory information management systems. \* Familiarity with precision medicine, genomics, multi\\-omics, or AI\\-enabled biomedical research. \* Experience operating at the interface between academia, healthcare institutions, industry, and public agencies. \*\*We offer\*\* At EPFL, we believe that people achieve great results when they feel supported, respected and enabled to succeed. By joining our community, you will help shape the future of society through education, research and innovation. We offer an inspiring, international and collaborative environment where your work has real impact and your ideas are valued. Combined with flexible ways of working and attractive employment conditions, we aim to create an environment where everyone can contribute, grow and make a difference. Beyond work, our campuses host a vibrant community and unique environment, enriched by initiatives promoting equality, inclusion, diversity, well\\-being and sustainability as well as an engaging program of cultural, sports and community activities throughout the year. \[Read about our employment conditions and employee benefits\](\< \> " ") \*\*Informations\*\* Contract Start Date : asap Activity Rate : Contract Type: CDD Duration: one year Reference: 2467 jpidb6b43f8jm jpit0939jm jpiy26jm

title: Master thesis / Internship in modelling of densified activated sludge in sequencing batch reactor
description: Master thesis / Internship in modelling of densified activated sludge in sequencing batch reactor (DAS\-SBR)  Eawag, the Swiss Federal Institute of Aquatic Science and Technology, is an internationally networked aquatic research institute within the ETH Domain (Swiss Federal Institutes of Technology). Eawag conducts research, education and expert consulting to achieve the dual goals of meeting direct human needs for water and maintaining the function and integrity of aquatic ecosystems.  The Department of Process Engineering (ENG) has a vacancy for a  Master thesis / Internship in modelling of densified activated sludge in sequencing batch reactor (DAS\-SBR)  Densified Activated Sludge (DAS), a hybrid system consisting of flocs and small granules (typically 200\~500 ?m in diameter), is a promising solution for the increasing stringent effluent quality standards and the intensification of biological processes in wastewater treatment. Compared to conventional activated sludge, DAS offers significant advantages to "do more with less" \- increasing treatment capacity without expanding the plant footprint. The improved settleability enables high biomass retention, thereby substantially increasing volumetric treatment capacity. The enrichment of slow\-growing bacteria, particularly nitrifiers, promotes microbial activities and provides greater flexibility for optimizing aeration strategies for enhancing nutrient removal.  The application of DAS in sequencing batch reactors (SBR) is being increasingly investigated and implemented worldwide, yielding many new valuable experimental findings and operational experience. However, a comprehensive understanding of long\-term performance of DAS\-SBR systems under dynamic conditions remains limited. Existing mathematical models do not yet adequately represent all relevant processes and characteristics, nor have they been calibrated and validated using real\-world operational data.  This project aims to develop a DAS\-SBR model in Sumo, which can better represent the key biological and physical processes observed in practice. By calibrating and validating the model against real\-world datasets, the project seeks to improve the understanding of DAS\-SBR system and to provide a reliable tool for process analysis, optimization, and future design.  We are looking for a motivated master thesis student or intern, who needs to be enrolled in a university for the entire thesis/internship duration, with interests in advanced technologies for biological wastewater treatment and modelling biological processes. Fluent spoken and written English are essential. Strong data analysis and programming skills and experience with modelling in Sumo are highly recommended. The preferred starting date is September/October 2026 onwards, not later than March 2027\.  At Eawag, we have a working environment in which people with different experiences, strengths, and perspectives can fully contribute and further develop. Here, you can help us advance! We promote genuine participation, exchange, and mutual understanding. We create structures that enable the compatibility of work and other areas of life, such as care work, and continuously make efforts to reduce barriers.  Do you have specific requirements regarding the application process or the position, or do you need additional information? Talk to us about it\-we will be happy to support you with possible flexible workplace, working hours, and job design solutions. For further information about Eawag and its conditions of employment, please visit and /.  Applications can be submitted until the position is filled and will therefore be evaluated on a rolling basis. Applications should include a short letter (. one page) describing your interests and their relevance to this position, a CV, and a list of lectures/transcripts of records from the university.  For further information, please contact Mengqi Zhu or Dr Derlon.  We look forward to receiving your application. Please send it through this webpage, as any other way of applying will not be considered. A click on the link below will take you directly to the application form.  Apply now  Eawag: Swiss Federal Institute of Aquatic Science and Technology jpid92ba563jm jit0731jm jiy26jm

ISB is an International Baccalaureate World School offering the Primary Years Programme (PYP) for younger students aged 3 to 11, the Middle Years Programme (MYP) for students aged 11 to 16 and the Diploma Programme (DP) for students in the final two years of their school careers. ISB is accredited by the New England Association of Schools and Colleges (NEASC). At ISB, we live our Mission and are committed to creating safe, caring, and affirming learning spaces for our international community. It is our aim to create a welcoming environment for students and families from across the globe and to promote learning and respect for people of all nationalities, religions and cultures. ISB's commitment to hiring and retaining quality employees has created a community of professional and dynamic teaching and administrative staff with low turnover rates and a high degree of involvement in professional development programmes. For more information about the school and our mission we invite you to visit our website at **EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER**International School Basel is an equal opportunity employer with a strong commitment to diversity. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, and national origin. **COMMITMENT TO SAFE RECRUITMENT**International School Basel is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of students in its care. As an employer, the school expects all staff and volunteers to share this commitment. All post holders are appointed subject to satisfactory **Criminal Records Checks, Social Media Check, Civil Litigation Check, Global Sanctions Check, and Reference Checks** with past employers. **THE POSITION**ISB seeks to appoint a passionate and dedicated Teacher of (Language and Literature) to join our Middle School Modern Languages Team. The successful candidate will teach to our Middle School students in Grades 6 to 8 within the IB Middle Years Programme. Ideally the candidate could additionally teach **Science** and/or **Individuals \& Societies** in as part of our new Middle School Dual Language Programme.Candidates applying for this role should have proven experience teaching in an international environment, ideally within an MYP context and hold a classroom teaching license and have a minimum of four years teaching experience. We will provide training to a successful candidate who does not have prior MYP experience.Please see the Description for more details. **OUR OFFER**ISB offers an excellent employment package and relocation support in an international and welcoming environment including free after\-school childcare, lessons, professional development opportunities, onsite fitness facilities and first\-class accident insurance worldwide together with an employee friendly pension plan. **HOW TO APPLY**Please apply by sending your application directly to us or by using the link available on Search Associates, the TES or the website. Your application should include: Letter of Application (2 pages maximum); up\-to\-date Curriculum Vitae; and names and contact details of at least two (although three is preferred) professional referees who have line\-managed you: one of whom must be your current Head of School (if this poses major difficulties, please state reasons in your letter of application). If you have been at your current school for less than 2 years, one of your referees must also be the Head of your previous school. Referees will be contacted once a candidate has accepted an invitation to interview for the role. For registered Search Associates candidates, ISB will download your Search Associates file (including References) directly. Due to work permit restrictions, preference will be given to candidates of EU/Swiss nationalities and candidates who hold a current Swiss work permit. Kindly note that the School reserves the right to end the search early should a suitable candidate be identified. **WE LOOK FORWARD TO RECEIVING YOUR APPLICATION!**![International School of the Basel Region AG]()* International School of the Basel Region AG  Fleischbachstrasse 2  4153 Reinach BL*jid3be8078jm jit1044jm jiy26jm

title: Team Leader des infirmiers à domicile 80% - Genève
description: Ref 2587540 \| Date: 26 Oct 2026![Unilabs]( )Team Leader des infirmiers à domicile 80% \- Genève**À propos de nous**Unilabs est l'une des principales entreprises de diagnostic en Europe et propose aux patients, sur quatre continents, une offre complète de services de laboratoire, de pathologie et d'imagerie. En tant que leader du numérique couvrant l'ensemble du domaine du diagnostic, les plus de 13'000 collaborateurs d'Unilabs dans le monde sauvent des vies chaque jour. Unilabs investit massivement dans la technologie, l'équipement et le personnel et utilise les technologies numériques de pointe dans ses laboratoires et instituts d'imagerie pour améliorer la vie de près de 100 millions de personnes chaque année.**Vos responsabilités**Vous aimez accompagner une équipe et rester proche du terrain ?  Unilabs recherche une ou un Team Leader à 80%, basé à Genève, pour encadrer son équipe d'infirmiers à domicile en Suisse romande, dès le 1er janvier 2027\.  Vous jouez un rôle clé dans l'organisation des tournées, la qualité des prélèvements et l'accompagnement des collaborateurs.**Compétences requises****Vos missions:**  Encadrer, motiver et accompagner l'équipe au quotidien.  Organiser les plannings et les tournées selon les besoins des patients et les disponibilités de l'équipe.  Accueillir les nouveaux collaborateurs et suivre leur intégration, leurs compétences et leurs besoins de formation.  Veiller au respect des procédures de prélèvement, des règles d'hygiène et de sécurité ainsi que des conditions de conservation des échantillons.  Assurer une coordination efficace avec la responsable, les laboratoires.  Suivre l'activité, identifier les difficultés et proposer des améliorations.  Veiller à la disponibilité du matériel et participer aux prélèvements à domicile selon les besoins.**Votre profil:**  Formation en soins infirmiers et expérience confirmée dans les prélèvements sanguins.  Une expérience à domicile et dans l'encadrement d'équipe constitue un atout.  Sens de l'organisation, autonomie et capacité à gérer les imprévus.  Maîtrise du français ; anglais souhaité**Vos qualités humaines sont essentielles:**  Nous recherchons une personne à l'écoute, bienveillante et fiable, capable de créer une relation de confiance avec les patients et les collaborateurs.  Vous savez fédérer une équipe, reconnaître les contributions de chacun et encourager l'entraide. Vous communiquez avec clarté et respect, donnez des retours constructifs et gérez les tensions avec calme et équité. Votre disponibilité et votre exemplarité font de vous un véritable soutien pour l'équipe.  **Envie de nous rejoindre ?**  Adressez\-nous votre CV accompagné de quelques lignes présentant votre motivation.  Lieu de travail : Genève, avec un périmètre d'activité en Suisse romande  Taux d'activité : 80%  Entrée en fonction : 1er janvier 2027**Nous offrons*** Un environnement de travail passionnant et dynamique, avec une dimension internationale* La possibilité de prendre des responsabilités et de développer votre potentiel* Une atmosphère de travail positive dans un cadre collaboratif et une culture d'entreprise pronant le respect et la reconnaissance* Des avantages sociaux attractifs, ainsi qu'une semaine de travail de 40 heures et 5 semaines de vacances par année* Un forfait annuel pour vos analyses personnelles et tarifs spéciaux pour les actes de radiologie effectués au sein du Groupe Unilabs**Contact**  Envoyer cette annonce à un amijpidafd84e3jm jpit1044jm jpiy26jm

title: Head of Quality, Health, Safety & Environment
description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Head of Quality, Health, Safety &amp; Environment (M/F/D)--- Head of Quality, Health, Safety \& Environment (M/F/D)======================================================Aviation connects the world, and Swissport makes it happen. Every year, we serve nearly 250 million passengers, welcome six million guests to our airport lounges, and handle more than five million tons of air cargo at over 300 airports in nearly 50 countries. This makes us the world’s leading provider of ground handling services and larger than any single airline. With around 63,000 highly qualified employees, we ensure that travel and trade run smoothly worldwide every day, while driving innovation in the aviation industry. Together, we are shaping the airport experience of the future. **We are looking for a**  **HEAD OF QUALITY, HEALTH, SAFETY \& ENVIRONMENT (M/W/D)**WORKLOAD \| 100%  LOCATION I GENEVA AIRPORT   **YOUR MISSION**  As Head of QHSE, you will act as a trusted partner to the Station Manager while championing a strong and sustainable culture of quality, health, safety, security and environmental responsibility at Swissport Geneva. By partnering closely with the management team and empowering our operational leaders, you will turn global standards into effective local practices, drive continuous improvement and ensure a safe, compliant and reliable operation.   **YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES*** Act as a close, trusted partner to the Station Manager and to central QHSE stakeholders in a matrix organisation, contributing to the strategic development and implementation of QHSE standards and objectives* Lead and develop a team of specialists in Compliance, Quality, Occupational Health and Safety, and Environmental Protection, fostering both professional growth and a strong team culture* Drive the implementation and continuous improvement of the local QHSE Management System, promoting awareness, safe behaviours, accountability and employee engagement* Oversee QHSE performance monitoring, internal audits, risk assessments (HIRA) and corrective action plans, ensuring compliance with applicable standards and procedures* Advise and coach managers and shift leaders on risk mitigation and incident investigations, represent Swissport Geneva in relevant committees, and oversee subcontractor audits **YOUR PROFILE*** A university degree or equivalent professional qualification; a Swiss Federal Diploma of Advanced Studies in Occupational Safety and Health Protection (ASGS) is preferred, or a willingness to obtain one post\-hire* Proven experience in implementing and maintaining ISO, OHSAS and/or ISAGO standards; auditor certification is an advantage* At least 5 years of experience in QHSE roles within aviation, ground handling or a comparable operational environment* Excellent communication skills in French and English, enabling you to engage confidently with stakeholders at all levels, from frontline employees to senior management* Proven leadership experience, a hands\-on and collaborative approach, and the ability to translate strategic objectives into practical solutions while engaging stakeholders around shared goals **WE OFFER*** Participation in the Management Incentive Program (MIP)* A workplace directly at Geneva Airport in an international environment* Attractive flight ticket discounts within the Swissport network* Insurance discounts (e.g. health, household and car insurance)* Public transport subsidies and commuting benefits **Are you interested? We look forward to receiving your application through our online job platform.**![Swissport International AG]()* Swissport International AG  Zürich\-Flughafen  8060 Zürich*jid71b4ce9jm jit1044jm jiy26jm

title: Swiss German AI Voice Trainer
description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Swiss AI Voice Trainer--- Swiss AI Voice Trainer======================What if your Swiss language skills could help improve the AI.  **PROJECT DETAILS**   **Title: Hydrus \- Voice Contributor \- Swiss (Switzerland)Project Overview:** a scripted and conversational audio data collection project**Language:** Swiss (Switzerland)**Location:** Remote (Switzerland)**Compensation**: 65USD per hour **WHAT YOU’LL DO**  Two supervised sessions of approximately 4 hours each, guided in real time by a Session Director on a separate recording platform. Record scripted material in a natural, conversational tone — faithfully, without a polished, performed, or “announcer” delivery. Record unscripted, spontaneous speech on a given topic, matching the same warmth and pace as your scripted takes. Set up and manage your own recording space and equipment for session recording. Deliver all recordings entirely in the required language (with specific dialect), without code\-switching into other languages or dialects.   **WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR** **Required** Experience as a voice actor, actor, or theater performer, or a comparable performance background. Native or native\-equivalent fluency in the required language and dialect, with the ability to deliver natural, everyday\-sounding speech both when reading a script and speaking to a quiet recording space, free of echo and background noise (acoustically treated for session recording, if selected). Owns or will acquire a dedicated, professional\-grade microphone for the audition (e.g. RODE NT\-USB , Blue Yeti), upgrading to a qualifying USB condenser or XLR mic \+ audio interface for session recording if selected. Built\-in laptop mics, AirPods, earbuds, and headsets are not accepted at any stage. Owns closed\-back monitoring headphones (required for session recording if selected). Comfortable both self\-directing for the audition and taking live direction from a Session Director in guided sessions.**Preferred (nice to have, not required)** Professional voice\-over experience (dubbing/ADR, audiobook, podcasting) in a conversational rather than commercial/announcer register. Baseline audio hygiene: comfortable setting mic distance and catching noise, clipping, or distortion yourself. An existing home recording setup already treated for sound. **Please note**: the recordings you produce may be used to create synthesized, AI\-generated voices for conversational AI products. Full details on how your data is collected, used, shared, and retained are set out in a Consent Form, which you'll review and sign before any paid session recording begins. **Your Data \& Privacy**Before any session recording, you'll be asked to review and sign a Consent Form covering how your voice recordings are collected, used (including to train synthesized/AI voice models), shared with approved partners, retained, and how to exercise your data rights (access, correction, deletion, and more, depending on where you live). If you'd like to review these terms before applying, contact us and we'll share a copy in advance. ![Welocalize]()* Welocalize  8001 Zürich*jid6011255jm jit1044jm jiy26jm

title: Responsable Gestion de Projets Infrastructure
description: ---base:  /meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Responsable Gestion de Projets Infrastructure---Responsable Gestion de Projets Infrastructure=============================================La Fédération des Hôpitaux Vaudois informatique ( ), est le partenaire informatique privilégié de 12 hôpitaux et établissements de santé régionaux du canton de Vaud. La FHVi les accompagne dans les nombreux défis de la transformation digitale du domaine de la santé et a pour principales missions de planifier, concevoir, réaliser et exploiter le système informatique de ses membres. Ce sont plus de 120 collaborateurs au service de 14'000 utilisateurs, pour un parc de plus de 8'000 postes de travail répartis sur une centaine de sites géographiques et sur trois cantons (VD, VS, FR).poste s'adresse indifféremment à une femme ou à un homme. A des fins de commodité de lecture, les termes ne sont qu'au masculin.Responsable Gestion de Projets Infrastructure=============================================Faites partie de l’aventure FHVi !  **Votre mission**  En tant que Responsable Gestion de Projets, vous assurez le management de l’équipe des chefs de projet du département Infrastructure, Exploitation \& Support.Vous garantissez la bonne conduite des projets d’infrastructure IT du département, depuis leur cadrage jusqu’à leur mise en production et leur passage en exploitation, dans le respect des priorités, des budgets, des délais, des standards et de la méthodologie de gestion de projet définie par la FHVi.Manager expérimenté et disposant d’une solide compréhension des environnements d’infrastructure IT, vous accompagnez et challengez les chefs de projet dans la conduite de projets complexes portant notamment sur les réseaux, les systèmes, les datacenters, la virtualisation, le cloud, les télécommunications ou encore la sécurité.Vous veillez notamment à la maîtrise des risques ainsi qu’à la sécurité, la disponibilité, la fiabilité, la performance et l’exploitabilité des solutions déployées, dans un environnement hospitalier critique.Vous assurez l’interface entre les chefs de projet, le Directeur du département et le PMO et contribuez à la priorisation du portefeuille, à l’allocation des ressources et à la construction de la roadmap du département.  **Vos responsabilités**   **Management et développement de l’équipe des chefs de projet*** Assurer le management hiérarchique de l’équipe des chefs de projet Infrastructure : gestion administrative, entretiens annuels, fixation des objectifs individuels et collectifs et suivi de leur atteinte.  * Accompagner et challenger les chefs de projet dans la conduite de projets complexes et intervenir en soutien ou en escalade lorsque la situation l’exige.  * Développer l’autonomie et les compétences de l’équipe, identifier les besoins de formation et accompagner les parcours de développement et de certification.  * Participer au recrutement et à l’intégration des nouveaux chefs de projet.  * Assurer le suivi des ressources externes : prestations, engagements, qualité des interventions et coûts   **Pilotage et maîtrise des projets d’infrastructure*** Garantir la maîtrise globale des projets d’infrastructure IT du département : périmètre, planning, budget, ressources, risques, dépendances et qualité des livrables.  * S’assurer de la prise en compte des exigences de sécurité, disponibilité, fiabilité, performance, continuité de service et exploitabilité des systèmes.  * Identifier les dérives et risques majeurs et piloter, avec les chefs de projet et les responsables concernés, les mesures correctives nécessaires.  * Veiller à la bonne coordination des acteurs internes et externes intervenant dans les projets.  * Garantir les conditions d’un passage maîtrisé du Build vers le Run, notamment lors des mises en production.   **Allocation des ressources et pilotage de la charge*** Affecter les chefs de projet aux différents projets en fonction des priorités, des compétences requises, de leur complexité et des disponibilités.  * Maintenir une vision consolidée de la charge et de la capacité de l’équipe et anticiper les besoins en ressources internes et externes au regard de la roadmap.  * Identifier les risques de surcharge ou les goulets d’étranglement et proposer les mesures nécessaires.  * Arbitrer les conflits de ressources en lien avec le Directeur du département et le PMO.   **Gouvernance, méthodologie et performance des projets*** Garantir l’application de la méthodologie de gestion de projet définie par la FHVi et veiller à ce que le niveau de gouvernance soit adapté à la criticité et à la complexité des projets.  * Veiller à la qualité et à la complétude des éléments nécessaires au pilotage : cadrage, planning, budget, risques, dépendances, décisions, jalons et reporting.  * Organiser des revues régulières permettant d’évaluer la santé des projets, d’anticiper les écarts et d’identifier les actions nécessaires.  * Harmoniser les pratiques, outils et rituels de pilotage au sein de l’équipe.  * Définir et suivre les indicateurs permettant d’évaluer la performance et la maîtrise des projets.  * Capitaliser sur les retours d’expérience et faire évoluer les pratiques en collaboration avec le PMO.   **Portefeuille, roadmap et coordination*** Assurer l’interface entre les chefs de projet, le Directeur du département et le PMO pour le suivi des projets, les arbitrages et les escalades.  * Consolider le reporting du portefeuille : avancement, budgets, risques, dépendances et décisions attendues.  * Préparer et participer aux comités de pilotage et aux différentes instances de gouvernance.  * Faciliter les arbitrages entre les équipes projets, les équipes techniques, l’exploitation et les autres parties prenantes.  * Construire, avec le Directeur et les responsables d’équipe, la roadmap consolidée du département et contribuer à son intégration dans la roadmap globale de la FHVi.  * Contribuer, avec le PMO, au cadrage et à la priorisation des demandes de projets ainsi qu’à la maîtrise des dépendances entre projets.  * Participer à l’élaboration et au suivi du budget des activités Build du département.    **Profil recherché**   **Formation \& expérience*** Formation supérieure en informatique, ingénierie des systèmes d’information ou domaine technique connexe, de niveau HES/EPF/universitaire (Bachelor ou Master), ou titre jugé équivalent.  * Une formation complémentaire en management ou en gestion de projet constitue un atout.  * Certification reconnue en gestion de projet (HERMES, PMP, PRINCE2 ou IPMA) ; une certification Agile constitue un atout.  * Minimum 8 ans d’expérience dans la conduite de projets IT complexes, dont une expérience significative dans des projets d’infrastructure IT.  * Minimum 3 ans d’expérience dans le management hiérarchique d’une équipe de chefs de projet IT, idéalement dans le domaine des infrastructures.  * Expérience de projets couvrant plusieurs domaines d’infrastructure : systèmes, réseaux, datacenters, virtualisation, cloud, télécommunications et/ou sécurité.  * Expérience acquise dans des environnements critiques et complexes ; une expérience dans un contexte multi\-sites, hospitalier ou parapublic constitue un atout.   **Compétences techniques et professionnelles*** Solide compréhension des architectures et environnements d’infrastructure IT : réseaux, systèmes, datacenters, virtualisation, cloud, télécommunications et sécurité.  * Capacité à comprendre et challenger les enjeux, choix et risques techniques d’un projet et à dialoguer avec crédibilité avec les équipes spécialisées.  * Bonne compréhension des enjeux de cybersécurité, disponibilité, résilience, continuité de service et exploitabilité des infrastructures.  * îtrise approfondie des méthodologies de gestion de projet classiques, agiles et hybrides.  * îtrise du pilotage de projets complexes : budgets, ressources, risques, dépendances, priorités et coordination de multiples parties prenantes internes et externes.  * Capacité à piloter un portefeuille de projets, à consolider la vision des charges et des risques et à éclairer les arbitrages.  * îtrise des outils de gestion de projet et de portefeuille.  * Bonne connaissance des principes et processus ITIL, notamment de la transition vers l’exploitation.  * La connaissance des marchés publics (AIMP/LMP) constitue un atout.   **Compétences managériales*** Manager et fédérer une équipe de chefs de projet expérimentés, en donnant un cadre clair et en favorisant la responsabilisation.  * Accompagner et challenger les chefs de projet dans leurs pratiques, leurs décisions et la conduite de situations complexes.  * Développer les compétences et Vous travaillerez au sein d'un \*\*seul magasin situé à Marin\*\*, en collaboration avec l'équipe sur place. ### Les conditions du poste \* \*\*Contrat :\*\* CDI \* \*\*Taux d'activité :\*\* 80 % \* \*\*Temps de travail :\*\* environ 33,84 heures par semaine \* \*\*Rémunération :\*\* 3 060 CHF brut par mois \* \*\*Prime sur objectifs\*\* en complément du salaire fixe \* \*\*13e mois\*\* \* \*\*Lieu de travail :\*\* magasin 5àsec de Marin \* \*\*Organisation :\*\* travail sur plusieurs jours par semaine, selon le planning établi avec la gérante et la responsable de secteur. \* \*\*Repos :\*\* selon le planning communiqué par la hiérarchie. ### Les horaires L'amplitude horaire habituelle du magasin est de 8 h à 19 h. Les horaires sont organisés selon les besoins du magasin, avec une alternance entre les créneaux d'ouverture et de fermeture. \* \*\*Ouverture :\*\* de 8 h 30 à 17 h. \* \*\*Fermeture :\*\* de 10 h à 19 h. Des nocturnes sont également organisées ponctuellement, avec une fin de journée pouvant aller jusqu'à 21 h. Une bonne disponibilité et une capacité d'adaptation aux horaires sont donc nécessaires. ### Le profil recherché Nous recherchons avant tout une personne motivée, sérieuse et fiable, qui souhaite apprendre un nouveau métier. Vous êtes : \* Dynamique, rigoureux(se) et organisé(e). \* À l'aise dans la relation client et doté(e) d'un bon sens du service. \* Capable de travailler en équipe et de respecter les consignes. \* Minutieux(se) et attentif(ve) à la qualité de votre travail. \* En bonne condition physique, le métier impliquant de rester debout une grande partie de la journée, de travailler dans un environnement parfois chaud et d'effectuer des déplacements fréquents entre l'accueil et l'arrière\\-boutique. \* À l'aise en français, à l'oral comme à l'écrit, pour accueillir et conseiller les clients. HR Business Partner
===================

**The company**

The Swatch Group Services Ltd. is a dynamic company of the Swatch Group providing high quality services to the Group organizations worldwide in the fields of Logistics, Customer Services, Quality Management Real Estate \& Gems. The company belongs to the Swatch Group, the world's largest watch maker with a portfolio of 16 brands of which Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch and Flik Flak.

Swatch Group Services offers a unique ecosystem where people can accomplish their goals and achieve their aspirations. To strengthen our HR team, we are offering an exciting opportunity based between Biel (60%) and Neuchâtel (40%), with flexibility to discuss the allocation. We are currently looking for an:

**HR Business Partner (100%)**

**Job description**

In this role, you will manage the complete employee life cycle and support our managers as a coach and consultant, helping them guide their teams toward success. Your mission? Build a great work environment, solve challenges with style, and contribute to the vibrant culture of our company.

**Profile**

**Your responsibilities will include:**

* Act as the main point of contact for employees and managers (\>150 employees)
* Lead end\-to\-end recruitment and staffing for The Swatch Group Services in the fields of Logistics, Customer Services, Quality Management, Real Estate as well as for the Group's companies based in Neuchâtel.
* Be a partner with managers to analyse needs and select top talent.
* Negotiate offers, prepare contracts, and ensure smooth onboarding \& offboarding.
* Provide guidance on employee relations, performance topics, and change initiatives.
* Support managers in handling discussions, resolving issues, and navigating team conflicts.
* Organise and control of the yearly evaluation and talent management process, and follow\-up with measures if needed.
* Follow up on development needs and action plans.
* Handle warnings and contract terminations.


At Swatch Group Services, we value fresh ideas, especially in areas like employer branding, employee retention \& HR process optimization, to keep improving our quality standards and elevating the employee experience.

**Professional requirements**

* University degree in HR or equivalent (Brevet fédéral) with over 5 years of experience in a similar role.
* You are a natural networker, collaborate efficiently with everybody and you build a trustful relationship at all levels and be regarded as a trusted partner.
* You get a strong experience in Recruitment ideally in the Supply Chain field. Hands on in sourcing.
* You have an excellent consultative and client service skill with the ability to effectively influence and manage key relationships with a strong knowledge of Swiss law.
* Autonomous and self\-motivated, with initiative and an ability to manage multiple priorities with a sense of urgency.
* You are data driven as well as highly organized: You have a very structured way of working, being able to prioritize a variety of complex tasks and to complete them diligently


**You're missing one or two skills in the list, yet you're eager to learn?  
It's perfectly OK. We like to share.**

**Languages**

Now, in order to blend in, socially and professionally, we certainly recommend the following languages:

* Fluent in French and in English, combined with good knowledge of German considered an asset.
* Any other languages are welcome \- we have 29 so far in the company, if you wish to add the 30th, you pretty much know what to do


**Company address**

**Contact**

A dynamic and evolving work environment, complemented by attractive benefits:

* Continuous training to support your professional development
* Career growth opportunities through our internal mobility policy
* 5 to 6 weeks of vacation per year, depending on your age and/or position
* A 40\-hour work week, in line with the collective labor agreement (CCT)
* Competitive salary and excellent social benefits
* Parental leave: up to 3 weeks for the other parent and 19 weeks for mothers
* On\-site company restaurant with employer financial contribution
* Exclusive discounts on Swatch Group products and with our partners
* Sports activities and internal events to foster team spirit
* Contribution to health insurance costs


Ready to debug your career and deploy your next challenge? ? Apply now ?  
Just a quick note from our sysadmin: to keep things clean and green , we only accept applications through our website.

Aline Huguenin

description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Middle School (Language and Literature) Teacher (ideally able to teach Science and/or Individuals and Societies in )--- Middle School (Language and Literature) Teacher (ideally able to teach Science and/or Individuals and Societies in )====================================================================================================================**SCHOOL PROFILE**The International School Basel (ISB) is an English\-language international day school for students from ages 3 to 18\. ISB is home to approximately 1,110 students who enjoy modern purpose\-built facilities on three campuses clustered a few kilometers south of Basel in the towns of Reinach and Aesch. ISB is an International Baccalaureate World School offering the Primary Years Programme (PYP) for younger students aged 3 to 11, the Middle Years Programme (MYP) for students aged 11 to 16 and the Diploma Programme (DP) for students in the final two years of their school careers. ISB is accredited by the New England Association of Schools and Colleges (NEASC). At ISB, we live our Mission and are committed to creating safe, caring, and affirming learning spaces for our international community. It is our aim to create a welcoming environment for students and families from across the globe and to promote learning and respect for people of all nationalities, religions and cultures. ISB's commitment to hiring and retaining quality employees has created a community of professional and dynamic teaching and administrative staff with low turnover rates and a high degree of involvement in professional development programmes. For more information about the school and our mission we invite you to visit our website at **EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER**International School Basel is an equal opportunity employer with a strong commitment to diversity. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, and national origin. **COMMITMENT TO SAFE RECRUITMENT**International School Basel is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of students in its care. As an employer, the school expects all staff and volunteers to share this commitment. All post holders are appointed subject to satisfactory **Criminal Records Checks, Social Media Check, Civil Litigation Check, Global Sanctions Check, and Reference Checks** with past employers. **THE POSITION**ISB seeks to appoint a passionate and dedicated Teacher of (Language and Literature) to join our Middle School Modern Languages Team. The successful candidate will teach to our Middle School students in Grades 6 to 8 within the IB Middle Years Programme. Ideally the candidate could additionally teach **Science** and/or **Individuals \& Societies** in as part of our new Middle School Dual Language Programme.Candidates applying for this role should have proven experience teaching in an international environment, ideally within an MYP context and hold a classroom teaching license and have a minimum of four years teaching experience. We will provide training to a successful candidate who does not have prior MYP experience.Please see the Description for more details. **OUR OFFER**ISB offers an excellent employment package and relocation support in an international and welcoming environment including free after\-school childcare, lessons, professional development opportunities, onsite fitness facilities and first\-class accident insurance worldwide together with an employee friendly pension plan. **HOW TO APPLY**Please apply by sending your application directly to us or by using the link available on Search Associates, the TES or the website. Your application should include: Letter of Application (2 pages maximum); up\-to\-date Curriculum Vitae; and names and contact details of at least two (although three is preferred) professional referees who have line\-managed you: one of whom must be your current Head of School (if this poses major difficulties, please state reasons in your letter of application). If you have been at your current school for less than 2 years, one of your referees must also be the Head of your previous school. Referees will be contacted once a candidate has accepted an invitation to interview for the role. For registered Search Associates candidates, ISB will download your Search Associates file (including References) directly. Due to work permit restrictions, preference will be given to candidates of EU/Swiss nationalities and candidates who hold a current Swiss work permit. Kindly note that the School reserves the right to end the search early should a suitable candidate be identified. **WE LOOK FORWARD TO RECEIVING YOUR APPLICATION!**![International School of the Basel Region AG]()* International School of the Basel Region AG  Fleischbachstrasse 2  4153 Reinach BL*jid3be8078jm jit1044jm jiy26jm

description: Master thesis / Internship in modelling of densified activated sludge in sequencing batch reactor (DAS\-SBR)  Eawag, the Swiss Federal Institute of Aquatic Science and Technology, is an internationally networked aquatic research institute within the ETH Domain (Swiss Federal Institutes of Technology). Eawag conducts research, education and expert consulting to achieve the dual goals of meeting direct human needs for water and maintaining the function and integrity of aquatic ecosystems.  The Department of Process Engineering (ENG) has a vacancy for a  Master thesis / Internship in modelling of densified activated sludge in sequencing batch reactor (DAS\-SBR)  Densified Activated Sludge (DAS), a hybrid system consisting of flocs and small granules (typically 200\~500 ?m in diameter), is a promising solution for the increasing stringent effluent quality standards and the intensification of biological processes in wastewater treatment. Compared to conventional activated sludge, DAS offers significant advantages to "do more with less" \- increasing treatment capacity without expanding the plant footprint. The improved settleability enables high biomass retention, thereby substantially increasing volumetric treatment capacity. The enrichment of slow\-growing bacteria, particularly nitrifiers, promotes microbial activities and provides greater flexibility for optimizing aeration strategies for enhancing nutrient removal.  The application of DAS in sequencing batch reactors (SBR) is being increasingly investigated and implemented worldwide, yielding many new valuable experimental findings and operational experience. However, a comprehensive understanding of long\-term performance of DAS\-SBR systems under dynamic conditions remains limited. Existing mathematical models do not yet adequately represent all relevant processes and characteristics, nor have they been calibrated and validated using real\-world operational data.  This project aims to develop a DAS\-SBR model in Sumo, which can better represent the key biological and physical processes observed in practice. By calibrating and validating the model against real\-world datasets, the project seeks to improve the understanding of DAS\-SBR system and to provide a reliable tool for process analysis, optimization, and future design.  We are looking for a motivated master thesis student or intern, who needs to be enrolled in a university for the entire thesis/internship duration, with interests in advanced technologies for biological wastewater treatment and modelling biological processes. Fluent spoken and written English are essential. Strong data analysis and programming skills and experience with modelling in Sumo are highly recommended. The preferred starting date is September/October 2026 onwards, not later than March 2027\.  At Eawag, we have a working environment in which people with different experiences, strengths, and perspectives can fully contribute and further develop. Here, you can help us advance! We promote genuine participation, exchange, and mutual understanding. We create structures that enable the compatibility of work and other areas of life, such as care work, and continuously make efforts to reduce barriers.  Do you have specific requirements regarding the application process or the position, or do you need additional information? Talk to us about it\-we will be happy to support you with possible flexible workplace, working hours, and job design solutions. For further information about Eawag and its conditions of employment, please visit and /.  Applications can be submitted until the position is filled and will therefore be evaluated on a rolling basis. Applications should include a short letter (. one page) describing your interests and their relevance to this position, a CV, and a list of lectures/transcripts of records from the university.  For further information, please contact Mengqi Zhu or Dr Derlon.  We look forward to receiving your application. Please send it through this webpage, as any other way of applying will not be considered. A click on the link below will take you directly to the application form.  Apply now  Eawag: Swiss Federal Institute of Aquatic Science and Technology jpid92ba563jm jit0731jm jiy26jm

HR Business Partner
===================

**The company**

The Swatch Group Services Ltd. is a dynamic company of the Swatch Group providing high quality services to the Group organizations worldwide in the fields of Logistics, Customer Services, Quality Management Real Estate \& Gems. The company belongs to the Swatch Group, the world's largest watch maker with a portfolio of 16 brands of which Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch and Flik Flak.

Swatch Group Services offers a unique ecosystem where people can accomplish their goals and achieve their aspirations. To strengthen our HR team, we are offering an exciting opportunity based between Biel (60%) and Neuchâtel (40%), with flexibility to discuss the allocation. We are currently looking for an:

**HR Business Partner (100%)**

**Job description**

In this role, you will manage the complete employee life cycle and support our managers as a coach and consultant, helping them guide their teams toward success. Your mission? Build a great work environment, solve challenges with style, and contribute to the vibrant culture of our company.

**Profile**

**Your responsibilities will include:**

* Act as the main point of contact for employees and managers (\>150 employees)
* Lead end\-to\-end recruitment and staffing for The Swatch Group Services in the fields of Logistics, Customer Services, Quality Management, Real Estate as well as for the Group's companies based in Neuchâtel.
* Be a partner with managers to analyse needs and select top talent.
* Negotiate offers, prepare contracts, and ensure smooth onboarding \& offboarding.
* Provide guidance on employee relations, performance topics, and change initiatives.
* Support managers in handling discussions, resolving issues, and navigating team conflicts.
* Organise and control of the yearly evaluation and talent management process, and follow\-up with measures if needed.
* Follow up on development needs and action plans.
* Handle warnings and contract terminations.


At Swatch Group Services, we value fresh ideas, especially in areas like employer branding, employee retention \& HR process optimization, to keep improving our quality standards and elevating the employee experience.

**Professional requirements**

* University degree in HR or equivalent (Brevet fédéral) with over 5 years of experience in a similar role.
* You are a natural networker, collaborate efficiently with everybody and you build a trustful relationship at all levels and be regarded as a trusted partner.
* You get a strong experience in Recruitment ideally in the Supply Chain field. Hands on in sourcing.
* You have an excellent consultative and client service skill with the ability to effectively influence and manage key relationships with a strong knowledge of Swiss law.
* Autonomous and self\-motivated, with initiative and an ability to manage multiple priorities with a sense of urgency.
* You are data driven as well as highly organized: You have a very structured way of working, being able to prioritize a variety of complex tasks and to complete them diligently


**You're missing one or two skills in the list, yet you're eager to learn?  
It's perfectly OK. We like to share.**

**Languages**

Now, in order to blend in, socially and professionally, we certainly recommend the following languages:

* Fluent in French and in English, combined with good knowledge of German considered an asset.
* Any other languages are welcome \- we have 29 so far in the company, if you wish to add the 30th, you pretty much know what to do


**Company address**

**Contact**

A dynamic and evolving work environment, complemented by attractive benefits:

* Continuous training to support your professional development
* Career growth opportunities through our internal mobility policy
* 5 to 6 weeks of vacation per year, depending on your age and/or position
* A 40\-hour work week, in line with the collective labor agreement (CCT)
* Competitive salary and excellent social benefits
* Parental leave: up to 3 weeks for the other parent and 19 weeks for mothers
* On\-site company restaurant with employer financial contribution
* Exclusive discounts on Swatch Group products and with our partners
* Sports activities and internal events to foster team spirit
* Contribution to health insurance costs
